Role Overview

We’re looking for a proactive Project Manager
to lead teams, manage technology projects end-to-end, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high standard. The ideal candidate will coordinate cross-functional teams, manage priorities and resources, solve blockers, and drive efficient project execution.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

The Offer Management team is responsible for the design, development, launch and maintenance of integrated Services and Products within the Motorola Solutions Portfolio. This includes bringing together all the industry leading products, services and software capabilities of Motorola Solutions to create the Offer Solution. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for collaborating closely with the Offer Management team to drive cross-functional strategic offer execution, mentoring junior PM talent, building data dashboards using advanced metrics and AI tooling, and navigating key stakeholder relationships to deliver critical business results.

Job Description

The ideal candidate is an experienced professional who bridges the gap between high-level business strategy and tactical execution, has a strong grasp of macro business outcomes, and has a natural ability to coach and mentor junior talent. You are a data-first professional who leverages modern tooling—including advanced data analytics and AI execution—to build robust reporting frameworks and dashboards. You are highly comfortable interacting with senior leaders and thrive in an environment that rewards critical thinking, adaptability, and continuous learning.

Strategic Execution & Leadership

Manage complex, cross-functional initiatives from inception to delivery, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and ROI.
Champion PMO methodologies, continuously refining processes, governance, and templates to increase organizational velocity and maturity.
Anticipate project risks and bottlenecks, proactively developing mitigation strategies before they impact business operations.

Team Mentorship & Coaching

Act as a core mentor to junior PMs, accelerating their professional development and upgrading the team’s collective execution capabilities.
Conduct process and framework reviews for the broader team, ensuring high standards of project management hygiene across all workstreams.

Advanced Data, Metrics & Reporting

Design, build, and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and operational metrics that provide leadership with clear, actionable insights.
Utilize advanced data manipulation techniques within Google Sheets, writing complex formulas and leveraging AI tools (e.g., LLMs, advanced data analysis prompts) to optimize data structures and automate reporting workflows.
Translate dense project data into high-level strategic narratives for executive consumption.

Executive Stakeholder Management

Serve as a trusted partner to senior leadership, confidently presenting project statuses, risk profiles, and strategic recommendations.
Navigate ambiguous, high-stakes situations with emotional intelligence, discretion, and a constant focus on business impact.

Project Management

Demonstrate best practices for developing and managing schedules and understand risks, interdependencies and the critical path.
Collaborate with global stakeholders (internal and external) to obtain buy-in, resolve conflicts and drive successful delivery of projects.
Manages expectations of project stakeholders with timely communication/escalation of risks/issues, their impact, and mitigation/corrective actions.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

7+ years of progressive project/program management experience, preferably with experience in Service - Implementation, Telecommunications, Radio Communications, or Aerospace/Defense preferred.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or similar is preferred.
Demonstrated competency with a project management tool (e.g. MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet).
Deep understanding of how project deliverables impact the broader business operations, P&L, and strategic objectives.
Advanced expertise in Google Sheets (complex formulas, nested functions, data modelling) combined with a demonstrated ability to use AI tools to augment and accelerate technical workflows.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to command a room, influence stakeholders, and mentor junior peers.
An insatiable appetite for learning new technologies, methodologies, and business domains.
Highly organized, structured, and process oriented; team building skills a plus.
Certified PMP preferred and Agile/Scrum Certification an advantage.

Target Base Salary Range: $140,000-$150,000

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's Degree and 7+ years of Project Management experience.
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits Include

Incentive Bonus Plans
Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
401K with Company Match
10 Paid Holidays
Generous Paid Time Off Packages
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Paid Parental & Family Leave
and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

jobs.title: Project Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
Mullins Mechanical is a leader in industrial and large commercial mechanical, plumbing, HVAC construction projects. Our projects are often in the industrial and manufacturing environments, such as manufacturing facilities, automotive plants, chemical plants, distribution centers, warehouses, and other large commercial facilities. We are a self-performing specialty contractor specializing in design-build applications, HVAC systems, plumbing, process piping systems, boiler and chiller systems, equipment installation and rigging, plant relocation and maintenance, and metal fabrication.

Responsibilities:

Lead the transition of projects from Preconstruction to Operations, ensuring alignment on budget, scope, risks, and schedules.
Launch Project Services team setup and establish deliverables, priorities, and ownership.
Create and maintain centralized dashboards/tracking systems (budget, procurement, submittals/RFIs, schedules, and BIM/VDC deliverables).
Coordinate subcontractor/vendor outreach and early procurement activities.
Set up project communication rhythms, kickoff summaries, and reporting structures.
Maintain and monitor the Master Services Trackers, ensuring timely updates on cost, schedule, procurement, submittals, and VDC progress.
Lead weekly internal Project Services meetings to align priorities, track risks, and resolve issues.
Oversee change management processes: tracking PCOs, packaging CORs, and maintaining exposure logs.
Partner with Procurement, Cost Controls, Scheduling, and VDC teams to support execution needs.
Provide financial oversight by coordinating monthly forecasts, validating costs, and monitoring labor trends.
Ensure documentation, Procore updates, and GC communication are accurate and current.
Act as a second set of eyes for the Onsite PM, proactively identifying risks and providing backup analysis.
Prepare and distribute weekly and monthly Project Services summaries for leadership reviews.
Develop and manage closeout plans, including O&Ms, as-builts, compliance, and final documentation.
Coordinate final cost reconciliations and job cost reporting.
Track and oversee punchlist completion, inspections, and commissioning.
Lead internal project debriefs to capture lessons learned.
Manage warranty responsibilities, including issue resolution with clients, vendors, and subcontractors.
Archive all project documentation and provide final performance summaries.
Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, business, or related field.
5+ years of experience in construction project management, with strong exposure to project controls (cost, schedule, procurement, or VDC).
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Procore, scheduling tools, forecasting dashboards).
Strong understanding of construction financials, forecasting, and reporting.
Familiarity with BIM/VDC coordination and document control processes.
Excellent organizational and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to coordinate across multiple teams.
Ability to anticipate risks, escalate issues, and support problem-solving under pressure.
Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Commitment to accountability, consistency, and continuous improvement.

Equal Employment Opportunity: Mullin Mechanical is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Disclaimer: This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Join Us

Mullins Mechanical ranked #243 on the 2024 ENR Top Specialty Contractors list, #48 in the Nation and #5 in the Southeast among Firms in Mechanical. We’re proud to be one of the fastest growing privately held companies in America. We’re a self-performing specialty contractor specializing in design-build applications, HVAC systems, plumbing, process piping systems, boiler and chiller systems, equipment installation and rigging, plant relocation and maintenance, fire protection, and metal fabrication. Our projects are often in industrial and heavy commercial environments such as manufacturing facilities, automotive plants, chemical plants, distribution centers, warehouses, data centers, and other large facilities.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Valorx

Valorx enables revenue teams to work with Salesforce data in the way they actually want to—in a spreadsheet-like environment.

Our products, including Fusion
, bring Salesforce data into familiar spreadsheet workflows while enabling teams to work with, analyze, and manage their data more efficiently.

As we continue to grow our Professional Services organization, we are looking for a Technical Project Manager
who can manage multiple client engagements simultaneously, work closely with technical and consulting teams, and ensure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.

About The Role

As a Technical Project Manager – Professional Services
, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of multiple client projects involving Valorx Fusion
, implementation, consulting, integrations, configuration, support, and technical services.

This role is ideal for someone who is a strong, hands-on Project Manager with a technical mindset
. You should be comfortable understanding technology, working with technical teams, communicating with clients, identifying risks, tracking dependencies, and keeping projects moving toward timely delivery.

You will typically manage 5–6 project/workstreams in parallel
, balancing client communication, internal coordination, project reporting, issue resolution, and delivery management.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery

Own the end-to-end delivery of multiple Professional Services projects simultaneously
Manage approximately 5–6 concurrent projects/workstreams across different stages of delivery
Define project scope, milestones, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and responsibilities
Develop and maintain detailed project plans and delivery schedules
Track project progress and proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and according to agreed requirements
Coordinate resources across technical, consulting, support, and customer-facing teams
Drive projects forward and ensure action items are completed on time

Client Communication & Consulting

Act as a primary point of contact for project-related communication with clients
Lead project kickoff meetings, status meetings, requirement discussions, and regular project reviews
Clearly communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable project plans
Build strong relationships with customers and ensure expectations are clearly managed
Handle project escalations professionally and drive issues toward resolution

Technical & Product Coordination

Develop a strong understanding of Valorx Fusion, Salesforce, data workflows, integrations, and related technical processes
Work closely with technical consultants, engineers, and support teams to understand technical requirements and solutions
Be comfortable discussing technical concepts with engineers and explaining technical topics to customers
Understand integrations, data flows, configurations, APIs, Salesforce concepts, and troubleshooting at a practical level
Coordinate Fusion implementation, configuration, support, and consulting activities
Help identify technical dependencies and potential delivery risks early in the project

Reporting & Governance

Maintain accurate project documentation, status reports, timelines, and action trackers
Provide regular reporting to leadership on project health, progress, risks, and upcoming milestones
Track project KPIs, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements
Ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into project status
Escalate risks and blockers proactively rather than waiting for deadlines to be missed

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve Professional Services project delivery processes
Establish and maintain project management best practices, templates, and workflows
Help create repeatable processes for Fusion implementation and customer support engagements
Continuously improve project planning, communication, reporting, and delivery efficiency

What We're Looking For

4–5+ years of Project Management experience, preferably in a technology, SaaS, consulting, implementation, or professional services environment
Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously—ideally 5+ concurrent projects or workstreams
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, planning, scheduling, risk management, and delivery governance
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills
Technically curious and comfortable working with technology and technical teams
Ability to understand technical requirements, integrations, data flows, and software products
Experience working with Salesforce or CRM platforms is highly desirable
Experience with SaaS implementations, software consulting, customer support, or technical services is a strong plus
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
Ability to prioritize and manage competing deadlines across multiple projects
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment
Proactive mindset—you identify problems early and drive them toward resolution
Strong ownership and accountability for project outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, Scrum Master, or other relevant project management certification
Experience with Salesforce implementations or Salesforce-related projects
Experience working with APIs, integrations, data migration, automation, or SaaS platforms
Experience managing technical consulting or Professional Services engagements

Why Join Valorx?

At Valorx, you will work at the intersection of Salesforce, data, spreadsheets, AI, and enterprise software
. You will have the opportunity to work directly with customers and technical teams while helping build and improve a growing Professional Services organization.

If you are a strong Project Manager who is also technically minded, highly organized, client-focused, and comfortable taking ownership of complex technology projects
, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Systems Engineering, Global
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.

At Nscale, our Global Data Centre Systems Engineering team designs, standardises, and scales the systems that keep our data centres running at peak performance. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

Nscale is hiring a Technical Program Manager to drive strategic, cross-functional initiatives within Global Data Centre Systems Engineering. This role combines program management, process engineering, and business analysis to turn operational needs into clear, measurable delivery plans and scalable solutions.

You will connect data centre infrastructure teams with partner functions across Nscale, leading discovery, defining requirements, coordinating delivery, and communicating progress and business value for initiatives with senior leadership visibility.

Experience required: 5+ years in technical program management, project management, PMO operations, business analysis, or program coordination within infrastructure, industrial, hardware-intensive, or similarly complex environments.

What You'll be Doing

Lead strategic initiatives. Own cross-functional work across analytics, metrics, data integrations, operational tooling, and systems engineering initiatives.
Own delivery discipline. Plan and govern scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, stakeholder communications, and measurable outcomes.
Lead discovery and assessment. Run cross-functional sessions to understand business needs, operational pain points, process gaps, and technical requirements; assess current-state workflows and recommend practical future-state options.
Translate needs into execution. Define clear business and system requirements, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and delivery plans.
Engineer scalable processes. Create and maintain process maps, workflow diagrams, swim lanes, systems diagrams, and other visual documentation; facilitate walkthroughs to confirm alignment.
Standardise where it matters. Promote harmonised standards, validation practices, and documentation while accounting for site-specific operational requirements.
Coordinate the full lifecycle. Guide initiatives from discovery and requirements through implementation, adoption, and operational handoff.
Communicate progress and value. Develop technical and executive-ready reporting that makes progress, risks, decisions, outcomes, and business value clear.
Maintain operational rigour. Apply relevant software development lifecycle methodologies.

About You

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, PMO operations, business analysis, or program coordination within infrastructure, industrial, hardware-intensive, or similarly complex environments.
Experience delivering projects using waterfall, hybrid, and agile methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through implementation and operational adoption.
Strong expertise in requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, business and systems documentation, process mapping, and gap analysis.
Hands-on experience with project and work management tools such as Planview, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms, and diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, Figma, Visio, or mind-mapping software, with the ability to quickly learn Nscale's tools.
Strong organisational skills and sound judgement when managing multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Comfort working with KPI and SLA data to identify trends, surface insights, and support decision-making.
Ability to build consensus and maintain effective working relationships across organisational boundaries.
Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed.

Nice to Have

An advanced degree in a relevant field.
Professional certification such as PMP, SAFe, or a comparable program, project, or agile credential.
Experience with Lean or Six Sigma.
Experience supporting executive communications and decision-making forums.
Experience in data centre infrastructure, operational technology, or large-scale infrastructure delivery environments.

Why this role matters

Your success will be measured by the impact you have across our global data centre footprint, including:

Documented, understood, and adopted workflows for priority systems engineering processes and systems.
Improved program delivery discipline, including project management compliance and timely risk and dependency escalation.
Cohesive views and presentations that support better operational and leadership decisions.
Reduced redundant tooling and broader availability of governed, quality-scored data for critical assets.
Clear translation of technical delivery progress into measurable business impact for leadership.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.

jobs.description:
UDR is seeking an organized, technically fluent Project Manager to lead technology deployments across our multi-family portfolio. This is a highly visible opportunity to deliver the property technology behind resident experience and community operations, from perimeter access control and security camera systems to smart home and related security infrastructure.

You will be the person who brings clarity to complex work: keeping vendors, property teams, and internal IT aligned, managing dependencies and timelines, surfacing risks early, and ensuring leadership has a clear view of project health and outcomes. While our vendors and internal IT teams

lead technical design and installation, you will move the work forward with structure, communication, and strong follow-through.

This is a project delivery role, not a security administration, security operations, or facilities operations role. You are a professional project manager first.

Salary Range: $98,761.00/yr. – $116,189.00/yr. + eligible for 10% annual bonus potential

What You'll Do

Own project delivery across a portfolio of concurrent technology initiatives spanning perimeter access, security camera systems, and smart home technologies; accountable for project outcomes while vendors and internal IT teams retain ownership of technical design and installation.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and status reports that conform to IT's standard project methodology; drive delivery accountability across teams and escalate scope, schedule, budget, or risk issues to appropriate decision-makers in a timely manner.
Serve as the primary coordination point between internal teams and third-party vendors; manage vendor timelines, facilitate SOW and change order reviews, and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
Build and maintain stakeholder relationships across all levels, from property teams and technical leads to senior leadership; deliver proactive status reporting on milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues, and support steering committee and monthly project reviews as needed.
Support feasibility studies, vendor selection, and proposal evaluation; coordinate testing phases and help stakeholders evaluate outcomes.
Develop and report metrics to track project status and measure success.
Maintain central project repositories and documentation standards; contribute to the ongoing development of IT PMO practices, templates, and tools.
Perform other duties as assigned or as necessary.

What You'll Bring

Four to six years of successful project management experience, ideally in IT infrastructure, construction/technology deployment, low-voltage systems, network rollouts, or similar technical project environments. UDR, Inc. — Project Manager II – Property Technology
PMP certification or a demonstrated background working within structured project delivery environments, including formal methodologies, portfolio governance, and PMO practices.
A Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems Management, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field; an equivalent blend of education and experience is also welcome.
Strong vendor management experience: able to review SOWs and change orders, hold vendors accountable to deliverables, and manage multi-vendor coordination.
Demonstrated experience with mainstream project management tools such as Trello, Jira, Planview, or Microsoft Project.
Comfort participating in technical conversations, asking smart questions, identifying understated risks or dependencies, and translating complex concepts for property teams and business stakeholders. This is a project leadership role rather than a hands-on technical role.
Familiarity with IoT technology, property technology, or physical security principles is a plus.
A practical, thoughtful approach to using AI productivity tools to strengthen reporting, documentation, and workflow efficiency.
Experience with Agile, waterfall, and hybrid project methodologies.
Excellent written and oral communication skills: able to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals, and to present clearly to top management, vendors, and project staff.

What Makes You Successful

You know how to lead through influence. You are equally comfortable partnering with technical vendors, property teams, business leaders, and you know that strong project management is not just about maintaining a plan; it is about creating alignment, building trust, and helping people make

progress through ambiguity.

You are proactive, steady under pressure, and naturally curious. You can zoom into the details when an install is at risk, then zoom back out to give leadership a clear, concise view of what matters most. You know when to determine whether a task should be attempted, how to prepare for unexpected

difficulties, and how to delegate effectively to meet deadlines and deliver on commitments within budget.

Work Environment

This is a hybrid position with regular in-office collaboration each week. Occasional travel to properties may be required but is not a regular part of the role; site visits may involve exposure to outside elements. Occasional evening or weekend work may occur around key installs, cutovers, or go-lives.

The opportunity

The Enterprise Security Program is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, global information security initiatives across EY. This Assistant Director role is designed for a project leader who can connect strategy to execution, bring together cross-functional teams, and drive outcomes that reduce enterprise risk while supporting business value and operational resilience.

The role sits within Information Security and will support the Enterprise Security Program’s Information Security Management Services Team. It requires strong leadership without direct authority, clear executive communication, and the ability to coordinate across Information Security, Member Firms, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead complex global information security programs and projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring scope, plans, milestones, risks, budgets and outcomes are actively managed.
Translate enterprise security objectives into clear execution plans that support business value, measurable benefits and risk reduction.
Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams across Information Security, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, Member Firms, vendors and contractors.

Technical and security knowledge: Understanding of information security technologies, including cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint and data security, along with familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls.
Project management depth: Proven ability to manage complex information security projects, including iterative and waterfall delivery methods, planning, budget management, risk management and stakeholder governance.

Executive communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical matters for non-technical stakeholders and present concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership.
Stakeholder engagement: Ability to engage executive leadership and key stakeholders, understand competing priorities and negotiate alignment at multiple levels of the organization.
Risk and issue management: Ability to anticipate delivery risks, assess business impact, make timely recommendations and drive mitigation through structured plans.
Problem solving: Strong analytical thinking, critical judgment, creativity and conflict-resolution skills in time-sensitive or ambiguous situations.
Global mindset: Comfort operating across cultures, geographies, Member Firms and organizational structures, including awareness of political, regulatory and commercial factors that may affect delivery.

To qualify for the role you must have

Proven experience leading complex global information security, technology or risk-related programs from initiation to closure.
Strong understanding of information security technologies and operating environments, including cloud, network, endpoint, messaging and data security domains.
Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets and executive reporting for complex initiatives.
Knowledge of security frameworks, standards and risk management methodologies, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or comparable frameworks.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, including preparing clear status updates, recommendations and escalation materials.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive outcomes through influence, structure and accountability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics in business terms.
Experience identifying interdependencies across other programs, operational timelines, business cycles and organizational priorities.
Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.

Experience with project management and delivery platforms such as MS Project, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
Experience supporting compliance, privacy or regulatory requirements, including Privacy Impact Assessments and GDPR-related considerations.
Experience improving security processes, practices and governance models in a global enterprise environment.
Experience supporting security initiatives that align to business strategy, operational resilience and measurable risk reduction.
Familiarity with vendor and contractor coordination in support of complex technology or security programs.

What We Look For

We are looking for a seasoned Information Security project leader who can bring structure to complexity, communicate with clarity, and deliver outcomes through influence. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior leaders, global teams and diverse stakeholders; will be able to connect security priorities to business value; and will lead with accountability, sound judgment and a strong focus on execution. This role requires someone who can remain steady during ambiguity, encourage collaboration during challenges, and keep teams aligned to a shared set of goals.

Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

Etsy is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Project Manager. As a Project Manager within our Operations Team, you will play a key role in coordinating the activities and timelines of small to medium-scale campaigns and channel support projects. You will manage the execution of specific project components, ensuring they align with overall project goals and are completed on time and within budget. Your role will involve monitoring project progress, identifying potential issues, and addressing day-to-day project challenges. Effective communication with stakeholders and setting clear expectations will be crucial to your success. This is a full-time position reporting to the Director of Brand Operations.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Our team inspires collaboration, structure, and process to bring creative ideas to life on time and under budget. All the while, we are passionate about Etsy’s mission to keep commerce human, and that passion drives everything we do.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Skills

The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating the successful execution of small to medium-scale projects across various marketing channels. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the achievement of strategic goals and to develop your project management skills in a supportive environment. If you join us, here are some of the other things you’ll do:

Project Planning & Execution:
Coordinate project activities and timelines, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule.
Manage the execution of specific project components, aligning with the overall project plan.
Monitor project progress, identify potential issues, and address them promptly.
Communicate with stakeholders to provide updates, set expectations, and resolve day-to-day project issues.
Assist in facilitating meetings and presentations to ensure clear communication of project goals and progress.

Operational Support:
Contribute to process improvements related to your workstream, helping to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

:

You have 4+ years of experience in Marketing and Creative Operations, Project Management, or Production.

Proficiency in project management software and tools is a plus.

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience.

Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries.

Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms, and automation.

For more information, please visit solera.com.

THE ROLE

As a Project Manager, you will:

Responsible for successful delivery of multiple complex initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams and resources to achieve milestones within established timeframes
Will be accountable for and directly manage critical Programs and Projects, coordinate logistics and resources, conduct planning and working sessions, and build lasting relationships to meet Project objectives.

Collaboratively define the scope of work, identify appropriate resources, set goals, develop schedules, and track and report progress while ensuring the overall approach is refined and communicated to stakeholders.
Establish, continually manage, and communicate with Project stakeholders and Executive and Senior Management regarding project expectations, and provide reporting insights on issues through root cause analyses

Effective Communication: Communicate proactively, effectively, and efficiently while presenting ideas clearly and persuasively to all organization levels. Excellent verbal and written communication (English)
Detail Oriented: at every level, the details do matter; unequivocally skilled in accounting for and confirming critical details; competent in identifying critical follow-up and drill-down questions even when you are not expected to be the technical subject matter expert
Risk Management: Work with stakeholders to identify potential problems, create mitigation plans, and minimize risk to project timelines
Process Improvement: Increase delivery success by iteratively improving existing or developing new artifacts and processes across programs and the PMO. Apply the proper balance of creating value versus diminishing returns to increase efficiency, repeatability, alignment, control, documentation, reporting, and the capture of details critical to team success.
Facilitating Solutions: Discern objective information to address issues, including documenting the impact and utilization of the PMO escalation process; collaboratively problem-solve and adapt to achieve objective
Training Competency: mentoring peers as determined by growth and delegation, skilled at logically documenting processes and artifacts for ease of use by others, comfortable and professional in providing feedback and course re-direction to peers

jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager – Space Operations (TS/SCI Required)

Salary:
$200,000-$250,000
Location:
Onsite in Grand Forks, ND (current or open to relocate)

About the Role

MapLarge is looking for a Technical Program Manager to be our on-the-ground lead in Grand Forks, ND. You will work alongside the operators who run satellite constellations and ground systems for the national security space mission.

You will be the bridge between those operators and MapLarge engineering. That means understanding how operators task satellites and use the data that comes back, and turning those needs into requirements, demos and delivered capability on our geospatial analytics platform.

This is a customer-embedded role for someone who knows the space mission, can hold their own in a technical discussion and wants to help build a program from the ground up. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. Beyond running the program, you will shape solution architecture, guide engineering decisions and bring modern, AI-assisted delivery practices to a classified mission program.

About MapLarge

Since 2009, MapLarge’s rapidly growing software platform has enabled federal governments and Fortune 1000 enterprises to develop, scale, and deploy mission-critical applications. Trusted by the world's most sophisticated organizations, our enterprise platform for geospatial analytics and visualization automates decision intelligence and offers a distinct decision advantage. We build cutting-edge products for large enterprises and government agencies that appreciate innovation. If you enjoy working with talented teammates to solve complex challenges, we'd love for you to join us.

Responsibilities

Build trusted relationships with operators and ground operations teams in Grand Forks
Manage program milestones, risks and deliverables on site
Translate operator needs into clear requirements for MapLarge engineering
Shape solution architecture and system design for mission applications on the MapLarge platform, working directly with our engineers and architects
Coordinate classified (high-side) integration with engineering and DevOps
Lead demos, pilots and proofs of concept for operators and leadership
Support RFI, RFP and proposal responses
Coordinate with commercial data partners and prime contractors
Identify new mission opportunities for business development

Requirements

Active TS/SCI clearance
Local to Grand Forks, ND or willing to relocate
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related field is required.
Authorized to work in the United States and no visa sponsorship required.
7+ years managing technical programs that delivered complex software, at least 5 of them in DoD or the Intelligence Community (IC).
Technical depth:
a hands-on software engineering or architecture background, ideally with C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Azure or AWS, and CI/CD. You can drive architecture discussions, solution design and technical decisions with customers and engineers.
Space mission experience:
direct experience with satellite operations, ground systems or space programs. This can be operational (Space Force, Air Force space operations) or program/contractor side.
Customer-facing:
comfortable working directly with operators, program offices and senior leaders, and managing expectations on high-value programs.

Nice to Have

Experience with proliferated low-Earth-orbit (LEO) constellations, satellite tasking and collection management, or ground segment operations.
Familiarity with sensor and intelligence data types such as radar, radio frequency (RF), moving target indicator (MTI) and imagery.
Experience with tactical data links or getting space-based data to warfighters.
Experience with real-time data systems, distributed computing or high-performance visualization.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, responsible AI guardrails or spec-driven engineering.
Experience coordinating across multiple engineering disciplines (web, backend, cloud, DevOps, data).
Experience delivering software in classified cloud environments.
Proposal and capture experience: leading or drafting proposal sections, alone or as part of a larger team.
Existing relationships within the space operations community.

Cultural Fit

While we hire all kinds of people and invent roles to fit them, there are four key traits we require of every team member that really define our team.
Fun to Work With
- Life is short and work should be fun.
Smart
- We work on cutting-edge hard problems. We need people who are quick learners, can anticipate needs, and solve problems independently while working with an intelligent peer group.
Passionate & Proactive
- We need people who really love their work and exhibit the energy and creativity that comes from being fully engaged in what you do.
Adaptable -
We hire team members for specific roles, but we expect adaptability as the business needs change and evolve.

Benefits

Competitive salary and 401K
Unlimited PTO
Top-notch health care
Family friendly
100% remote flexibility
Cutting-edge tech with an A+ team solving complex, meaningful problems
Collaborative, intelligent, positive, and supportive team culture

jobs.description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

TEAM

At Woven by Toyota (WbyT), the AD/ADAS Project Management Team enables the successful delivery of engineering technology that advances the company’s business goals. As a strategic partner to WbyT’s Engineering and Product functions, the Project Management team leads the technical execution of the AD/ADAS portfolio, maintains the organization’s plan of record, and drives the velocity and agility of a highly cross-functional engineering organization distributed across multiple global locations.

Our team members come from a mix of Autonomy, off-board ecosystem, hardware and vehicle backgrounds but we all share a common drive to enable the delivery of complex and safe autonomous engineering products to the world. We are problem solvers who make things happen by setting and communicating clear goals and supporting engineering teams to deliver through the technical and organizational complexity.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Staff Technical Program Manager to contribute to Woven’s Active Learning Loop program that enables the continuous improvement of our autonomous driving stack across data pipelines, ML training, simulation, validation, and deployment.

The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, engaging with senior leadership, and driving cross-functional programs across distributed, global teams with minimal direction. You are motivated by the challenge of bringing complex technology platforms to production and have a strong instinct for connecting technical execution to business outcomes.

This role demands proficiency in data and cloud infrastructure, machine learning platform systems, tools, simulation, and validation workflows. Additionally, it requires strong cross-functional communication skills and a data-driven strategy to enhance engineering speed and cost efficiency.

Responsibilities

Own and drive complex cross-functional programs across Data and cloud infrastructure, ML Platform, simulation and validation, with a focus on improving development throughput and cost efficiency.
Drive cloud cost management across the ALL program by tracking and reporting on data storage, compute, and ML training spend, identifying cost drivers, and partnering with engineering leads to define and execute cost reduction initiatives
Define project scope, milestones, and success metrics for platform capabilities, explicitly tying them to developer productivity, iteration speed, test throughput, and safety validation timelines, and aligning outcomes with the broader autonomy roadmap.
Create and maintain an integrated project plan of record (sprint, quarter, year) that unifies platform team roadmaps into a single execution and risk-management view, with clear critical paths to autonomy feature readiness and validation gates.
Lead cross-functional planning and high-velocity execution across the Active Learning Loop program, proactively resolving dependencies and blockers, and driving timely, evidence-based decisions.
Identify and resolve systemic issues in the development workflow, and continuously evolve TPM practices, including mentoring other TPMs focused on autonomy efficiency and validation outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

6+ years program/project management experience within a software, automotive, aerospace, robotics, or mobility-related industry.
Familiarity with the ML development ecosystem, including data pipelines, training workflows, simulation, or offline validation infrastructure.
Experience managing cloud infrastructure costs, including data storage and compute, within a large-scale engineering environment.
Proven track record of leading large cross-functional programs to successful delivery spanning organizations of 100+ stakeholders.
Experience driving technical programs in ambiguity with high-level direction across distributed teams and diverse business cultures.
Experience establishing and evolving program operations and decision-making structures adapting to team culture and operating constraints.

NICE TO HAVES

Experience in Autonomous Vehicle projects, Automotive, or OEM/Tier-1 environments
Experience in the development of autonomy features for L2/L4 systems
Proficiency in Business level Japanese
PMP/PMI or other Project Management certifications are welcome

What We Offer

We are committed to creating a modern work environment that supports our employees and their loved ones. We offer many options of the best programs to allow you to do your most meaningful work and to help you shape the future of mobility.

・Excellent health, wellness, dental and vision coverage

・A rewarding 401k program

・Flexible vacation policy

・Family planning and care benefits

Our Commitment

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager 
Who We Are
We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.
We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager
to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).
What You'll Do
As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. The Sr. Program Manager reports to the Program Director (or Group Program Director) and will manage Associates and/or Managers. The Sr. PM partners with the Business Supervisor or Business Director to run most Tier 1 or 2 projects. 
Responsibilities
Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.
Drive the end-to-end process for integrated campaigns (film, experiential, digital/social, OOH), ensuring seamless delivery on time and on budget by developing and tracking tactical plans to develop each with a keen understanding of client parameters and objectives. Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules
Partner with Business Leadership counterpart to develop all scope proposals for assigned projects, developing a compelling proposal as well as profitable approach for the agency
Provide strong financial management of assigned accounts including managing all budget allocations, reviewing burn, proactively creating scope change orders (internal and external), proactively suggesting areas for optimization and macro view of out-of-pocket budget tracking
Lead all reporting and reconciliation processes in partnership with finance team 
Help digest all client feedback and lead the team on how we address and action the feedback. Understand and mentor teams on where/when to escalate creative feedback or work reviews to senior leadership 
Build and nurture strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor who understands how to get things done effectively and efficiently leveraging our teams and resources to create innovative and breakthrough creative solutions that solve clients business objectives 
Manage and mentor junior program managers, strategically deploying them across projects and fostering their professional growth.
Collaborate with department leads (account, production, creative, strategy) to assemble the right teams for each initiative, confirm the right allocations and manage overall workforce planning with Resource Management lead
Work closely with production to ensure timelines accommodate production requirements and projects continue to move seamlessly in execution 
Support the Business Lead and Production teams during executional and production phases of creative work to ensure absolute clarity client & media requirements, provide tactical support during production and oversee the successful delivery/traffic assets when required 
Partner with Creative, Production, and Business teams to turn campaign ideas into actionable plans, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track without compromising creative ambition.
Manage and monitor production and creative workflows, proactively identifying risks and driving solutions to keep projects moving smoothly.
Foster clear, integrated ways of working by aligning teams on roles, processes, and communication throughout the creative and production lifecycle.
Proactively identify potential issues or opportunities, keeping teams and clients informed and driving swift, effective solutions.
Oversee the creation of presentation materials that uphold agency standards and resonate with clients’ business objectives.
Participate in new business efforts, contributing to proposals, pitches, and strategic planning to showcase our operational strengths and capabilities
Champion a positive, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, accountability, and a shared passion for producing culturally powerful work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex ideas clearly, accurately, and persuasively.
Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.
Highly organized with exceptional time management and prioritization abilities, balancing multiple workstreams with quality and care.
Passionate about people and culture, with a results-driven approach balanced by genuine curiosity and sensitivity to team dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications
5–7 years of experience managing large-scale brands or programs within a creative agency or related communications environment.
Proven ability to build strong client partnerships that drive long-term growth and mutual success.
Demonstrated expertise managing multi-disciplinary teams across creative, production, and strategy disciplines.
Solid understanding of financial principles as they relate to agency scopes, budgets, and P&L impact.
Experience leading strategic and day-to-day client communications, as well as mentoring junior team members.
Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns, including digital, social, print, and broadcast production.
Comfortable with Google Suite (Sheets and Slides); experience with Monday.com or SmartSheets is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telco or retail categories, or in performance marketing environments.
Background in managing cross-functional agency partners and leading collaborative workstreams.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.
UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

$95,000 - $115,000
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

About Blue Water Thinking

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

Job Description:

The Deployment Project Manager supports healthcare technology management (HTM) work associated with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Federal Electronic Health Record Modernization (FEHRM) program. This role coordinates simultaneous deployment projects and workstreams across multiple VA medical centers. The Project Manager works directly with national, regional, and site-level Biomedical Engineering and clinical teams, technical teams, third-party vendors, and program management offices across the VA enterprise.

Successful candidates bring recent, practical experience with medical devices, facility HTM operations, or healthcare technology implementation, along with strong project coordination skills. They can follow a technical discussion, identify an unresolved issue, ask questions to understand its impact, and turn that information into a clear status update or escalation for leadership.

Travel associated with this role will consist of being away for about a week every 2 months*

Responsibilities:

Ability to coordinate HTM deployment schedules, site dependencies, equipment and interface readiness, testing activities, and go-live preparation across multiple VA facilities.
Track project milestones, risks, decisions, and action items; identify how unresolved issues may affect in-flight work or deployment readiness.
Work with facility HTM, clinical teams, Oracle Health, vendors, and program stakeholders to clarify ownership, deliverables, and milestone status.
Participate actively in technical and operational discussions. Ask focused follow-up questions when information is incomplete or conflicting, and track issues through resolution.
Escalate concerns with a clear explanation of the issue, its potential impact, the decision needed, and the next steps.
Prepare status reports, executive summaries, briefings, and meeting documentation that accurately capture decisions, owners, and follow-up actions.
Support planning and coordination through readiness, testing, deployment, and post-deployment follow-up.
Work within applicable VHA processes, federal requirements, and healthcare technology practices

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and at least 5 years relevant professional experience.
Recent, practical experience in a hospital HTM department, medical device or imaging company, healthcare technology deployment, or a comparable field-based environment.
Experience coordinating projects or complex work across technical, clinical, vendor, and leadership stakeholders.
Working familiarity with medical devices and facility HTM activities sufficient to understand the work being tracked and recognize readiness concerns.
Ability to identify the project implications of technical issues and communicate them clearly to technical teams and leadership.
Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting VHA operations or a multi-facility EHR deployment.
Familiarity with Oracle Health Cerner Millennium or VA FEHRM.
Experience coordinating medical device integration, equipment readiness, testing, or go-live activities.
Familiarity with HTM equipment inventory or computerized maintenance management systems.
Familiarity with applicable healthcare regulatory requirements and standards.
Experience using tools, including AI-assisted tools, to improve documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.

Eligibility Requirements:

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal public trust clearance.

Compensation:

Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies and experience, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. The proposed salary range for this position is outlined below.

Salary range:
$95,000 - $125,000

Blue Water Thinking offers a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance (medical, dental and vision), paid time off, federal holidays, and matching 401K plan.

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager / Delivery Lead to lead the end-to-end execution and coordination of a large-scale Android platform modernization and application migration program for a next-generation In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) platform. The program involves Android operating system migration, hardware platform bring-up, middleware modernization, passenger, crew and maintenance application porting, integration, verification, Android compatibility qualification, release readiness, and customer acceptance support.

The Program Manager will serve as the primary delivery coordination lead responsible for planning, execution governance, schedule management, dependency tracking, risk mitigation, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and alignment across multiple engineering workstreams. The role will work closely with customer stakeholders, architects, engineering leads, verification teams, DevOps teams, and release management teams to ensure successful delivery of program objectives while maintaining schedule, quality, and reporting commitments.

This role is primarily focused on program execution, delivery governance, and cross-functional coordination, rather than hands-on software development.

Key Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution
Own overall program execution for Android platform and application migration activities.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering platform bring-up, middleware migration, application migration, integration, verification, compliance testing, and release readiness activities.
Define milestones, delivery phases, checkpoints, dependencies, entry criteria, and exit criteria.
Establish governance processes for tracking scope, schedule, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
Coordinate work across distributed onsite and offshore engineering teams.
Ensure alignment between technical execution plans and customer program objectives.
Support program onboarding, resource ramp-up, and capacity planning activities.
Monitor project health and drive corrective actions where schedule or technical risks emerge.
Delivery Coordination
Coordinate delivery activities across multiple engineering domains including:
Android Platform & BSP
Middleware & Platform Services
Passenger Applications
Crew Applications
Maintenance Applications
Build & Release Engineering
Test Automation
System Integration
Android Compatibility & Compliance
Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions and execution reviews.
Ensure technical teams are synchronized regarding deliverables, interfaces, integration points, and release schedules.
Manage dependency tracking across platform, middleware, application, and test teams.
Ensure timely closure of action items affecting project milestones.
Schedule Management
Create and maintain detailed project schedules and integrated master plans.
Track progress against committed milestones and delivery objectives.
Manage sprint, release, and milestone-level schedules.
Conduct schedule variance analysis and develop recovery plans when required.
Identify critical path items and escalation triggers.
Monitor resource allocation and project throughput against planned timelines.
Drive milestone readiness assessments before major releases or integration events.
Risk, Issue & Impediment Management
Maintain program-level risk and issue registers.
Proactively identify technical, schedule, resource, infrastructure, and dependency risks.
Facilitate risk mitigation planning and execution.
Coordinate root-cause analysis for major delivery challenges.
Escalate issues requiring leadership intervention.
Track mitigation actions through closure.
Remove execution impediments impacting engineering productivity and delivery commitments.
Coordinate resolution of environment, infrastructure, access, integration, and test setup issues.

Act as primary delivery interface for customer and leadership stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
12+ years of software engineering, embedded systems, or technology program management experience.
Minimum 5+ years managing large-scale software development programs.
Experience leading complex platform migration or modernization programs.
Strong project and program management experience involving globally distributed teams.
Proven experience managing multi-stream deliveries involving development, integration, testing, and release teams.
Demonstrated success driving execution in schedule-sensitive environments.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Experience with risk management, dependency management, and escalation management.
Excellent organizational, leadership, negotiation, and facilitation skills.

Experience with Android platform development programs.
Experience with AOSP, BSP, embedded Linux, or Android-based product development.
Experience in:
In-Flight Entertainment (IFE)
Aerospace systems
Automotive Infotainment
Consumer Electronics
Connected Products

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Senior Engineering Program Manager

Careers That Change Lives

Help shape the future of a transformative therapy. The Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) Operating Unit is seeking an accomplished, high-impact Quality Core Team Member (QCTM) to lead Quality for the next-generation Renal Denervation (RDN) platform—one of ICT’s highest-priority innovation programs. Positioned at the intersection of strategy, product development, and execution, you will influence critical business and technical decisions, mobilize cross-functional partners, and help bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.

This position is on-site 4 days per week at the Mounds View, MN campus as the Quality lead on a cross-functional new product development team within the Coronary & Renal Denervation (CRDN) operating unit. This role will require less than 10% travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

We believe that when people from different cultures, genders, and points of view come together, innovation is the result—and everyone wins. Medtronic walks the walk, creating an inclusive culture where you can thrive.

A Day in the Life

A Senior Engineering Program Manager
leading the Quality team will:

Lead the Quality strategy for a high-priority new product development program, translating PDP milestones into an actionable plan that proactively manages timelines, dependencies, technical risks, and resource needs.
Serve as the Quality voice on the Core Team, partnering across Research & Development, Clinical, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Project Management Office, and Operations to shape strategies that advance quality, compliance, patient safety, and customer impact.
Drive key Quality-owned technical deliverables that support product development, including Risk Management, Design Verification, and Design Transfer, while ensuring strong alignment across engineering, regulatory, and manufacturing partners.
Use program metrics and risk indicators to monitor Quality performance, communicate progress, and drive timely mitigation plans with Quality and program leadership.
Influence cross-functional execution by clearly communicating priorities, progress, risks, and key decisions to technical teams, Quality leaders, and senior stakeholders.

Product development and program delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead Quality planning and execution within large, complex PDP programs, translating technical milestones into clear priorities, integrated workstreams, risk-based decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Capital equipment and systems expertise: Strong understanding of complex system-level product development, including the integration of software, hardware, mechanical design, and clinical or user needs in a regulated medical device environment.
Cross-functional leadership: Ability to lead through influence across engineering, quality, regulatory, clinical, manufacturing, and supply chain partners, building alignment and driving decisions in a matrixed, global environment.

Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or math and a minimum of 7 years of technical work experience; or an advanced degree in science, technology, engineering, or math with 5 years of technical experience.

Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional product development initiatives from strategy through execution, with the ability to drive alignment, manage risks, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Experience influencing and collaborating across geographically distributed teams, with the ability to build strong partnerships across functions, sites, and leadership levels.
Experience working in highly regulated environments and supporting new product development in alignment with global quality system and regulatory expectations.
