jobs.description:
K&K Global Talent Solutions Inc.
is an international recruiting agency that has been providing technical resources in the Canada and the USA region since 1993.
This position is with one of our clients in USA, who is actively hiring candidates to expand their teams.

Job Title: Program Manager with Quote to Cash & Finance M&A Integration

Location:
San Jose, CA/onsite

Position Type: Full time/Permanent role

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced contract Program Manager to lead program governance, execution, and delivery for the Quote to Cash (QTC) and Finance workstream of a strategic Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) integration initiative. This role contributes to the end-to-end program plan, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline required to integrate an acquired company's business processes and systems into the existing CRM and SAP ERP platform landscape.
You will partner closely with the QTC & Finance Product Manager, Sales Operations, Finance, IT, Engineering, and the acquired company's stakeholders to build the program roadmap, manage governance and reporting, drive risk and dependency management, and ensure a seamless, compliant, and minimally disruptive transition onto the platform. This is an execution and delivery leadership role that complements the Product Manager's ownership of requirements, scope, and functional design.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain the end-to-end program timeline for the QTC and Finance M&A integration workstream, from discovery through go-live, hypercare, and decommissioning of transition state.
Partner with BPO/PMO leadership, the Product Manager, Engineering, and business stakeholders to translate the vision, scope, and gap analysis for QTC and Finance integration into a structured program plan with clear milestones and deliverables.
Engage with SAP FI/CO, SD, and CRM (Microsoft Dynamics) functional and technical teams to estimate level of effort, sequencing, and feasibility of delivery for quoting, pricing, order booking, invoicing, revenue recognition, collections, and financial close workstreams.
Establish and run program governance, including meeting cadence and artifacts such as Scrum of Scrums, Steering Committee/Operating Committee, RAID logs, Wiki/SharePoint repositories, and integrated project schedules tailored to the M&A integration timeline.
Coordinate data migration, integration, and cutover planning across customer, contract, pricing, product, and financial master data workstreams, ensuring alignment with dual-run/parallel processing and business continuity requirements.
Manage the cross-workstream dependency map across Order Management, Billing, Tax, and other M&A integration workstreams, proactively identifying and resolving conflicts, blockers, and resourcing gaps.
Drive execution and monitoring by tracking progress against the plan, managing scope, schedule, and budget trade-offs, escalating risks and issues, and ensuring timely decision-making by sponsors and cross-functional leads.
Own program-level stakeholder communication and status reporting to the M&A Integration PMO.
Coordinate UAT scheduling and readiness, cutover/go-live planning, release communications, hypercare support, and post-go-live stabilization before disbanding the program team.
Support change management and training logistics to prepare acquired company employees and internal teams for the new platform and processes.
Ensure statutory, tax, revenue recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15), and audit requirements are reflected in the program plan and tracked to closure in partnership with Finance and Controllership.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience delivering complex, multi-functional technology programs, ideally with exposure to Finance/ERP platforms and M&A integration, carve-out, or platform consolidation projec ts.
Proven experience managing programs involving CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar) and SAP ERP, particularly SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) and SAP FI/CO (Finance & Controlling). SAP S/4HANA experience preferred.
Solid working knowledge of end-to-end Quote to Cash processes, including pricing/CPQ, contract management, order booking, billing/invoicing, revenue recognition, collections, cash application, and core finance and accounting principles such as ASC 606/IFRS 15, tax, and statutory reporting.
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams of business and technical resources and coordinating data migration and system cutover planning for customer, product, pricing, and financial master data.
Strong command of program governance tools and practices, including RAID logs, integrated schedules, steering committee reporting, backlog and dependency tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, Aha!, or similar), and process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart).
Experience with Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models typical of large enterprise integration programs, and the ability to apply the appropriate methodology based on program needs.
Exceptional stakeholder management, executive presence, and verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence across Sales, Finance, IT, Engineering, and executive leadership.
Resourceful, self-motivated, and able to operate effectively and autonomously in ambiguous, time-sensitive environments while recognizing and escalating critical issues quickly.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field required; MBA is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience integrating an acquired company's CRM/ERP environment into a parent company's platform ecosystem.
Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, SAP CPQ, SAP Hybris Billing, and SAP Finance/Treasury.
Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-currency, and multi-country finance operations.
PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent Program Management certification.
Prior consulting experience with M&A integrations, divestitures, or enterprise CRM/ERP transformation programs.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
The QTC and Finance program plan is executed on schedule, with clear governance, risk visibility, and cross-workstream alignment throughout the M&A integration lifecycle.
Minimal business disruption during cutover, supported by clean data migration, validated financial reporting, and a well-managed hypercare period.
Strong cross-functional alignment and communication between Sales, Finance, IT, the Product Manager, and the acquired company's teams.
Transparent and well-maintained program artifacts, including RAID logs, project schedules, and status reporting, enabling timely decisions by sponsors and leadership.

Job Number: R0251307

Information Systems Security Manager

The Opportunity:

Department of War (DoW) information systems require continuous, disciplined oversight to stay authorized to operate and defensible against evolving threats. As a Senior Information System Security Manager (ISSM), you will own that oversight, serving as the principal cybersecurity authority for one or more system authorization packages across their full lifecycle.

You'll manage the RMF process end-to-end including categorizing systems, selecting and tailoring controls, overseeing assessment and authorization activities, and maintaining continuous monitoring posture after ATO. You'll supervise a team of ISSOs, assigning control families, reviewing their work, and consolidating it into authoritative packages in eMASS. You'll coordinate directly with Authorizing Officials (AO), Authorizing Official Designated Representatives (AODR), Security Control Assessors (SCA), and program leadership to resolve findings, manage POA&Ms, and drive packages to authorization on schedule.

This role combines technical depth in NIST SP 800-53, 800-37, and 800-137 with the leadership to run a compliance program. You'll set standards for documentation and artifact management, train and mentor ISSOs, and represent the security posture of your systems to senior stakeholders.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

6+ years of experience in cybersecurity compliance, information assurance, or IT security operations
Experience serving as an ISSM, ISSO, or RMF authorization role on DoD or DoW systems
Experience managing RMF Steps 1-6: Categorize through Authorize, and Step 7: Continuous Monitoring
Experience with eMASS, including authorization package development, control implementation statements, POA&M management, and artifact and evidence management
Experience supervising or mentoring ISSOs or junior compliance staff
Experience preparing systems for and supporting compliance audits, inspections, or assessments

TS/SCI clearance

Experience developing internal SOPs, naming conventions, or governance frameworks for artifact and control management
Experience with system boundary changes, categorization changes, or reauthorization packages
Experience hiring, interviewing, or building out a compliance team
Knowledge of cloud-hosted DoD systems, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Master's degree

Welcome to a better way, an authentic way. Welcome to Nature’s Way.

We believe that nature is the best way to holistic health, and it should be available to everyone.

Our customers trust:
Our products to be the gold standard
Our words to be true
Our claims to be honest,
Our actions to have integrity.

And we’ve been leading the way since 1969.

Be a part of helping people live healthy lives as our new Cybersecurity Manager.

SUMMARY

The Cybersecurity Manager leads the day-to-day execution and continual improvement of the enterprise Cyber Security program. This role manages security operations, vulnerability management, incident response, risk reduction, compliance and audit readiness, security awareness, third-party security services, and the operational use of Microsoft security capabilities. The manager works across IT, business teams, and service providers to implement security controls, coordinate remediation, improve detection and response workflows, and strengthen the organization’s security posture while supporting the broader security strategy established by the Director of Cyber Security and IT Operations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Lead execution and continual improvement of the enterprise Cyber Security program, translating security strategy, policies, standards, and priorities into operational plans.
Manage vulnerability management activities, including identification, prioritization, coordination of remediation, and reporting of technology risks.
Lead day-to-day security operations and monitoring, including investigation, escalation, response, documentation, and follow-up for security events and incidents.
Coordinate incident response activities across IT domains and business functions and support post-incident reviews and corrective actions.
Maintain audit and assessment readiness by coordinating documentation, evidence collection, control validation, findings response, and remediation tracking.
Support security risk assessments and third-party/vendor security reviews and coordinate mitigation of identified risks.
Partner with IT, Legal, Operations, Compliance, and other business teams on cross-functional security initiatives and remediation activities.
Promote security awareness and compliance through communication, education, and support of organization-wide security programs.
Support the implementation of Operation’s security capabilities such as identity and access management, privileged access, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and email/web security.
Own the implementation and operation of security capabilities such as logging and monitoring, SIEM/SOAR, and data protection.
Manage third-party security operations center (SOC) and other security service providers, including service levels, analyst performance, alert quality, portal access, escalation paths, incident coordination, actionable reporting, backup coverage, and continuous improvement.
Lead the design, development, testing, governance, and continual improvement of security incident response and remediation tools, workflows, automation rules, playbooks, integrations, and reporting to improve detection, triage, containment, recovery, and corrective action while minimizing unintended operational impact.
Oversee the operational configuration, integration, data quality, alerting, and policy alignment of Microsoft security capabilities, including Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview, and supporting data connectors.
Establish and govern least-privilege administrative access, privileged identity management, separate administrative accounts, role elevation, and access review practices for security and technology platforms.
Maintain and improve security policies, processes, procedures, standards, knowledge articles, incident records, and lessons learned to support consistent execution, audit readiness, and organizational knowledge.
Help establish and maintain secure configuration, patching, hardening, and technical control standards across infrastructure, applications, endpoints, and cloud environments.
Provide clear security metrics, risk information, recommendations, and status updates to IT leadership and relevant stakeholders.
Evaluate emerging threats, technologies, and security practices and recommend practical improvements.
Mentor and develop Cyber Security staff, provide technical and operational guidance, establish priorities, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.
Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with executives, managers, auditors, partners, and subject matter experts.
Must be highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, or closely related IT roles, including experience leading security initiatives and providing guidance to other security professionals.
Working knowledge of security frameworks and best practices such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, and CIS Controls.
Experience with vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, identity and access management, endpoint security, logging/SIEM, data protection, secure configuration, and patch management.
Experience supporting internal or external security audits, assessments, evidence collection, remediation, and compliance activities.
Knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and cloud technologies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security environments, is highly desirable.
Hands-on experience designing, maturing, implementing, administering, tuning, and integrating the Microsoft security suite, including Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID and Privileged Identity Management, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Intune security controls, and related Microsoft 365 and Azure security capabilities.
Experience designing and governing security automation, including Microsoft Sentinel automation rules and playbooks, Logic Apps, alert enrichment, notifications, data connectors, workflow integrations, and automated response actions.
Experience managing third-party SOC or managed security service providers, including service-level oversight, escalation, quality review, access dependencies, performance reporting, and vendor coordination.
Ability to assess technical risk, translate findings into practical remediation plans, and communicate risk to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or Microsoft security certifications are preferred.
Commitment to continuous professional development and staying current with emerging technologies, threats, and security practices.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has supervisory responsibilities and is responsible for leading, mentoring, and developing Cyber Security staff.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and relevant experience. Demonstrated experience in enterprise cybersecurity operations, risk management, incident response, and audit/compliance activities is required; prior leadership or supervisory experience is preferred.

Experience commissioning BES Cyber Systems, substations, generation assets, transmission assets, or operational technology (OT) environments.

This role will support NIPSCO’s regulatory compliance and operational readiness initiatives associated with the certification and commissioning of a new Control Center,

responsibilities may include:

jobs.description:
About Judi Health

Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry's first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.

At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. We are the intelligence platform powering benefits plans for millions of Americans and proudly leading the next generation of care. To learn more, visit www.judi.health.

Position Summary

The Principal Project Manager, Corporate Compliance, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing compliance-related projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. This position serves as a liaison between Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, Information Technology, Operations, and other business stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with regulatory, accreditation, and organizational requirements.

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining project governance, tracking milestones, managing risks and dependencies, facilitating stakeholder communication, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's compliance program. This role requires strong organizational, analytical, and relationship management skills, along with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

Position Responsibilities

Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of compliance department projects and initiatives.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
Coordinate cross functional project teams to ensure successful implementation of compliance initiatives.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, barriers, and resource constraints.
Facilitate project meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
Prepare project reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for leadership and governance committees.
Ensure project documentation is complete, organized, and maintained in accordance with departmental standards.

Compliance Program Support

Support implementation and enhancement of compliance program elements, including policies and procedures, training, risk management, hotline management, investigations, auditing and monitoring, and corrective action plans.
Coordinate enterprise compliance initiatives related to Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Marketplace, and other lines of business.
Support implementation and optimization of compliance technology platforms, including NAVEX and other governance, risk, and compliance systems.
Assist with enterprise risk assessments and compliance program effectiveness initiatives.
Monitor project activities to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory and contractual requirements.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management

Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
Coordinate activities between Compliance and business owners to ensure accountability for project deliverables.
Manage vendor implementation activities and track contractual deliverables, milestones, and action items.
Facilitate issue resolution and escalation when project risks or delays are identified.

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, workflows, and operational efficiencies.
Develop standard operating procedures, project methodologies, templates, and reporting tools.
Support automation, workflow optimization, and technology enhancements designed to improve compliance operations.
Track project outcomes and key performance indicators to measure effectiveness and support continuous improvement.

Governance and Reporting

Maintain project governance structures and documentation.
Develop meeting agendas, meeting minutes, action item logs, and project status reports.
Present updates to Compliance Leadership, executive leadership, and applicable committees.
Ensure action items are assigned, monitored, and completed timely.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Project Management, Compliance, Public Health, or related field required.
Master's degree preferred.

Experience

Minimum of five (5) years of project management experience required.
Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting compliance, regulatory, healthcare, health plan, PBM, TPA, or highly regulated business environments preferred.
Experience leading enterprise or cross departmental projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, dependencies, and organizational objectives required.
Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms preferred.
Experience managing the annual review of business continuity plans and disaster recovery plans preferred.

Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) considered.
Healthcare Compliance certification such as CHC or CCEP preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong project planning, organization, and execution skills.
Knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience facilitating meetings and driving accountability across departments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and Project.
Experience with JIRA, Smartsheet, Asana, or similar project management tools preferred.
Experience with NAVEX, policy management systems, incident management systems, or other compliance platforms preferred.
Knowledge of healthcare regulatory requirements, including CMS, HIPAA, URAC, and NCQA standards preferred.

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE:
Cybersecurity Manager
FLSA STATUS:
Exempt
SCHEDULE:
M-F, 40 hrs./week
LOCATION:
Any Spencer Fane Office Location
REPORTS TO:
IT Security Director

POSITION SUMMARY:

Under direction of the IT Security Director, the Cybersecurity Manager leads the firm's cybersecurity operations, providing technical leadership across security engineering, architecture, incident response, and security platforms. The position oversees cybersecurity personnel and external service providers, directs the implementation and effectiveness of security controls, and partners with IT and business stakeholders to integrate security into the firm's technology environment. The role is accountable for operational security performance, incident response readiness, and the delivery of cybersecurity initiatives that protect firm systems and data.

COMPENSATION:
At Spencer Fane, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to location, skillset, experience, training, licenses, certifications and other business or organizational needs. Compensation will be determined based on the above factors along with the requirements of the position. The salary range for this position will vary depending on location as shown below.

SALARY RANGE BY LOCATION:

Birmingham, AL; Hendersonville, TN; Kansas City, MO; Las Vegas, NV; Miami, FL; Nashville, TN; New Orleans, LA; Overland Park, KS; Palm Beach, Fl; Phoenix, AZ; Salt Lake City, UT; St. Cloud, MN; St. Louis-Clayton, MO; Tampa, FL; Tulsa, OK: $155,000.00 - $175,000.00

Austin, TX; Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX; Denver, CO; Galveston, TX; Houston, TX; Minneapolis, MN; Plano, TX; Sacramento, CA; Westlake Village, CA: $170,000.00 - $192,000.00

Bentonville, AR; Cape Girardeau, MO; Dakota Dunes, SD; Fayetteville, AR; Greenville, SC; Jefferson City, MO; Oklahoma City, OK; Omaha, NE; Santa Fe, NM; Springfield, MO; St. George, UT; Tallahassee, FL; Wichita, KS: $142,500.00 - $160,500.00

Santa Monica, CA; Washington, DC: $185,000.00 - $210,000.00

New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; San Jose, CA: $200,000.00 - $227,500.00

BENEFITS:
Medical, Vision, Dental, PTO, 401k, Life, Disability

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Cybersecurity Operations Leadership

Lead daily cybersecurity operations, workload prioritization, escalations, and service delivery.
Supervise cybersecurity personnel, including assignments, coaching, cross-training, and performance management.
Establish documented ownership, procedures, metrics, service expectations, and backup coverage.

Incident Response and Resilience

Lead technical investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident improvement.
Coordinate response activities with IT, Legal, Communications, firm leadership, and external providers.
Maintain and test incident-response plans, playbooks, escalation paths, and tabletop exercises.

Security Engineering and Architecture

Lead security reviews for network, endpoint, identity, cloud, data, AI, and business technologies.
Translate business requirements and security risks into practical technical designs and standards.
Validate access, integrations, logging, monitoring, segmentation, data protection, and recovery controls.

Security Platform Oversight

Maintain operational accountability for network, endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and privileged-access controls.
Ensure security platforms are properly configured, integrated, monitored, documented, and supported.
Monitor platform health, security coverage, service performance, and remediation of control gaps.

Security Transformation and Project Delivery

Lead cybersecurity initiatives from design through implementation, testing, transition, and measurement.
Manage scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, rollback plans, and stakeholder communications.
Build sustainable processes that reduce reliance on individuals, other IT teams, and external providers.

Detection and Vulnerability Management

Oversee vulnerability identification, validation, prioritization, remediation, exceptions, and reporting.
Direct development and tuning of security detections, alerts, use cases, and response playbooks.
Use incidents, testing, intelligence, and operational data to identify security improvements.

AI and Emerging Technology Security

Lead technical security assessments for AI platforms, agents, integrations, automation, and emerging technologies.
Evaluate permissions, data access, third-party connections, production impact, logging, and monitoring.
Translate governance requirements into practical technical safeguards and operating standards.

Vendor and Managed-Service Oversight

Manage operational relationships with security monitoring, incident-response, testing, and engineering providers.
Define responsibilities, service expectations, escalation procedures, deliverables, and performance measures.
Validate vendor work while retaining internal ownership of security decisions and operational knowledge.

Metrics and Reporting

Establish operational metrics for incidents, alerts, vulnerabilities, platforms, projects, and service performance.
Maintain dashboards and provide concise operational updates to the IT Security Director.
Identify recurring issues, control gaps, performance concerns, and improvement opportunities.

GRC, Audit, and Client Support

Provide technical evidence, control documentation, and subject-matter support to designated GRC personnel.
Support audits and client assessments through technical validation, evidence collection, and remediation.
Implement approved policies and escalate compliance concerns or control exceptions appropriately.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, or a related field preferred. In lieu of a degree, at least five years of directly relevant cybersecurity experience — gained at an organization with a minimum of 2,000 users and/or $500M in annual revenue — managing enterprise security operations, security engineering, architecture, or incident response.
Eight years of progressive IT and/or cybersecurity experience, including at least three years managing enterprise cybersecurity operations across network, endpoint, identity, cloud, and email security environments, with responsibility for security engineering, architecture, vulnerability management, and threat detection. At least three years must have been gained within a highly regulated industry — law firm experience preferred, or equivalent (e.g., healthcare, financial services, government).

Management & Oversight

At least three years of direct supervisory experience managing cybersecurity professionals, including workload prioritization, performance management, technical development, and operational coverage.
At least three years of experience directly managing managed security service providers (MSSPs) and third-party cybersecurity vendors, including responsibility for service-level performance, incident escalations, technical deliverables, and remediation of service deficiencies.
Security Budgeting, Capital Budget Planning and vendor financial contract management are a plus.

Technical Leadership

Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity initiatives from technical design and implementation through testing and transition into ongoing operations, coordinating internal technical teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
Direct experience serving as technical lead during significant cybersecurity incidents — such as ransomware attacks, account compromises, unauthorized access, or data exfiltration — including directing investigations, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident corrective actions.

EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

Security Architecture & Engineering:
Advanced knowledge of enterprise security architecture, engineering principles, and technical controls across network, endpoint, identity, cloud, email, and privileged-access environments. Capable of evaluating technical designs, validating security requirements, and identifying vulnerabilities and control deficiencies across interconnected systems.
Security Operations & Platform Management:
Comprehensive understanding of enterprise security platforms, including endpoint detection and response (EDR), security information and event management (SIEM), identity and access management (IAM), privileged access management (PAM), and vulnerability management solutions. Technical knowledge of security platform integration, automation, and API-based connectivity, with the ability to evaluate platform configurations, monitoring coverage, operational effectiveness, and remediation requirements.
Incident Response & Threat Management:
Advanced technical knowledge of incident investigation, threat detection, containment, eradication, and recovery procedures. Capable of directing technical response activities, evaluating threat intelligence and security telemetry, coordinating incident escalations, and identifying improvements to detection capabilities and response procedures.
Vulnerability Management & Risk Assessment:
Expertise in evaluating vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability and potential business impact, prioritizing remediation, and validating corrective actions. Skilled in translating technical security risks into actionable remediation plans while balancing operational requirements and business priorities.
Technical Leadership & Decision-Making:
Advanced technical judgment in evaluating security architecture, resolving complex cybersecurity issues, establishing operational priorities, and directing technical teams during critical incidents. Capable of assessing competing technical solutions, identifying implementation risks, and making informed decisions involving security effectiveness, operational resilience, and business continuity.
People Leadership & Development:
Proven ability to manage cybersecurity professionals across multiple technical disciplines, establish clear performance expectations, evaluate technical capabilities, develop staff, and maintain operational accountability. Skilled in organizing team responsibilities, establishing escalation procedures, and developing processes that reduce reliance on individual personnel or external providers.
Cybersecurity Project Delivery:
Skilled in managing cybersecurity implementations involving multiple security technologies, infrastructure dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders. Capable of evaluating technical requirements, coordinating implementation activities, managing project risks, validating security controls, and ensuring successful transition into ongoing operations.
Vendor & Managed-Service Management:
Ability to evaluate the technical performance of external security providers, establish service expectations and escalation procedures, validate security monitoring and incident-response deliverables, and address service deficiencies while maintaining internal accountability for cybersecurity operations.
AI & Emerging Technology Security:
Knowledge of cybersecurity risks associated with AI platforms, automated agents, third-party integrations, and emerging enterprise technologies. Capable of evaluating access permissions, data exposure, system integrations, logging, and monitoring requirements to identify and implement appropriate technical safeguards.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:
Advanced analytical and troubleshooting capabilities to investigate complex cybersecurity incidents, evaluate security telemetry, identify systemic control weaknesses, and determine effective technical solutions. Sound judgment in prioritizing remediation activities based on security exposure, operational impact, and available resources.
Communication & Business Partnership:
Skilled in communicating complex cybersecurity risks, technical findings, incident developments, and remediation recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. Capable of coordinating cro

jobs.title: Sr. Business Operations Manager (Starlink Growth)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK GROWTH)

Starlink is a revolutionary satellite constellation, delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world – bringing an unprecedented opportunity to significantly impact communities, businesses, and governments worldwide. The North America Business Development team is seeking a Sr. Business Operations Manager to serve as a pivotal partner in defining and executing go-to-market (GTM) strategy across both third-party and direct starlink.com selling channels. This role owns the operational backbone of North American Business Development initiatives while driving foundational GTM strategy work that shapes the team’s long-term direction. In addition, the role owns day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America and works cross-functionally to maximize Starlink fulfilments and subscribers. It is vital that Starlink deals, partnerships, and direct-to-consumer efforts be optimized for speed, scale, and balanced growth. This role requires deep program management and business operations expertise, comfort working with both people and data, and fluency in financial analysis, reporting, pricing, promotions, and the day-to-day mechanics that make Starlink business development and direct channel initiatives run.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business operations, and chief-of-staff capabilities with strategic rigor, GTM expertise, and long-term vision. This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of connectivity technologies with a world-class team focused on connecting every household and traveler.

Responsibilities

Own and drive GTM strategy for North America across both third-party channels and Starlink.com, ensuring alignment on prioritization, resource allocation, and growth objectives
Own day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America, including performance tracking, conversion optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize the business
Provide strategic insight across the North America Business Development team to minimize cannibalization and maximize balanced growth between third-party and starlink.com
Assist with pricing strategy and promotions development for both Starlink.com and third-party channels, partnering with finance, marketing, and commercial teams to design and evaluate programs that drive incremental growth
Own the operationalization of existing and upcoming business development and GTM initiatives, driving program management, deal pipeline tracking, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline so initiatives move with speed and scale
Create data visualization and present analysis on leading and lagging indicators, along with clear recommendations and optimization planning to leadership stakeholders
Conduct new vertical, competitor, and market research, develop big-bet hypotheses, and perform structured assessments of broad business intelligence, target partners, channels, and direct GTM opportunities to inform team prioritization and resource allocation
Report on progress of strategy, operations, and GTM initiatives, presenting insights, risks, and recommendations directly to Starlink leadership

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field
7+ years of experience in business operations, program management, strategy, GTM and ecommerce, consulting, investment banking, or related roles involving complex initiatives
4+ years of experience driving execution of revenue or growth-oriented programs, including tracking, reporting, and operationalizing commercial or direct-to-consumer initiatives

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven background in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, or chief-of-staff roles supporting high-growth or commercial teams in technology, telecommunications, utilities, or subscription-based services
Experience owning or supporting direct-to-consumer (e.g., e-commerce) channel growth alongside third-party or partner channels, with demonstrated ability to balance growth and minimize cannibalization
Experience in management consulting or investment banking, with demonstrated ability to structure problems, build rigorous analyses, and drive recommendations to action
Familiarity with business development, partnerships, pricing strategy, or promotions in consumer technology, telecommunications, or adjacent sectors
Strong analytical, financial modeling, and data fluency; comfort with accounting concepts, KPI design, pricing analysis, and building clear reporting for leadership
Demonstrated success operationalizing complex commercial, product, or direct-channel initiatives and driving them from concept through execution and scale
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; able to work effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders
MBA or master’s degree with a business or technical focus preferred

Additional Requirements

Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Willingness to travel approximately 25-50% of the time to customer locations and other SpaceX locations as required

Itar Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Optivolt

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

Our Team & Traction

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team.

To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture.

Why we are looking for you

As Operations Manager, you will own the business processes and day-to-day operations that support our growth. You’ll manage working capital, financial projections, accounting workflows, and business systems while keeping logistics and facilities running reliably.

This hands-on role combines business operations with responsibility for our physical workplace and supply flow. You will partner with leadership, engineering, accounting providers, and legal counsel on budgets, forecasts, contracts, and practical processes. You’ll also directly manage shipping, inventory, vendors, and facility needs.

What you’ll do

What we’re looking for

Preferred skills

Additional requirements

Pay and benefits

Business Operations and Financial Planning
Manage working capital across receivables, payables, inventory, and supplier commitments; improve collections, payment terms, and cash conversion.
Build and maintain cash-flow forecasts, operating budgets, and revenue, expense, and inventory projections with leadership.
Track actual results against plans, explain variances, and model purchasing, hiring, and growth scenarios to support decisions.
Manage purchasing approvals and spending controls; identify cost reductions and flag cash needs and operational risks early.
Accounting and ERP Systems
Own AR/AP workflows, including quotes, customer invoicing, collections, vendor bills, and payment scheduling within approval processes.
Handle routine bookkeeping and account reconciliations; support month-end close and financial reporting with accounting providers.
Administer and improve ERP and accounting workflows across purchasing, inventory, billing, and reporting; maintain accurate records and access controls.
Maintain financial and operational dashboards, SOPs, approvals, and supporting records for reliable reporting and audit readiness.
Contracts and Business Administration
Coordinate customer and vendor agreements, NDAs, and purchase terms from preparation through approval and signature.
Negotiate commercial terms with leadership and coordinate legal review with counsel; track open issues through completion.
Maintain contract, insurance, and corporate records; track renewals, obligations, and administrative deadlines.
Shipping Logistics and Inventory
Own domestic and international shipping and receiving for prototypes, equipment, production materials, and field deployments.
Manage carriers, freight forwarders, rates, shipping and customs documentation, delivery tracking, and claims or exceptions.
Maintain inventory accuracy through labeling, cycle counts, and ERP reconciliation; coordinate returns and RMAs with engineering and quality.
Facilities and Lab Operations
Keep office, lab, and testing spaces functional, organized, and safe, including maintenance, access, and basic safety supplies and records.
Manage facility vendors, service contracts, budgets, upgrades, and equipment installations to support engineering and production needs.
Provide hands-on support for deliveries, visitors, workspace changes, and indoor and outdoor test setups.
3+ years in business operations, finance operations, or operations management, including 1+ years owning financial and operational processes.
Hands-on experience managing working capital and preparing cash-flow forecasts, budgets, financial projections, and variance analyses.
Working knowledge of bookkeeping, AR/AP, account reconciliations, and financial statements; experience supporting an accounting close.
Experience administering or improving ERP and accounting systems across purchasing, inventory, and finance.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial models, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and scenario analysis.
Experience coordinating contracts, negotiating commercial terms, and working with legal counsel or external advisors.
Experience managing facilities, logistics, vendors, and physical inventory in a hardware, manufacturing, lab, or similar environment.
Ability to prioritize independently, communicate financial and operational tradeoffs, and handle confidential information responsibly.
Track record improving processes and controls while remaining willing to handle routine accounting, administrative, and physical operations work.
Experience supporting GAAP-based financial reporting or SOC audit readiness, controls documentation, and evidence collection is a strong plus.
Experience in a hardware startup, including inventory planning, contract manufacturing, and the cash demands of physical products.
Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems such as NetSuite, Odoo, SAP Business One, or QuickBooks.
Familiarity with international shipping and customs, lab safety practices, or material-handling equipment.
Willingness to work extended hours as needed to support critical milestones
Everyone at Optivolt is required to participate in on call support for customers
Must be based in San Francisco, CA

jobs.title: SAP Engagement Manager- Project Manager
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

About The Job You're Considering

The SAP Engagement Manager (Project Manager) is responsible for the successful execution and completion of complex SAP programs, including the orchestration and integration of all OneCapgemini components when SAP serves as the lead Business Line. Project Managers are responsible for overseeing the project/engagement/contract/activity on a daily basis and are responsible for delivering high-quality results within the identified objectives and constraints, ensuring the effective use of the allocated resources. They are responsible for risk and issue management, project/engagement communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way.

Success is defined by delivering the project within committed timelines and financial parameters while achieving stated client outcomes and meeting all quality requirements. This role provides overall leadership across the program lifecycle and ensures the effective integration of Capgemini offerings, capabilities, and delivery teams.

The ideal candidate combines large-scale SAP Project management, executive client relationship management, commercial acumen, and business development capabilities with a proven ability to lead complex transformation programs across global organizations.

Responsible for leading either a large contract/engagement or a definable segment of a very large and complex contract/engagement. Clients may be external or internal. PM are responsible for the translation of the client's complex business requirements into formal agreements. For these, PM establish specific solutions, applications or processes which ultimately culminate in customer acceptance of the results. This includes working with client team members and executives to identify business requirements and subsequently working with, and leading others, in the initiating, planning, controlling, executing and closing the client's solution. PM are responsible for a wide range of process activities beginning with the request for proposal through development, and final delivery.

Your Role

Lead the successful delivery of client outcomes and project results.
Manage a primary engagement or client to ensure appropriate focus, governance, and delivery oversight.
Oversee programs with a total contract value of up to $15 million, monthly revenue of up to $2 million, and teams of up to 100 professionals across limited geographies and capabilities.
Lead all Capgemini delivery personnel assigned to the program, regardless of geography or capability.
Serve as the highest point of escalation for Capgemini project and program teams and as the primary client escalation contact for day-to-day delivery matters.
Drive the full program lifecycle, from initiation through closure, using prescribed Capgemini tools, technologies, methodologies, and governance standards.
Establish and maintain productive working relationships and an effective operating cadence with client counterparts.
Share accountability with the assigned Delivery Executive for the financial performance of each program.
Provide accurate and timely financial information to appropriate client stakeholders in accordance with the Statement of Work and agreements established with the client PMO.
Translate objectives, scope, milestones, and deliverables defined in the Statement of Work into a comprehensive and actionable program plan.
Collaborate with the client to validate, adjust, and obtain formal approval of the baseline program plan.
Actively manage program plans, including progress updates, delivery activities, approved adjustments, change requests, and agreed-upon replanning activities.
Manage program governance, risks, issues, dependencies, financial performance, resource plans, change control, and executive reporting.
Participate in client discussions, both in person and remotely, to present proposed solutions, respond to inquiries, and demonstrate Capgemini’s ability to address the client’s business and technology needs.
Support stakeholder alignment, cross-functional collaboration, and organizational change throughout the program lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to apply AI, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent delivery capabilities to strengthen program governance, reporting, risk management, and operational efficiency.
Continuously contribute to the growth, delivery excellence, and strategic priorities of the SAP Business Line.

Your Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field required; master’s degree preferred.
Proven SAP experience, including a minimum of 9+ years leading complex projects, programs, or PMO functions across multiple workstreams, capabilities, and geographies.
Proven experience managing large-scale SAP transformation programs, including governance, financial and contractual commitments, resource planning, risk and issue management, change control, and executive reporting.
Ability to translate Statements of Work, business objectives, milestones, and deliverables into actionable program plans using SAP delivery methodologies and project portfolio management tools.
Demonstrated success partnering with client executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders, and PMO organizations.
Strong executive presence with excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, problem-solving, decision-making, and escalation-management skills.
Action-oriented, self-motivated, and effective in complex, fast-paced delivery environments.

jobs.description:
NetSuite Systems, Project & Integration Manager

Department:
Operations / Information Systems
Reports To:
Senior Management
Location:
Braintree, Massachusetts
Employment Type:
Full-Time

Position Summary

The NetSuite Systems, Project & Integration Manager
is responsible for managing, optimizing, and continuously improving the company's NetSuite ERP environment and its integration with operational, financial, manufacturing, warehouse, EDI, payroll, and other business systems.
This position serves as the primary internal business owner and project manager for NetSuite-related initiatives. The role works closely with Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Sales, Quality, Warehouse, Production, Maintenance, HR, and external technology partners to ensure systems support the company's operational and financial requirements.
The position will oversee system projects from planning through implementation, including requirements gathering, process development, system configuration coordination, testing, training, implementation, troubleshooting, and ongoing performance management.
The successful candidate will be highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working between business operations and technology providers. The position does not require the individual to be a software developer but requires a strong understanding of ERP systems, integrations, data flow, business processes, and project management.

Key Responsibilities

NetSuite ERP Management

Serve as the primary internal point of contact for NetSuite-related business requirements, issues, projects, and improvements.
Develop a strong working knowledge of NetSuite's financial, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, sales, reporting, and operational capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve business processes through better utilization and configuration of NetSuite.
Coordinate with NetSuite consultants, Oracle partners, third-party vendors, and internal users.
Manage system enhancements, configuration changes, testing, and implementation.
Monitor system performance, data accuracy, user adoption, and process compliance.
Maintain documentation of system processes, configurations, integrations, and key workflows.
Establish appropriate controls around system changes, user access, and data integrity.

Systems Integration

Manage integrations between NetSuite and other company systems and applications.
Coordinate EDI implementations and ongoing EDI requirements with customers, suppliers, and third-party providers.
Manage integrations involving systems such as SPS Commerce, RF-SMART, I-Trade, payroll/HR systems, banking systems, shipping platforms, warehouse systems, and other operational applications
, as applicable.
Understand and document data flows between systems.
Coordinate testing of inbound and outbound transactions.
Investigate integration failures, data discrepancies, and transaction errors and coordinate resolution with the appropriate vendor or technical resource.
Establish procedures for monitoring critical integrations and escalating issues.

Project Management

Lead NetSuite and business systems projects from initial concept through implementation.
Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and deliverables.
Gather requirements from department managers and translate business needs into system requirements.
Coordinate internal resources and external vendors.
Manage project priorities, budgets, deadlines, and risks.
Provide regular project status updates to senior management.
Coordinate user acceptance testing and obtain appropriate approval before implementation.
Ensure completed projects achieve the intended operational and financial objectives.

Business Process Improvement

Evaluate existing business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, controls, and reporting.
Work with department leaders to document current-state and future-state processes.
Identify unnecessary manual processes and opportunities for automation.
Develop recommendations for system and process improvements.
Assist management in evaluating the financial and operational impact of proposed system changes.
Ensure system changes support the company's growth and operational requirements.

Reporting & Data Management

Develop and coordinate NetSuite reporting requirements across departments.
Improve access to purchasing, inventory, labor, production, sales, financial, and operational information.
Work with users to define reporting requirements and develop appropriate dashboards, saved searches, reports, and KPIs.
Monitor data integrity and investigate discrepancies between systems.
Assist management with developing reliable reporting for decision-making.
Establish consistent definitions and processes for critical business data.

User Support & Training

Serve as an internal resource for NetSuite users.
Coordinate user training for new functionality and system changes.
Develop user procedures, training materials, and system documentation.
Promote consistent system usage and adherence to established processes.
Identify recurring user issues and develop permanent solutions rather than relying on manual workarounds.

Vendor & Partner Management

Manage relationships with NetSuite consultants, software vendors, integration providers, and technology partners.
Review vendor proposals, statements of work, contracts, and project estimates.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed-upon scope, timelines, service levels, and deliverables.
Challenge unnecessary costs, duplicate services, and scope increases.
Coordinate vendor meetings and ensure action items are completed.
Assist management with evaluating new technology providers and solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, or a related field preferred.
5+ years of experience with ERP systems, business systems, technology projects, or systems implementation.

Demonstrated experience working with NetSuite or a comparable ERP platform
.
Experience managing system integrations and third-party technology vendors.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to understand business processes and translate them into system requirements.
Experience with data analysis, reporting, and process improvement.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

NetSuite implementation, administration, or optimization experience.
Experience with RF-SMART, SPS Commerce, EDI, I-Trade
, or similar systems.
Experience in manufacturing, food production, distribution, warehousing, or supply chain environments.
Experience with inventory, purchasing, production, labor, and warehouse management systems.
Experience managing ERP implementations or major system transitions.
Familiarity with APIs, data interfaces, integration platforms, or middleware.
Experience developing NetSuite Saved Searches, dashboards, reports, and workflows.
NetSuite certification or other relevant ERP certification is a plus.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance in this position will be evaluated based on:
Successful completion of system projects within agreed-upon scope and timelines.
Reliability and accuracy of system integrations.
Reduction of manual processes and duplicate data entry.
Improved accuracy and availability of management reporting.
User adoption and effective utilization of NetSuite functionality.
Reduction in recurring system issues and integration failures.
Vendor performance and cost management.
Successful implementation of new systems and system enhancements.
Improved cross-functional business processes.
Data integrity and system controls.

Core Competencies

Project Management
— Ability to organize complex projects, establish priorities, manage deadlines, and drive accountability.
Systems Thinking
— Ability to understand how multiple systems interact and how changes in one system affect other areas of the business.
Business Acumen
— Understands the operational and financial impact of technology decisions.
Analytical Thinking
— Uses data and structured problem-solving to identify root causes and develop solutions.
Communication
— Able to communicate effectively with senior management, department managers, system users, consultants, and technical vendors.
Accountability
— Takes ownership of projects and follows issues through to resolution.
Continuous Improvement
— Consistently looks for opportunities to improve processes, systems, efficiency, and reporting.
Role Expectations

The NetSuite Systems, Project & Integration Manager is expected to operate as a business systems owner and project leader
, rather than simply an IT support resource. The position should understand the company's operational requirements, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure technology investments produce measurable business value.
The individual will be expected to take ownership of assigned projects, establish clear timelines and deliverables, communicate progress to management, and ensure that projects are fully implemented and adopted by the organization.

Fun: Wer arbeitet, muss auch mal eine Pause machen. Ob Party oder auspowern – bei uns hast du durch regelmäßige After Work Events und agenturgeförderte Fitnessprogramme genug Möglichkeiten

Internationalität: Als international agierende Agenturgruppe bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, dich mit Kolleg:innen aus den unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen aus der ganzen Welt zu vernetzen und auszutauschen

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in insurance fraud investigations, claims operations, and people management and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Claims Fraud and Investigations Manager for our Waterloo officee to lead and develop a team responsible for the prevention, detection, and investigation of suspected insurance fraud while supporting the effective management of claims fraud risk.

Reporting to the AVP, Investigative and Recovery Services you will oversee the daily operations of the Claims Fraud Investigations team, provide technical expertise and leadership on complex fraud matters, and help develop strategies that enhance fraud detection, investigation outcomes, and organizational savings. You will work closely with Claims leadership, investigators, Human Resources, and other key business partners to ensure investigations are conducted effectively, professionally, and in compliance with regulatory and governance requirements.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

The position is currently based in Waterloo, with plans to relocate to our new Kitchener office when it opens in early 2027.

What you will do

Lead the daily operations of the Claims Fraud Investigations team and ensure the delivery of high-quality investigative services to the Claims organization.
Promptly review and triage investigative referrals from all sources
Promptly assign investigations to the appropriate internal investigator after triaging them
Provide counter fraud education on key fraud indicators, fraud trends, fraud metrics, etc. to Zurich adjusters and management
Provide operational leadership and technical guidance to investigators while supporting the development and execution of fraud investigation strategies.
Deliver professional investigation reports with clear conclusions and technically sound recommendations.
Monitor and manage highly complex fraud investigations, including matters involving arbitration and litigation.
Handle technical referrals, complaints, and collaborate with Internal Audit regarding claims fraud investigation performance.
Conduct quarterly quality audits of completed investigations and periodic reviews of open investigations as needed.
Develop team capabilities through coaching, mentoring, and training related to fraud identification, investigation, documentation, and reporting.
Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for Claims leaders and managers regarding fraud investigation activities.
Ensure compliance with all local regulations, privacy requirements, and Zurich Claims governance standards.
Collect, analyze, and report fraud-related data to support management reporting, business insights, and fraud strategy initiatives.
Promote awareness and adherence to claims fraud prevention and investigation strategies across the organization.
Act as the liaison between the Claims Fraud Investigation team and Human Resources on employee-related matters.
Foster strong working relationships across Claims and other business units to support successful investigative outcomes.

Job Qualifications - What You Bring To The Table

Bachelor's Degree and 6 or more years of experience in Insurance Fraud or Insurance Investigations.

OR

Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree, and 6 or more years of experience in Insurance Fraud or Insurance Investigations.

OR

High School Diploma or equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in Insurance Fraud or Insurance Investigations.

AND

Leadership experience.
Project management experience.
Must obtain and maintain anti-fraud certification.
Knowledge of claims handling processes and procedures.
Experience interpreting and applying fraud statutes and regulations.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
People leadership and team development experience.
Experience working collaboratively across business units and stakeholder groups.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable compensation range, but starting salaries may exceed this range based on a candidate’s skills and experience.

At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto's Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada's 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals' first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com.

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. jobs.title: Senior Cyber Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
If you are motivated and believe in the credit union philosophy of "People Helping People," join our team!

About The Role

The Senior Cyber Intelligence Analyst is the technical lead for intelligence-driven detection and exposure management. You own the analytic tradecraft, the detection engineering standards, and the intelligence products that shape how the organization prioritizes vulnerabilities, builds detections, and briefs leadership. You set the bar for the team's Splunk work, mentor analysts, and represent threat intelligence to peer teams and executives.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real ownership. You are expected to define how the work gets done, not just do it, and to make defensible analytic calls that leadership will act on.

What you will do

Lead threat intelligence and analysis

Own the intelligence requirements process: define priority intelligence requirements with stakeholders, maintain the collection plan, and evaluate feed and vendor value.
Lead analysis of threat actors, campaigns, malware families, and TTPs relevant to financial services, our technology stack, and our third-party ecosystem, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
Produce and quality-review decision-ready intelligence products at the tactical, operational, and strategic levels, including briefings for the CISO and contributions to governance and Board-level reporting.
Own the threat-informed assessment of newly disclosed vulnerabilities (CISA KEV, EPSS, exploit availability, vendor advisories) and drive that assessment into vulnerability prioritization and emergency remediation decisions.
Lead intelligence support to incident response: attribution, campaign context, indicator enrichment, and post-incident lessons that become detections and requirements.
Represent the organization in industry sharing communities (FS-ISAC and peer groups) and build relationships with vendor and government intelligence contacts.

Lead detection engineering

Own the detection engineering program in Splunk Enterprise Security: standards, lifecycle, coverage measurement, and the tuning process.
Design and build high-value detections, correlation searches, and risk-based alerting (RBA) logic; review and mentor others' detection work.
Maintain the MITRE ATT&CK coverage map, prioritize gaps against current threat intelligence and crown-jewel assets, and drive a roadmap to close them.
Establish detection-as-code practices: version control, peer review, testing against replayed or emulated attack data, and controlled deployment.
Lead purple-team and adversary emulation exercises to validate detections and measure real coverage rather than assumed coverage.
Set standards for SPL quality, data model use, CIM compliance, and search performance; partner with the Splunk platform team on data onboarding and platform direction.

Lead threat hunting and exposure management

Design and run the threat hunting program: hunt hypotheses tied to priority intelligence requirements, documented methodology, and outcomes that feed detections and remediation.
Lead cross-source analysis correlating vulnerability data (Tenable) with endpoint (SentinelOne), source control (GitHub), network and edge (F5, Check Point, Zscaler), and email (Proofpoint) telemetry to identify exposed, exploitable, and actively targeted assets.
Serve as the threat intelligence lead for the continuous threat exposure management (CTEM) program, ensuring exposure prioritization reflects real adversary behavior and business impact.
Provide threat research and detection strategy for emerging programs in AI security, software supply chain and third-party risk, and application security.

Mentor, influence, and report

Mentor and technically guide analysts on the team; review analytic products and detections for rigor and clarity.
Own the team's Splunk dashboards and scheduled reporting for intelligence metrics, detection coverage, hunt outcomes, and threat-informed vulnerability metrics that roll up to leadership reporting.
Influence remediation and control decisions across IT operations, application owners, and engineering by presenting evidence-based risk assessments.
Brief executives and governance audiences clearly and credibly, including confidence levels and dissenting assessments.

What you bring

Required

7+ years in cybersecurity with at least 4 years in threat intelligence, detection engineering, or threat hunting, including experience leading work streams or projects.
Expert hands-on Splunk skills: advanced SPL, Splunk Enterprise Security, correlation searches, risk-based alerting, data models, CIM, and search optimization.
A track record of building detection programs or coverage strategies, not just individual detections, and measuring their effectiveness.
Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, structured analytic techniques, and intelligence product standards (confidence language, sourcing, analytic rigor).
Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and email, with the ability to translate it into telemetry and search logic.
Experience integrating threat intelligence into vulnerability prioritization using CVSS, VPR, EPSS, CISA KEV, and exploit intelligence.
Excellent analytic writing and briefing skills; comfortable presenting to executives and defending assessments under scrutiny.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and raise the technical bar for a team.

Preferred

Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, with familiarity in FFIEC, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and PCI DSS expectations for threat intelligence and monitoring.
Experience with Tenable, SentinelOne, GitHub Advanced Security, Zscaler, Proofpoint, or comparable platforms.
Python for enrichment, automation, and data analysis; experience with security APIs and STIX/TAXII; experience operating a threat intelligence platform (TIP).
Experience with detection-as-code tooling and CI/CD for detections.
Hands-on experience with CTEM or exposure management platforms.
Experience running purple-team or adversary emulation programs.
Certifications such as GCTI, GCDA, GCFA, GREM, Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, or CISSP.
Research or practical experience in AI/ML security, software supply chain security, or application security.

Pour délivrer au quotidien ces milliers de contenus au sein de sites et d'applications adaptés pour les lecteurs, les équipes techniques, design et produit du Figaro mènent de front de nombreux projets, et font face à des challenges variés.

Vous construisez et maintenez l'infrastructure data audience organique du groupe. Vous détectez les signaux avant qu'on vous pose la question, mesurez l'impact de chaque chantier et êtes l'interlocuteur data des équipes Produit, Tech, Direction.

Vous n'êtes pas un SEO qui fait de la data : vous êtes un profil data qui comprend profondément les mécaniques d'acquisition organique, au premier rang desquelles le SEO.

Concrètement, vous :

- Construisez et maintenez le data warehouse audience organique centralisé : GSC, GA4, logs serveur, API réseaux sociaux, plateformes newsletters, outils tiers, en synergie avec les autres Data Analyst du groupe Figaro
- Analysez l'écosystème des leviers d'audience organique (Social, Newsletters, Deeplinks, Discover) et mesurez leur contribution respective, y compris les effets de cannibalisation ou de synergie entre canaux
- Êtes propriétaire des dashboards de suivi organique consolidés par canal (indexation, positions, Discover, trafic social, newsletters) et de l'alerting automatique sur les signaux critiques
- Produisez les analyses d'opportunité et benchmarks concurrentiels qui orientent les décisions stratégiques
- Détectez et qualifiez les évolutions des algorithmes via les patterns de données - proactivement
- Analysez l'écosystème des autres leviers d'audience (Social, Newsletters, Deeplinks, etc.)

En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe SEO / GEO, vous :

- Automatisez les audits récurrents : pages orphelines, canonical, crawl budget, couverture d'index
- Mesurez systématiquement l'impact de chaque chantier livré - avant, pendant, après
- Concevez et pilotez des expérimentations SEO et audience organique mesurables, avec hypothèse, protocole et lecture des résultats
- Contribuez à la mesure de notre visibilité dans les environnements IA génératifs - un chantier stratégique que vous aiderez à définir et instrumenter
- Détectez et qualifiez les évolutions des algorithmes via les patterns de données - proactivement

Vous avez 6 à 8 ans d'expérience en data analyse, avec une compréhension technique solide des mécaniques SEO (crawl, indexation, ranking).

Vous maîtrisez Python et SQL, et avez une expérience concrète avec les APIs GSC, BigQuery ou DuckDB. Vous comprenez les mécaniques de crawl, d'indexation et de ranking - pas pour les appliquer opérationnellement, mais pour savoir quoi mesurer et comment l'interpréter. Vous savez rendre vos analyses lisibles pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.

Vous avez une curiosité active pour le GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) et les méthodologies de mesure de visibilité dans les réponses IA.

À l'aise avec les outils d'IA dans votre workflow quotidien, notamment Claude et Claude Code - nous attendons quelqu'un qui augmente sa productivité par l'IA, pas qui s'y initie

Une expérience en environnement éditorial à fort volume (>500k URLs) est un vrai atout.

- Télétravail possible à hauteur de 3 jours / semaine.
