jobs.title: Research Analyst - Cyberspace Operations
jobs.description:
Apply your analytical skills to support the Department of War’s assessments of full-spectrum cyberspace operations. Provide rigorous independent analysis and insights to key decision-makers in the Department and Congress to ensure that the warfighting enterprise is secure, resilient, and mission-capable. Make a tangible impact with great pay and benefits.

About IDA

This position is part of IDA’s Operational Evaluation Division (OED), located in Alexandria, VA, just outside Washington, D.C. IDA is a non-profit, federally funded research and development center (FFRDC) that delivers objective, rigorous analysis on the nation’s toughest national security, technology, and science policy challenges. Our work is team-based, multi-disciplinary, and deeply impactful to national defense.

What does research look like in this position?

Plan, design, observe, and analyze assessments of full-spectrum cyberspace operations within the Department of War. Define data needs and analysis and reporting methods.
Work independently, in small teams, and collaboratively with government sponsors, to advocate for operationally realistic cyber assessments, ensuring that military systems are resilient and that forces can achieve and sustain dominance in the cyberspace domain.
Develop firsthand knowledge of cyberspace operations by participating in Department-wide planning and attending assessment events.
Conduct independent, in-depth analyses of assessment results to assess the ability of equipped combat forces to conduct realistic operations in contested, threat-representative conditions.
Present findings to mid- and senior-level officials (e.g., presidential appointees, generals, admirals, etc.) through oral presentations and written reports.

What qualifications and skill-sets do you need?

Required:

Candidate must meet one of the following education/experience combinations:
PhD in a STEM field (such as Physics, Chemistry, Applied Mathematics, Engineering (such Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Chemical Engineering), Computer Science, or Operations Research), or any other data-intensive research field; OR
Masters degree (same fields as above) along with 6+ years of work experience in research, system design/engineering, or system operations; OR
Master's degree (same fields as above) combined with military experience in cyberspace operations or cybersecurity-related fields

Have an interest in learning fundamentals of cybersecurity, cyberspace operations, and the implications of operating in contested cyberspace.
Proficiency with compilation and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data
Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.
Availability to travel approximately 25% time.
Successful completion of a background check is required.
Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred:

Prior military, DoW acquisition, test and evaluation, and/or assessment experience.
Knowledgeable in cyberspace domain awareness or cybersecurity.
Experience with software or programming languages used in research, engineering, testing, and analysis automation (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB).

Why work at IDA?

Comprehensive benefits including diverse health insurance options, generous 10% contribution to retirement, maternity/paternity leave, 20 days paid time off, and relocation assistance;
Mission-oriented work at a non-profit that supports and protects our warfighters; as a non-profit, IDA employees are eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSFL);
Professional development including tuition reimbursement, internal and external trainings, and funding for researcher-pitched projects and publications;
A strong employee and corporate culture of work-life balance.
Organization-wide commitment to diversity in the workplace and providing a working environment free from discrimination, by fostering a culture of active citizenship and implementing data-driven processes of continuous feedback and learning.
Flat corporate structure that encourages collaboration and ability to choose your own projects.
A brand-new facility located in Alexandria’s high-tech corridor in Potomac Yard; amenities include gym, and close proximity to local dining and shopping; and
Easy access to Potomac Yard Metro stop and Potomac Yard DASH bus stop. Employer contributes $340/month (IRS max) to commuter benefits.

What are the next steps?

Complete the application and submit your resume.
The application process consists of three interviews.

A short screening call with HR;
A 30 min – 60 min screening call with researchers; and
Full day interview with various researchers and staff; includes giving an hour presentation on a research project.
Prior to the full day interview, you will be asked to provide:

Transcripts (unofficial accepted);
3 letters of recommendation; and
A writing sample.

Identity Intelligence Analyst

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing our government is no longer how to get more data – it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our nation’s leaders.

As an Identity Intelligence Analyst for the U.S. Army Europe Africa team, you'll bring strategic, operational intel analyst experience leveraging all sources of information to collaborate and coordinate planning and activities at an Army Service Component Command in support of real-world operations in Europe and Africa. You’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client address challenging digital forensic challenges. You’ll validate the information and develop tradecraft, as you build assessments for senior policymakers. This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skillset into areas like digital forensics, and media exploitation. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have the resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our nation’s leaders and policymakers.

Information Security Analyst, Security Trust

Location: Remote, United States

Department: Information Security

Reports To: Manager, Security Trust

About Alteryx

At Alteryx, Security and Trust are foundational to how we help organizations use data, analytics, and artificial intelligence with confidence. Our Information Security organization partners across the business to protect our customers, employees, products, and global ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale.

The Security Trust team helps build confidence in Alteryx by supporting security assurance activities across customers, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders. We operate as a global team supporting the organization around the clock, using scalable processes, reusable knowledge, automation, and artificial intelligence to meet the needs of a fast-moving business.

Position Overview

The Information Security Analyst, Security Trust supports security assurance workflows across the Information Security organization. This includes customer security reviews, Trust Center operations, third-party risk assessments, vendor security reviews, security documentation, evidence management, and operational reporting.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys analyzing security information, communicating clearly, improving processes, and using artificial intelligence tools to reduce manual work. The analyst will have the opportunity to develop across multiple areas of Security Trust, with room to grow more deeply into customer trust, third-party risk management, or broader security assurance operations over time.

What You'll Do

Support global Security Trust operations across customer trust, third-party risk, and security assurance workflows.
Respond to customer security questionnaires, vendor assessments, due diligence requests, and requests for security documentation.
Ensure customer-facing responses are accurate, evidence-based, consistent with approved messaging, and aligned with Alteryx Security, Legal, Privacy, Product, and Compliance positions.
Translate technical security, privacy, compliance, and product information into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate responses for customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Review security artifacts including SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certifications, PCI DSS attestations, HIPAA security documentation, penetration testing reports, risk assessments, policies, procedures, and security questionnaires.
Help evaluate security risks, document findings, and recommend practical remediation or risk treatment options.
Maintain and improve reusable security content, including Trust Center materials, standard responses, knowledge articles, playbooks, internal documentation, evidence repositories, and AI-enabled knowledge bases.

Support internal and external audit readiness by organizing evidence and maintaining accurate security documentation.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve self-service, reduce turnaround time, and scale Security Trust operations globally.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the broader Information Security organization.

Artificial Intelligence & Automation

Artificial intelligence is a core part of how the Security Trust team operates and scales. Success in this role requires a passion for leveraging AI to improve productivity, quality, and consistency while maintaining strong security and governance practices.

You Will

Use approved AI tools to accelerate questionnaire completion, vendor assessments, evidence collection, document generation, content maintenance, and security analysis.
Develop reusable prompts, workflows, and knowledge assets that improve consistency and reduce manual effort across the team.
Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve operational efficiency.
Validate AI-generated outputs for technical accuracy, completeness, consistency, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.
Measure and improve the effectiveness of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining human oversight and accountability.
Help drive adoption of AI-enabled processes that improve the experience of customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

2 to 5 years of experience in Information Security, Security Assurance, Customer Trust, Third Party Risk Management, Governance, Risk, and Compliance, or a related discipline.

Strong written, verbal, analytical, and organizational skills.
Demonstrated curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI and automation to improve security operations.

Experience with Conveyor, SafeBase, Vanta, or similar Trust Center platforms.
Experience with third-party risk management platforms.
Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience using artificial intelligence and workflow automation in security operations.
Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSK, CTPRP).

Expand reusable Trust Center content.
Mature scalable Security Trust workflows.
Leverage artificial intelligence to reduce manual effort.

Support a security program that enables business growth while maintaining strong security standards.

Job Description

Job Title – Trade Operations Analyst

Location: Dublin

Duration: Permanent

Working Hours: Standard GMT (08:30am-5:00pm)

The Expertise
We’re Looking For

3 years of financial services experience, preferably with exposure to Custody Operations and/or Trade/Fixed Income Life Cycle management.
2 years of experience, in Trade Life Cycle, Settlements or Fails Management.
Experience with OMGEO Alert, CTM, CLS, Finastra preferred.

The Purpose
of Your Role

This position will be responsible for the day-to-day activities ensuring all trade confirmation and settlement processes, reporting, and inquiry responses are completed timely and accurately for the Fidelity Trading Desks (Equity, Fixed Income and FX) activities. This person will possess a full understanding of Fidelity’s organizational structure, information flow and internal systems, as well as good industry knowledge pertaining to trading and settlement of equity, and foreign currency (non USD) exchanges. They should be able to identify, analyse, and resolve complex issues or potential operational risk that may arise and effectively communicate with any party that may be involved.

The Skills
You Bring

Experience with industry practices and tools.
Detailed knowledge of market settlement practices.
Operational knowledge in FX settlement
Proficient skills in various software applications to include, Excel, Word, Power point, Outlook
Excellent interpersonal and communications skills.
Working knowledge of agile methodologies
Strong time management skills.
Strong attention to detail
Strong data analytical skills.
Must be able to recognize high-risk items and escalate those items or seek assistance to minimize loss to either the shareholder and/or Fidelity.
Must have the ability to develop solid action plans to resolve daily operational issues/problems.

The Value
You Deliver

Monitoring transactional confirmation, fails resolution, escrow activity and settlement.
Communicate issues and take initiative to proactively resolve and prevent problems
Perform market-specific processes to ensure confirmation and settlement in challenging foreign markets
Communicate with internal Equity / FX Trading Desks, Broker, Custodian Banks, and other business partners to ensure operational challenges are managed
Participate as a Subject Matter Expert on projects
Ability to work effectively within a team environment to successfully manage daily work volumes and quality standards
Works with Manager and Team Leads to identify process improvements
Ensure that all responsibilities/assignments are performed in a timely fashion
Deliver effective written and verbal communication to appropriate business partners

How Your Work Impacts
the Organization

The Global Middle Office (GMO) acts as a servicing centre for FMR Co. and FIAM trading desks globally, facilitating the confirmation and settlement of security and currency transactions with brokers and custodian banks, and providing daily cash estimates to Trading. It is also responsible for coordinating corporate action executions, ensuring the collection of income to the Funds, resolving position differences and facilitating securities lending activities.

Trade Operations provides trade support to Fidelity's domestic and international equity, fixed income, high yield and foreign exchange trading desks located in Hong Kong, London and Boston.. Trade analysts work closely with the traders, broker-dealer community and the custodian bank network to facilitate trade matching and settlement in over 70 countries worldwide. In addition to the various external counterparts that the trade analysts deals with, there are also several internal groups that assist in the group's daily responsibilities, including Compliance, Treasurer's Office, Counterparty Risk, Legal, Fund Accounting and other Custody groups.

Company Overview

At Fidelity, we are focused on making our financial expertise broadly accessible and effective in helping people live the lives they want. We are a privately held company that places a high degree of value in creating and nurturing a work environment that attracts the best talent and reflects our commitment to our associates. Fidelity established an Ireland presence in 1996 and we currently employ 1000 staff across IT and shared services, with offices in Dublin (City West) and Galway (Parkmore East).

For information about working at Fidelity, visit www.fidelityinvestments.ie.

Fidelity Investments is an equal opportunity employer.

A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Accelerate your career with us

The Funding & Securities Operations Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the operational execution, settlement oversight, and risk management of fixed income securities, debt issuance activities, and funding transactions. This position is responsible for end-to-end settlement support, fail management, TMPG compliance, new issue funding operations, underwriting support, and operational risk oversight across brokered CDs, bank notes, Treasury securities, and other fixed income products.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Treasury, Funding, Capital Markets, Trading, Middle Office, Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations teams, and external counterparties to ensure transactions settle accurately, funding obligations are met, regulatory requirements are satisfied, and operational risks are proactively mitigated.

Key Responsibilities

Securities Settlement, Fail Management & TMPG Oversight

Monitor daily settlement activity and identify failed or at-risk securities transactions across fixed income and government securities products.
Lead investigation, escalation, and resolution of settlement fails and operational exceptions.
Monitor aged fails and implement escalation protocols based on financial, operational, counterparty, and regulatory impact.
Engage with counterparties, custodians, clearing organizations, and internal partners to resolve settlement issues.
Support compliance with Treasury Market Practices Group (TMPG) requirements, including fail charge monitoring, validation, reconciliation, and dispute resolution.
Review fail trends, settlement performance, and exception activity to identify opportunities for risk reduction and process enhancement.
Maintain documentation supporting fail investigations, settlements, TMPG activity, and control evidence.

Funding & New Issue Operations

Manage the operational lifecycle of brokered certificates of deposit (CDs), bank notes, and other debt issuance transactions.
Coordinate underwriting and funding activities across Treasury, Finance, Capital Markets, Legal, Operations, and external issuing agents.
Review transaction documentation and settlement requirements to ensure operational readiness and timely execution.
Monitor issuance pipelines and funding calendars to support successful transaction settlement.
Support onboarding of new funding programs, structures, products, and issuance capabilities.
Ensure funding transactions are executed within established deadlines and operational requirements.

Settlement & Wire Controls

Review and validate wire instructions, settlement details, payment routing information, and beneficiary data.
Establish and maintain settlement instructions, approved templates, and payment controls.
Coordinate with Treasury, correspondent banks, trustees, custodians, and external agents to ensure accurate and timely delivery of funding proceeds.
Investigate and resolve wire exceptions, rejected payments, settlement discrepancies, and funding delays.
Maintain documentation supporting approvals, validations, settlements, and payment processing activities.

Risk Management & Controls

Maintain a strong control framework supporting settlement activity, funding operations, and debt issuance processes.
Escalate material settlement, funding, liquidity, operational, or reputational risks to leadership and key stakeholders.
Support audits, compliance reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk management inquiries.
Ensure adherence to internal policies, procedures, and control standards.
Develop and maintain process documentation, desktop procedures, escalation protocols, and control evidence.

Analytics, Reporting & Process Improvement

Develop and maintain reporting related to settlement performance, fail activity, funding transactions, underwriting operations, and operational exceptions.
Analyze trends across fails, funding delays, wire rejections, operational breaks, and settlement exceptions.
Perform root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and opportunities for remediation.
Track operational performance metrics and remediation efforts to measure improvements and reduce risk.
Partner with Technology and Operations teams to implement automation, process simplification, and enhanced controls.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Support

Serve as a key operational contact for Funding, Treasury, Trading, Capital Markets, Finance, Risk, Technology, and external counterparties.
Provide transparency on significant settlement and funding issues, including financial and operational impacts.
Participate in governance discussions related to settlement effectiveness, funding operations, operational risk, and control enhancement.
Support new product initiatives, business changes, and operational readiness assessments.
Collaborate across teams to improve client, counterparty, and business partner experience while strengthening operational performance.

Schedule & Location

📍 Location:
Saint Paul & Charlotte

🕒 Schedule:
Monday–Friday | 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. local time

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
Typically six or more years of related experience

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience supporting fixed income operations, securities settlements, funding operations, treasury operations, capital markets, broker-dealer operations, or debt issuance activities.
Knowledge of Treasury securities, TMPG fail charge requirements, fixed income settlement processes, and funding operations.
Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, exception management, and reconciliation processes.

Our data team sits at the heart of that transformation, serving as the analytical engine that powers the entire business. From architecting the data models that drive risk and capital allocation to delivering the reporting and insights that guide growth strategy and operational excellence, we ensure every department has the intelligence needed to win.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a vital driver of our growth and product evolution, partnering closely with Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering to optimize the borrower journey. Your work will directly influence how we acquire customers, the efficiency of our loan application funnel, and the long-term value of our customer base.

You will bridge the gap between user behavior and business strategy, combining analytical rigor with product intuition to help leaders understand the "how" and "why" behind the customer experience. While your primary focus is on the front-end growth engine, you are a generalist at heart—capable of architecting data models that serve the entire organization’s need for clear, actionable intelligence from top-of-funnel to capital allocation.

What You’ll Do

Data Modeling & Architecture: Design and implement robust data models that transform fragmented marketing spend and application event logs into structured, "gold-standard" datasets. You will ensure our product and acquisition data is clean, organized, and optimized for cross-functional use.
Funnel Optimization: Build and maintain scalable frameworks to monitor the loan application funnel—identifying friction points, drop-off behaviors, and opportunities to improve conversion from lead to funded loan.
Technical Impact: Elevate our analytics toolkit by writing high-performance BigQuery SQL and designing intuitive Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to track KPIs like CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), Approval Rates, and Origination Volume in real-time.
Experimental Design: Partner with Product and Marketing to design, execute, and analyze A/B tests, ensuring we make evidence-based decisions on everything from landing page optimization to credit offer presentation.
Cross-Functional Insight: Act as the analytical backbone for the business, translating complex user behaviors into repeatable, automated insights that drive measurable growth and product-market fit.

What We Look For

3–5+ years of experience using data to drive measurable business impact, specifically within Growth, Product Analytics, or Marketing Science.
Deep proficiency in SQL (preferably BigQuery); you are an expert at handling complex joins and window functions to reconstruct user journeys across marketing touchpoints and loan applications.
Advanced Data Modeling: Proven ability to design and maintain structured datasets (star schemas, dbt models) that turn messy clickstream and CRM data into reliable tables for the entire business.
Expertise with Tableau: You don’t just report data; you build intuitive dashboards that help managers visualize cohort performance, attribution models, and funnel velocity.
Statistical Depth: Strong grasp of statistical concepts like survival analysis (to model time-to-repayment or time-to-next-loan), causal inference, and significance testing.
Fintech/Lending Context: Understanding of the lending lifecycle—from initial acquisition through underwriting to funding—and how product changes impact portfolio quality.
Communication: Clear, confident ability to translate complex data trends into actionable stories for both technical teams and executive leadership.
Adaptability: A generalist mindset—you are comfortable navigating the ambiguity of a fast-moving environment and can apply your analytical toolkit to solve problems across different business domains.
Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.

jobs.title: Quality Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Turtlebox Audio

The first Turtlebox was born out of necessity. After breaking every “loud” product on the market through routine outdoor use, the idea of the Turtlebox was born in our garage, not as a business but just for personal use. Nothing else could get the job done.

Most portable speakers aren’t actually meant for the outdoors and can’t withstand the elements, the ones that can aren’t loud enough to be heard. When you’re at the beach or on an ATV, you need sound to carry in order to hear it over the wind, waves, and boat engines, you need a Turtlebox.

We soon realized that there was a huge need for the Turtlebox among likeminded adventurers and our journey began to set out to make the world’s loudest most rugged outdoor portable speaker.

Click here for a peek inside our workplace!

Role Overview

The Quality Data Analyst turns quality data into decisions. This role analyzes the company’s quality data, including warranty return rates, customer feedback, product reviews, and factory operational KPIs, to identify trends, uncover root causes, and drive improvements in products, operational processes, and business strategy.

Working closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations, Customer Service, and Supply Chain teams, the analyst builds dashboards that give clear visibility into how current systems and products are performing, designs experiments to determine the best configurations or operational changes, and applies predictive modeling to improve customer experience, operational excellence, and other business outcomes. The analyst tracks quality performance over time and delivers clear, data-backed recommendations to stakeholders at every level of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Data analysis and preparation

Collect, combine, and analyze quality data from multiple sources, such as warranty claims, returns and RMA records, customer service tickets, product reviews, factory inspection results, and supplier data.
Review data structures and identify errors, inconsistencies, and gaps before analysis begins.
Clean and prepare data by correcting errors, removing duplicates, and handling missing values, documenting each step so results are repeatable.
Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in failure modes, defect rates, and return reasons, and dig into the root causes behind them.

Validation and testing

Run validation checks to confirm data meets business rules and quality standards.
Build and maintain automated data quality checks so issues are caught early rather than discovered in reports.
Design and run experiments (A/B tests, process trials, design-of-experiments studies) to evaluate proposed product or operational changes and measure their impact.

Dashboard development and reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards that give leadership and cross-functional teams real-time visibility into quality performance, from the factory floor to the customer’s hands.
Automate recurring reports (weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews) to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.
Translate complex findings into clear, concise summaries and visuals for both technical and non-technical audiences.

KPI monitoring and predictive analytics

Track key quality metrics such as warranty return rates, customer returns, defect rates, first-pass yield, and other operational KPIs, and flag negative trends early.
Build predictive models to forecast warranty exposure, anticipate emerging product issues, and support proactive decisions that improve customer experience and operational excellence.
Set baselines and targets for quality KPIs in partnership with Quality and Operations leadership.

Cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement

Partner with Engineering, Operations, and suppliers to investigate quality issues and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Share insights from customer feedback and field returns with Product Development to inform future designs.
Provide data-driven recommendations and follow up to measure whether implemented changes delivered the expected results.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, preferably in consumer goods, consumer electronics, or a related industry.
Strong proficiency in SQL, plus experience with a scripting or programming language (such as Python or R) for data analysis.
Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (such as Power BI or Tableau) and building dashboards for business users.
Solid knowledge of statistical techniques and concepts (regression, probability distributions, hypothesis testing and their proper use) and experience applying them to real business problems.
Experience working in a fulfillment, production, or other operational environment.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail.

Preferred

Familiarity with quality tools and methodologies such as Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), 8D, or root cause analysis.
Experience analyzing warranty, returns, or customer feedback data, including text analysis of reviews or service tickets.
Experience with predictive modeling or machine learning techniques.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and to work independently.

The firm delivers equity, fixed income, and alternative investments to intermediaries, high net worth individuals, institutions and other charitable and non-profit organizations with the goal of providing a positive impact while meeting the financial needs of our clients.

Job Summary

Trillium is seeking an Equity Research Analyst to join its investment team in Boston. This role will support Trillium’s central research function by conducting high-quality company and sector research, identifying attractive long-term investment opportunities, and contributing to the Approved List used by Portfolio Managers across strategies. The analyst will cover two to three sectors based on experience and team needs, with preferred expertise in Information Technology, Financials, Real Estate, or Communication Services. The successful candidate will bring strong fundamental research, financial modeling, valuation, and communication skills, along with the ability to integrate sustainability considerations into investment analysis. Duties And Responsibilities

Conduct fundamental equity research on companies and sectors, integrating financial analysis and sustainability considerations into investment conclusions.

Experience with Microsoft Office, Bloomberg, FactSet, MSCI, or similar research and data platforms.

The expected base salary range for this position is $170,000 to $200,000, with eligibility for a performance-based bonus. jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

Join our Corporate Communications team as an Insight Research Analyst Senior
. This role will support the Communications and Public Affairs office.

This role functions as a strategic partner in designing, developing, executing, and analyzing research projects for short- and long-term business goals and results. Leads and facilitates cross-functional teams in the application of the appropriate research methodologies (i.e., qualitative, quantitative, text or business intelligence), design innovation, marketing strategies, and general industry trends to understand member insights and translate findings into business strategies. Business recommendations can be based on quantitative or qualitative data, understanding the underlying assumptions of each and their relative impact to address the business problem.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Charlotte, NC, Colorado Springs, CO, and Tampa, FL.

Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Leads, facilitates and/or collaborates with cross functional teams and vendors in support of the end-to-end research project(s).
Determines the appropriate research methodologies, design innovation, marketing strategies and general industry trends to solve business problems within specific areas of expertise.
Applies advanced level of knowledge in conducting research using the appropriate methodology (quantitative, qualitative, text or business intelligence). Examples include surveys, usability tests, focus groups, in-depth interviews, and ethnographical studies.
Formulates findings into business recommendations and presents findings to various levels of leadership.
Mentors and provides guidance to peers and team members; navigates through obstacles to resolve escalated issues of an unusual nature.
Researches and identifies industry best practices and trends to increase effectiveness.
Acquires, maintains, and applies advanced knowledge of the business, its products and processes, and advanced knowledge of qualitative or quantitative research methodologies to represent member sentiment across products, channels, and experiences.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
6 years of experience in member/customer focused market research, marketing, or consulting experience to include quantitative analytics and insight OR Advanced Degree, 4 years of experience in member/customer focused market research, marketing, or consulting experience to include quantitative analytics and insight.
Demonstrated leadership experience to include leading projects.
Advanced knowledge of qualitative or quantitative research methodologies, relevant research tools, and knowledge of relevant industry data sources.
Experience conducting research using the appropriate methodology (quantitative, qualitative, text or business intelligence). Examples include surveys, usability tests, focus groups, in-depth interviews, and ethnographical studies.
Advanced analytical skills with proven ability to interpret data and link insights to growth opportunities.
Proven ability to influence through data while maintaining compliance and regulatory standards.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

What Sets You Apart

Prior U.S. military service or being a military spouse/domestic partner is highly valued.
Expertise in synthesizing research and data into clear, actionable insights through advanced reporting and data visualization, enabling leaders to make informed business decisions.

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $103,450 - $197,730.

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation:
USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits:
At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Responsible for developing, preparing, interpreting, and monitoring moderate–to–complex health process and outcomes data analyses, projections, data modeling, and reports used by system management in decision-making. Develops, implements, and monitors reporting and analysis solutions from multiple databases to ensure efficient processing, up-to-date tools, improved patient experience, and clinical and operational efficiencies. Serves as an expert resource to provide reporting and analysis guidance and support. Responsible for weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad-hoc reports design and distribution.

Essential Job Functions

Collaborate with various health system stakeholders to design and develop data models and reporting solutions for quality, patient safety, patient satisfaction, and health system operations.
Develop and incorporate clinical service line and department patient experience, clinical, quality, and operational reports, scorecards, and databases utilized to improve clinical and operational processes. Work collaboratively with other teams to provide analytical support to periodic quality reporting to external parties (Press Ganey, CMS, Vizient, Leapfrog, etc.), including data validation, discrepancy analysis, market referencing, and benchmark establishment.
Responsible for the collection, analysis, and reporting of data from multiple data sources to create actionable reports and knowledge for peers and leadership. Abstract information for decision support purposes, including service-line reporting and other duties as may be identified to assist decision-making.

Monitor adherence to data standards, support clients with a broad range of technical expertise, and provide technical and end-user documentation. Prepare and assist in the presentation of the strategic process and outcomes metrics.
Assist in developing ETL (Extraction, Transformation, and Loading) processes to acquire and load data from internal and external sources.
Extract, interpret, analyze, and prepare presentations of such information for senior management (e.g., patient experience, service line, DRG, and physician profiling).
Assists with data for implementing patient experience and quality improvement processes and initiatives. Research other qualified outside benchmark data for comparison to internal benchmarks. Manage and design reports and benchmarking results clearly and concisely, and process and interpret report data for decision-making effectively and efficiently. Skill a database and query design and development for modeling and reporting.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel spreadsheets and Access.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

Self-starter who works well alone and in a team.

Job Summary and Department Description

The Digital Solutions Project Manager is a key role in the digital transformation of Avant Healthcare Professionals. The role will oversee projects in the digital transformation program, as well as develop project management practice. The Digital Solutions Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering cross-functional projects that advance the company’s technology modernization and digitization priorities. This role translates strategic initiatives into structured project plans, establishes clear governance, manages risks, and supports the adoption of new technologies, with projects that will encompass operational integrations, automation, mobile applications, and AI-enabled tools. The Digital Solutions Project Manager partners with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered within scope, budget, and schedule. This role will champion project management best practices within the organization and educate and enforce project management best practices in a vibrant environment.

Essential Functions of the Job

Manage the end-to-end delivery of technology, digitization, automation, integration, and business process improvement projects from initiation through implementation and closeout 
Create and maintain project charters, scope, schedules, milestones, budgets, resource plans, risk and issue logs, decision logs, and status reports 
Interact with senior management on project risks, options, and status; identifying, assessing and managing project risks, dependencies, issues, constraints, change requests, and escalating matters requiring leadership decisions
Translate business needs into clear project requirements, process maps, success measures, and implementation plans in partnership with business and technical stakeholders 
Provide timely, audience-appropriate project and portfolio reporting to the VP, executive sponsors, project teams, and other stakeholders 
Support responsible AI, data quality, privacy, cybersecurity, document retention, and compliance requirements within assigned projects 
Use waterfall, agile, scrum, or hybrid delivery practices based on project needs and maintain consistent PMO standards and documentation 
Coordinate vendor deliverables, project dependencies, service commitments, and roadmap activities in partnership with the senior management and internal stakeholders 
Partner with VP, Technology & Digital Solutions to support project governance, portfolio visibility, prioritization, and alignment with the technology roadmap and organizational goals

Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO methodologies, templates, SOPs, governance practices, and lessons learned
Partner and build relationships with business owners, Learning & Development, and other stakeholders on change management, communications, training, adoption, and digital enablement activities

Other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
Dave vs. Goliath. We’re Dave.

Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave’s digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave’s offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option.

Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most.

Dave is hiring a Marketing Project Manager to own the vendor, contract, and systems operations that keep our Marketing team moving. You'll be the connective tissue between our agencies, vendors, Legal, and Marketing teams.

The Opportunity

As Marketing's Project Manager, you'll be the day-to-day point of contact for vendor contract management, agency management, and systems and workflow management. You'll partner with Marketing managers, Project Management, and Legal to keep contracts on schedule and ensure we have the right workflow structures in place. We'll count on you to spot friction in our workflows and fix it, including piloting AI-assisted tools that take repetitive work off the team's plate.

What You Build & Own

Vendor relationships, end-to-end. Serve as the primary contact for vendor information requests, diligence forms, and contract logistics so partners onboard quickly and stay compliant.
Contractor, talent, and creator logistics. Source, onboard, and schedule contractors and freelancers; coordinate agency, talent, and creator/influencer partnerships, including fulfillment and work with our User Acquisition team.
Asset and repository management. Keep marketing assets organized in our digital asset management (DAM) system and pull materials by date range on demand.
Audit requests. Own the fulfillment of audit requests, working with Legal and Marketing managers to pull and organize relevant documentation.
Systems and workflow. Maintain and improve our project management systems, and pilot AI-assisted workflows for vendor, invoice, and asset tasks with the Manager of Marketing Operations.

The impact

When vendors and tools are onboarded quickly, and assets are organized and on schedule, our marketers can spend less time on admin and more time reaching the members who count on Dave. You'll make the whole Marketing organization faster.

What We’re Looking For

3-5 years of project management experience
3-5 years in-house or at an agency, working directly in or closely with creative production
Hands-on experience with project management systems such as Jira or Confluence
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the flexibility to adapt to rapid and ongoing change
Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and stay effective under pressure
Resourceful and proactive; you learn quickly and think ahead
Works well with people across many roles, bringing a positive, empathetic approach to managing project teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice-to-have

Experience managing agency or vendor invoicing and contracts
Experience with creator or influencer partnership logistics
Experience using AI tools to automate repetitive operational work

What To Expect

Marketing at Dave moves fast, and priorities shift as we learn what works. You'll have real autonomy over how vendor and production operations run, and we'll expect you to use data like spend, turnaround times, and delivery dates to decide what to fix first. If you like bringing order to ambiguity, you'll thrive here.

Why join Dave

Mission: Help build products that level the financial playing field for everyday Americans.
Scope and growth: Own a function end to end and shape how Marketing works with its partners.
Resources and support: Work alongside experienced Marketing Operations, Legal, and Creative partners.
Meaningful challenges: Modernize core workflows, including with AI, and see the results quickly.

Ready to build for the underdog?

Reports to: Manager, Marketing Operations & Production

Don’t let imposter syndrome get in the way of an incredible opportunity. We’re looking for people who can help us achieve our mission and vision, not just check off the boxes. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Dave, our people are just as important as our product. Our culture reflects the values that guide who we are, how we work, and what we aspire to be. Daves are member-centric, helpful, transparent, persistent, and better together. We strive to create an environment where all Daves feel valued, heard, and empowered to do their best work. As a virtual-first company, team members can live and work anywhere in the United States, except Hawaii.

A Few Of Our Benefits & Perks

💚 Opportunity to tackle tough challenges, learn and grow from fellow top talent, and help millions of people reach their personal financial goals

💻 Flexible hours and virtual-first work culture with a home office stipend

🏥 Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance plans

👶 Generous paid parental and caregiver leave

💰 401(k) savings plan with matching contributions

📈 Financial advisor and financial wellness support

🏖️ Flexible PTO and generous company holidays, including Juneteenth and Winter Break

🎉 All-company in-person events once or twice a year and virtual events throughout to connect with your team members and leadership team

Experience working in a professional services/consulting environment
Experience applying Agile approaches to project management

Experience with estimation/sizing and SOW/Change Order contracting

jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager 
Who We Are
We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.
We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager
to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).
What You'll Do
As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. The Sr. Program Manager reports to the Program Director (or Group Program Director) and will manage Associates and/or Managers. The Sr. PM partners with the Business Supervisor or Business Director to run most Tier 1 or 2 projects. 
Responsibilities
Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.
Drive the end-to-end process for integrated campaigns (film, experiential, digital/social, OOH), ensuring seamless delivery on time and on budget by developing and tracking tactical plans to develop each with a keen understanding of client parameters and objectives. Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules
Partner with Business Leadership counterpart to develop all scope proposals for assigned projects, developing a compelling proposal as well as profitable approach for the agency
Provide strong financial management of assigned accounts including managing all budget allocations, reviewing burn, proactively creating scope change orders (internal and external), proactively suggesting areas for optimization and macro view of out-of-pocket budget tracking
Lead all reporting and reconciliation processes in partnership with finance team 
Help digest all client feedback and lead the team on how we address and action the feedback. Understand and mentor teams on where/when to escalate creative feedback or work reviews to senior leadership 
Build and nurture strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor who understands how to get things done effectively and efficiently leveraging our teams and resources to create innovative and breakthrough creative solutions that solve clients business objectives 
Manage and mentor junior program managers, strategically deploying them across projects and fostering their professional growth.
Collaborate with department leads (account, production, creative, strategy) to assemble the right teams for each initiative, confirm the right allocations and manage overall workforce planning with Resource Management lead
Work closely with production to ensure timelines accommodate production requirements and projects continue to move seamlessly in execution 
Support the Business Lead and Production teams during executional and production phases of creative work to ensure absolute clarity client & media requirements, provide tactical support during production and oversee the successful delivery/traffic assets when required 
Partner with Creative, Production, and Business teams to turn campaign ideas into actionable plans, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track without compromising creative ambition.
Manage and monitor production and creative workflows, proactively identifying risks and driving solutions to keep projects moving smoothly.
Foster clear, integrated ways of working by aligning teams on roles, processes, and communication throughout the creative and production lifecycle.
Proactively identify potential issues or opportunities, keeping teams and clients informed and driving swift, effective solutions.
Oversee the creation of presentation materials that uphold agency standards and resonate with clients’ business objectives.
Participate in new business efforts, contributing to proposals, pitches, and strategic planning to showcase our operational strengths and capabilities
Champion a positive, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, accountability, and a shared passion for producing culturally powerful work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex ideas clearly, accurately, and persuasively.
Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.
Highly organized with exceptional time management and prioritization abilities, balancing multiple workstreams with quality and care.
Passionate about people and culture, with a results-driven approach balanced by genuine curiosity and sensitivity to team dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications
5–7 years of experience managing large-scale brands or programs within a creative agency or related communications environment.
Proven ability to build strong client partnerships that drive long-term growth and mutual success.
Demonstrated expertise managing multi-disciplinary teams across creative, production, and strategy disciplines.
Solid understanding of financial principles as they relate to agency scopes, budgets, and P&L impact.
Experience leading strategic and day-to-day client communications, as well as mentoring junior team members.
Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns, including digital, social, print, and broadcast production.
Comfortable with Google Suite (Sheets and Slides); experience with Monday.com or SmartSheets is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telco or retail categories, or in performance marketing environments.
Background in managing cross-functional agency partners and leading collaborative workstreams.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection & Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings & Program Management
; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers
, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team.

NV5’s Project Delivery Services, a part of Buildings & Program Management, is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Project Manager to serve in an Owner’s Representative role within our multidisciplinary project delivery team. This position will manage complex projects from inception through completion and coordinate architects, engineers, technical specialists, and other professionals across the NV5 platform, as well as outside consultants. The Senior Project Manager will serve as a trusted client advisor, provide strategic and day-to-day direction to integrated project teams, and maintain accountability for delivery consistent with client goals, contractual requirements, budget, schedule, quality, and risk expectations.

This is a hybrid position based in New York City, New York.

Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Owner’s Representation

Serve as the Owner’s Representative and trusted client contact, protecting client interests and guiding decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
Build trusted relationships with client leadership and stakeholders; translate strategic and operational objectives into clear project priorities and delivery requirements.
Lead complex multidisciplinary project teams on behalf of the Owner and NV5, exercising sound judgment and maintaining accountability for scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder alignment.
Develop durable client relationships and lead or materially support business development efforts, including pursuit strategy, proposals, interviews, scoping, and expansion of follow-on work.

Project Management & Delivery

Lead complex projects and programs from early planning and programming through design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
Develop delivery strategies and manage scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk with a high degree of independence in alignment with client goals and contractual requirements.
Establish project communication protocols, escalation paths, and decision-making processes appropriate to project complexity and stakeholder needs.
Coordinate and integrate multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, planners, technical specialists, contractors, and consultants from across the NV5 platform and external partners, clarifying roles, deliverables, interfaces, and accountability.

Design & Construction Oversight

Manage design-phase activities across disciplines to confirm alignment with program requirements, technical interfaces, constructability, budget, schedule, quality, and regulatory standards.
Lead integrated reviews of design deliverables at key milestones, resolve cross-discipline coordination issues, and guide cost-estimating, value-management, and design-to-budget efforts.
Serve as the Owner’s primary project liaison during construction, monitoring progress, quality, safety, and team performance through site observations, project reporting, and meetings.
Evaluate and provide well-supported recommendations regarding RFIs, submittals, change orders, claims, disputes, and other matters with material cost, schedule, technical, or contractual implications.

Project Controls & Financial Management

Establish and maintain project controls, including integrated schedules, budgets, cash-flow forecasts, performance metrics, and client reporting.
Anticipate, quantify, communicate, and mitigate schedule, cost, technical, contractual, and performance risks before they affect project outcomes.
Manage the development and reconciliation of cost estimates, contingency strategies, and forecasts at key design and construction milestones.
Review and recommend approval of pay applications, invoices, change orders, and financial commitments, providing clear analysis of impacts and available options.

Regulatory, Permitting & Documentation Oversight

Develop regulatory and permitting strategies and coordinate entitlements, permits, and approvals from Authorities Having Jurisdiction.
Lead coordination with public agencies, user groups, community representatives, and other stakeholders on complex or sensitive project matters.
Maintain comprehensive project documentation, records management, decision logs, and reporting, and promote consistent team compliance.

Closeout, Occupancy & Transition

Plan and lead project closeout, including punch lists, commissioning, inspections, final acceptance, and resolution of outstanding contractual and technical matters.
Coordinate multidisciplinary move-in, occupancy, training, systems activation, and operational transition activities to support a successful handoff.
Ensure timely financial reconciliation, contract closeout, lessons learned, and turnover of warranties, record documents, and operational information.

Internal Management & Mentorship

Manage internal project performance, including staffing coordination, workload planning, fee and contract management, invoicing, accounts receivable, profitability, and forecast accuracy.
Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and quality oversight to project managers, coordinators, and technical team members; delegate effectively and support accountability for results.
Contribute to multidisciplinary delivery practices across NV5 by sharing lessons learned and supporting improvements to tools, standards, resource coordination, and training.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

Establish credibility as a trusted Owner’s Representative and project advisor for assigned clients.
Lead complex multidisciplinary assignments through key milestones with clear accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.
Demonstrate strong project financial stewardship, reliable forecasting, and timely escalation and resolution of material issues.
Build effective working relationships across NV5 disciplines and regions, creating integrated teams that deliver coordinated solutions.
Strengthen project team capability through mentoring, delegation, quality oversight, and consistent use of project delivery standards.
Support NV5 growth in local and strategic markets through client relationships, cross-selling, and participation in pursuits and market activities.

Qualifications
Specific Knowledge & Skills

Advanced proficiency in project budgeting, scheduling, forecasting, project controls, financial management, and delivery planning for complex assignments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to advise clients, facilitate difficult decisions, and present clear recommendations.
Demonstrated project leadership, independent judgment, negotiation, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and risk-management abilities.
Strong knowledge of design and construction processes, consultant coordination, contracts, procurement, and multiple project delivery methods.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams, integrate technical workstreams, manage interfaces between disciplines, and promote accountability among internal and external contributors.
Proficiency with MS Office, Bluebeam, and common project management, scheduling, financial, and collaboration tools.
Ability to travel as required by project assignments; travel percentage will vary based on project location.

Requirements

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture, engineering, project management, facilities management, or a related field preferred.
Project experience in Mission Critical/Data Center sectors preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible experience managing design and construction projects, including substantial responsibility for complex, multidisciplinary assignments.
Demonstrated experience leading project teams, working independently, managing client relationships, and taking responsibility for project financial performance and delivery outcomes.
Demonstrated experience coordinating architects, engineers, contractors, technical specialists, and other disciplines across organizational or geographic boundaries.
Established professional network within the Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Development industry in the Northeast and across the United States.
Professional registration (Professional Engineer, Registered Architect, etc.) or project management certification (PMP, CCM) strongly preferred.

The pay range for this position in New York is up to $180,000; however, base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, dependent on the position offered. This information is provided in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay Act.

NV5 provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Benefits

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance

Company paid Life & AD&D

NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: to shape and strengthen the physical world.

Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as one team
across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.

At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

About the Role

We're seeking a Technical Project Manager to join our digital team and drive technical projects from conception to deployment. In this role, you'll bridge the gap between development teams and stakeholders, manage agile workflows, and ensure successful delivery of software and digital integration projects. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a technical background who wants to grow their project management skills while staying connected to hands-on development work.

This role is for individuals able to work in our New York Office and will be working on digital marketing products that include the Bravo website, NBC Insider, Peacock Blog and NBC Affiliate Marketing websites. The Technical Project manager will facilitate technical integrations with internal NBC Platforms, 3rd Party vendors and help with AI integrations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end coordination of technical projects including web applications, API integrations, and digital platform implementations
Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog grooming
Create and maintain sprint plans, user stories, and technical documentation
Serve as the primary liaison between development teams, product owners, editorial teams and stakeholders
Track project progress using agile metrics and tools, identifying and resolving blockers
Maintain project tracking systems in Airtable or similar platforms, ensuring accurate sprint velocity and burndown metrics
Review technical specifications and provide input on feasibility and timelines
Find and grow opportunities in the AI and Agentic AI space, working with internal AI Taskforces and staying ahead of the curve on the latest developments.
Support QA processes and coordinate deployment schedules
Identify opportunities to streamline development workflows and improve team efficiency

Qualifications

Basic Requirements:

3+ years of experience in technical project coordination, software development, or related technical role
Light coding experience (HTML/JSON, JavaScript, Python, Selenium or similar) with ability to understand technical discussions
Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and technical integration concepts
Familiarity with Scrum or Agile methodologies
Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple technical projects simultaneously
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (Jira, Airtable, Asana, Trello, Github, or similar)
Comfortable working in fast-paced technical environments with shifting priorities

Desired Characteristics:

Experience as a Scrum Master or in an Agile Project Manager role
Hands-on experience with Analytic Tools (Adobe, mParticle) REST APIs, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys), and integration workflows
Proficiency with Git/version control concepts and workflows
Working knowledge of Airtable, including automations, and API usage
Experience with content management systems (CMS), Drupal a Plus
Bonus: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Bonus: Understanding of database concepts and data modeling
Bonus: Scrum Master Certification (CSM) or similar agile certification
Bonus: Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field or experience.

What You Will Bring

Technical curiosity and ability to quickly understand new systems and technologies
Strong problem-solving skills and analytical mindset
Collaborative approach to working with engineering teams
Proactive communication style that keeps all team members informed
Flexibility to adapt processes as project requirements evolve
AI First attitude with a passion for continuous improvement and learning new technical skills
Ability to balance technical precision with business priorities

This position offers growth potential within our digital team and opportunities to develop both technical expertise and project management leadership skills across diverse technical initiatives.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid
