jobs.title: Workplace Portfolio, Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
We Do Consulting Differently

Job Summary

The Workplace Portfolio, Sr. Project Manager leads complex projects across BRG’s global workplace portfolio and owns defined programs that improve capital planning and project delivery. The role combines hands-on responsibility for office expansions, relocations, and renovations with portfolio analysis and executive recommendations. Program ownership includes workplace standards and governance, delivery tools and playbooks, and strategic process improvement.

Working with the Head of Workplace Portfolio, this person translates business needs into practical options, maintains reliable project controls, and develops consistent delivery practices across locations. The role exercises independent judgment within approved scope and budgets. Portfolio strategy, capital allocation, and lease or contractual commitments remain subject to established leadership and legal approvals.

Reports to: Head of Workplace Portfolio

Role: Senior individual contributor; no direct reports

Travel required: 25–50% domestic and international.

Duties And Responsibilities

Project Delivery

Act as BRG’s owner’s representative for assigned workplace projects, directing external project teams and managing delivery from market surveys and site selection through design, construction, commissioning, and occupancy, including furniture, workplace technology, and relocations. Exercise this responsibility within approved scope, budgets, and authority.
Direct architects, engineers, contractors, and other project providers. Lead procurement, bid evaluations, scope development, and vendor negotiations in coordination with Legal and other required approvers.
Adapt project delivery to local market conditions, regulatory requirements, and procurement practices, coordinating with regional partners and required internal approvers.
Review test fits and construction documents, conduct site inspections, and coordinate technology, security, and building-system requirements.
Manage operational handoff and closeout, including readiness checks, as-built documents, warranties, final accounts, and landlord obligations such as tenant-improvement reimbursements.

Analysis & Planning

Lead assigned portfolio-planning initiatives, using headcount forecasts and utilization data to evaluate renewals, relocations, expansions, and consolidations.
Develop decision-ready business cases comparing capacity, total occupancy cost, capital requirements, and delivery risks. Recommend a preferred option and identify the approvals needed.

Capital Planning & Program Controls

Own annual and multi-year capital plans for assigned projects, including budgets, cash-flow forecasts, commitments, and variance reporting. Partner with Finance to distinguish capital expenditure from ongoing occupancy costs.
Develop and maintain capital-project budgeting tools and processes with Finance and IT, including estimating templates, cost benchmarks, forecasting, and variance reporting. Standardize their use across projects and improve reporting to reduce manual work.
Maintain an integrated view of concurrent projects, including schedule dependencies, resource conflicts, and emerging risks.
Apply approval checkpoints and change-control procedures. Escalate scope, cost, or schedule changes with a clear recommendation before commitments exceed delegated authority.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

Partner with office leaders, Finance, and the Head of Workplace Portfolio to prioritize needs and translate approved decisions into sequenced project plans. Present recommendations and progress to executive audiences.

Workplace Program Leadership

Own and maintain workplace project standards and governance approved by the Head of Workplace Portfolio. Define consistent delivery stages, review checkpoints, documentation requirements, and escalation procedures within established approval boundaries.
Develop and maintain workplace playbooks, templates, and procedures covering project initiation through operational handoff. Support consistent use across the global portfolio while allowing for local requirements.
Develop and maintain RFP templates and procurement playbooks for project management, design, and construction services. Standardize scopes, evaluation criteria, and selection documentation in coordination with Legal and required internal approvers.
Capture global project best practices and lessons learned through structured post-project reviews. Incorporate findings into delivery standards, playbooks, and team guidance.
Lead value-engineering and sourcing reviews that evaluate cost, operational requirements, and delivery risk. Document approved savings against an agreed baseline and use project results to improve cost benchmarks and procurement practices. Maintain vendor-performance measures and use post-project reviews to improve delivery and identify repeatable savings.
Mentor team members in financial analysis and executive communication. Review work quality and help resolve complex project issues without assuming direct people-management responsibility.
Coordinate reliable lease, critical-date, occupancy, and cost reporting with the relevant record owners to support proactive planning.
Lead assigned workplace environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives and incorporate approved sustainability requirements into project delivery. Coordinate greenhouse gas (GHG) savings analysis and reporting, documenting baselines and validating calculations and reported results with the appropriate internal owners.
Lead assigned strategic process-improvement initiatives across the workplace portfolio. Identify delivery and reporting gaps, develop implementation plans, and measure results against agreed cost, cycle-time, quality, or risk measures.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of progressive experience in workplace, corporate real estate, architecture, construction, interior design, facilities, or related project management fields.
Demonstrated delivery of complex commercial office projects and concurrent initiatives across multiple locations.
Strong command of capital planning, forecasting, procurement, construction documentation, and project controls.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience developing scenario models and presenting concise recommendations to senior leadership.
Evidence of improving delivery standards or business processes, leading external teams, and mentoring colleagues.
Strong written communication and independent judgment; ability to manage ambiguity and travel domestically and internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with global workplace portfolios, occupancy planning, and lease administration or portfolio-reporting systems such as Visual Lease.
Experience with workplace sustainability or greenhouse gas reporting, including documented baselines and savings analysis.
Experience with Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Project, and workplace technology or building systems.
PMP, LEED AP, NCIDQ, architectural, construction, or other relevant professional certifications.

Salary Range: $145,000- $195,000

Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the United States, without company sponsorship.

About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

BRG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Position Summary

The Principal Project Manager, Corporate Compliance, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing compliance-related projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. This position serves as a liaison between Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, Information Technology, Operations, and other business stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with regulatory, accreditation, and organizational requirements.

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining project governance, tracking milestones, managing risks and dependencies, facilitating stakeholder communication, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's compliance program. This role requires strong organizational, analytical, and relationship management skills, along with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of compliance department projects and initiatives.

Track project outcomes and key performance indicators to measure effectiveness and support continuous improvement.

Governance and Reporting

Develop meeting agendas, meeting minutes, action item logs, and project status reports.
Present updates to Compliance Leadership, executive leadership, and applicable committees.
Ensure action items are assigned, monitored, and completed timely.

Master's degree preferred.

Experience

Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting compliance, regulatory, healthcare, health plan, PBM, TPA, or highly regulated business environments preferred.
Experience leading enterprise or cross departmental projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, dependencies, and organizational objectives required.
Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms preferred.
Experience managing the annual review of business continuity plans and disaster recovery plans preferred.

Certifications

Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) considered.
Healthcare Compliance certification such as CHC or CCEP preferred.

Strong project planning, organization, and execution skills.
Knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience facilitating meetings and driving accountability across departments.

New York, NY | Full-Time | On-Site

ABOUT HOLLISWOOD
Founded in 2011, Holliswood Development is a vertically integrated NYC real estate investment and development firm focused on residential value-add opportunities, multifamily renovations, luxury conversions, and the repositioning of existing buildings across Manhattan and Brooklyn. Our projects are small to mid-sized, and we run them with lean, collaborative teams and an entrepreneurial mindset.

THE ROLE
This is an owner-side role. You'll work directly with ownership and oversee third-party GCs, architects, engineers, and consultants on projects in existing NYC buildings, often requiring Alt-1 and Alt-2 filings. You'll have significant influence over design, layouts, finishes, budgets, and schedules, and you'll drive projects from initial planning through completion.

• Lead pre-construction: design development, budgeting, constructability reviews, scheduling, and procurement

• Identify value-engineering opportunities without compromising design intent or quality

• Manage 3–5 projects at once through regular site visits and project coordination
• Coordinate DOB filings, permitting, inspections, and approvals with expediters and consultants
• Report to ownership on budgets, schedules, risks, and key decisions

QUALIFICATIONS
• 7+ years in construction management, real estate development, or project management
• Experience with NYC multifamily renovations, luxury residential, conversions, or value-add projects
• Strong knowledge of existing NYC buildings, DOB requirements, and Alt-1 / Alt-2 filings
• Strong architectural and design sensibility, with an eye for layouts, detailing, and high-end finishes
• Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit; Bluebeam and Procore preferred
• Ability to manage multiple projects independently and take full ownership of execution
• Preferred: degree in architecture, construction management, or engineering, plus owner/developer-side experience

Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

Etsy is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Project Manager. As a Project Manager within our Operations Team, you will play a key role in coordinating the activities and timelines of small to medium-scale campaigns and channel support projects. You will manage the execution of specific project components, ensuring they align with overall project goals and are completed on time and within budget. Your role will involve monitoring project progress, identifying potential issues, and addressing day-to-day project challenges. Effective communication with stakeholders and setting clear expectations will be crucial to your success. This is a full-time position reporting to the Director of Brand Operations.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Our team inspires collaboration, structure, and process to bring creative ideas to life on time and under budget. All the while, we are passionate about Etsy’s mission to keep commerce human, and that passion drives everything we do.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Skills

The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating the successful execution of small to medium-scale projects across various marketing channels. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the achievement of strategic goals and to develop your project management skills in a supportive environment. If you join us, here are some of the other things you’ll do:

Project Planning & Execution:
Coordinate project activities and timelines, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule.
Manage the execution of specific project components, aligning with the overall project plan.
Monitor project progress, identify potential issues, and address them promptly.
Communicate with stakeholders to provide updates, set expectations, and resolve day-to-day project issues.
Assist in facilitating meetings and presentations to ensure clear communication of project goals and progress.

Operational Support:
Contribute to process improvements related to your workstream, helping to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are
:

You have 4+ years of experience in Marketing and Creative Operations, Project Management, or Production.
You have strong organizational and time management skills.
You are adept at coordinating multiple tasks and ensuring project components are delivered on time.
You have excellent problem-solving skills and can address day-to-day project issues efficiently.
You possess strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in project management software and tools is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 94,000.00 - 128,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 85,000.00 - 115,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. Technical Program Manager – Space Operations (TS/SCI Required)

Salary:
$200,000-$250,000
Location:
Onsite in Grand Forks, ND (current or open to relocate)

About the Role

MapLarge is looking for a Technical Program Manager to be our on-the-ground lead in Grand Forks, ND. You will work alongside the operators who run satellite constellations and ground systems for the national security space mission.

You will be the bridge between those operators and MapLarge engineering. That means understanding how operators task satellites and use the data that comes back, and turning those needs into requirements, demos and delivered capability on our geospatial analytics platform.

This is a customer-embedded role for someone who knows the space mission, can hold their own in a technical discussion and wants to help build a program from the ground up. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. Beyond running the program, you will shape solution architecture, guide engineering decisions and bring modern, AI-assisted delivery practices to a classified mission program.

About MapLarge

Since 2009, MapLarge’s rapidly growing software platform has enabled federal governments and Fortune 1000 enterprises to develop, scale, and deploy mission-critical applications. Trusted by the world's most sophisticated organizations, our enterprise platform for geospatial analytics and visualization automates decision intelligence and offers a distinct decision advantage. We build cutting-edge products for large enterprises and government agencies that appreciate innovation. If you enjoy working with talented teammates to solve complex challenges, we'd love for you to join us.

Responsibilities

Build trusted relationships with operators and ground operations teams in Grand Forks
Manage program milestones, risks and deliverables on site
Translate operator needs into clear requirements for MapLarge engineering
Shape solution architecture and system design for mission applications on the MapLarge platform, working directly with our engineers and architects
Coordinate classified (high-side) integration with engineering and DevOps
Lead demos, pilots and proofs of concept for operators and leadership
Support RFI, RFP and proposal responses
Coordinate with commercial data partners and prime contractors
Identify new mission opportunities for business development

Requirements

Active TS/SCI clearance
Local to Grand Forks, ND or willing to relocate
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related field is required.
Authorized to work in the United States and no visa sponsorship required.
7+ years managing technical programs that delivered complex software, at least 5 of them in DoD or the Intelligence Community (IC).
Technical depth:
a hands-on software engineering or architecture background, ideally with C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Azure or AWS, and CI/CD. You can drive architecture discussions, solution design and technical decisions with customers and engineers.
Space mission experience:
direct experience with satellite operations, ground systems or space programs. This can be operational (Space Force, Air Force space operations) or program/contractor side.
Customer-facing:
comfortable working directly with operators, program offices and senior leaders, and managing expectations on high-value programs.

Nice to Have

Experience with proliferated low-Earth-orbit (LEO) constellations, satellite tasking and collection management, or ground segment operations.
Familiarity with sensor and intelligence data types such as radar, radio frequency (RF), moving target indicator (MTI) and imagery.
Experience with tactical data links or getting space-based data to warfighters.
Experience with real-time data systems, distributed computing or high-performance visualization.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, responsible AI guardrails or spec-driven engineering.
Experience coordinating across multiple engineering disciplines (web, backend, cloud, DevOps, data).
Experience delivering software in classified cloud environments.
Proposal and capture experience: leading or drafting proposal sections, alone or as part of a larger team.
Existing relationships within the space operations community.

Cultural Fit

While we hire all kinds of people and invent roles to fit them, there are four key traits we require of every team member that really define our team.
Fun to Work With
- Life is short and work should be fun.
Smart
- We work on cutting-edge hard problems. We need people who are quick learners, can anticipate needs, and solve problems independently while working with an intelligent peer group.
Passionate & Proactive
- We need people who really love their work and exhibit the energy and creativity that comes from being fully engaged in what you do.
Adaptable -
We hire team members for specific roles, but we expect adaptability as the business needs change and evolve.

Benefits

Competitive salary and 401K
Unlimited PTO
Top-notch health care
Family friendly
100% remote flexibility
Cutting-edge tech with an A+ team solving complex, meaningful problems
Collaborative, intelligent, positive, and supportive team culture

new_jobs.title: Sr Technical Project Manager - Active Learning Loop
new_jobs.description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

TEAM

At Woven by Toyota (WbyT), the AD/ADAS Project Management Team enables the successful delivery of engineering technology that advances the company’s business goals. As a strategic partner to WbyT’s Engineering and Product functions, the Project Management team leads the technical execution of the AD/ADAS portfolio, maintains the organization’s plan of record, and drives the velocity and agility of a highly cross-functional engineering organization distributed across multiple global locations.

Our team members come from a mix of Autonomy, off-board ecosystem, hardware and vehicle backgrounds but we all share a common drive to enable the delivery of complex and safe autonomous engineering products to the world. We are problem solvers who make things happen by setting and communicating clear goals and supporting engineering teams to deliver through the technical and organizational complexity.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Staff Technical Program Manager to contribute to Woven’s Active Learning Loop program that enables the continuous improvement of our autonomous driving stack across data pipelines, ML training, simulation, validation, and deployment.

The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, engaging with senior leadership, and driving cross-functional programs across distributed, global teams with minimal direction. You are motivated by the challenge of bringing complex technology platforms to production and have a strong instinct for connecting technical execution to business outcomes.

This role demands proficiency in data and cloud infrastructure, machine learning platform systems, tools, simulation, and validation workflows. Additionally, it requires strong cross-functional communication skills and a data-driven strategy to enhance engineering speed and cost efficiency.

Responsibilities

Own and drive complex cross-functional programs across Data and cloud infrastructure, ML Platform, simulation and validation, with a focus on improving development throughput and cost efficiency.
Drive cloud cost management across the ALL program by tracking and reporting on data storage, compute, and ML training spend, identifying cost drivers, and partnering with engineering leads to define and execute cost reduction initiatives
Define project scope, milestones, and success metrics for platform capabilities, explicitly tying them to developer productivity, iteration speed, test throughput, and safety validation timelines, and aligning outcomes with the broader autonomy roadmap.
Create and maintain an integrated project plan of record (sprint, quarter, year) that unifies platform team roadmaps into a single execution and risk-management view, with clear critical paths to autonomy feature readiness and validation gates.
Lead cross-functional planning and high-velocity execution across the Active Learning Loop program, proactively resolving dependencies and blockers, and driving timely, evidence-based decisions.
Identify and resolve systemic issues in the development workflow, and continuously evolve TPM practices, including mentoring other TPMs focused on autonomy efficiency and validation outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

6+ years program/project management experience within a software, automotive, aerospace, robotics, or mobility-related industry.
Familiarity with the ML development ecosystem, including data pipelines, training workflows, simulation, or offline validation infrastructure.
Experience managing cloud infrastructure costs, including data storage and compute, within a large-scale engineering environment.
Proven track record of leading large cross-functional programs to successful delivery spanning organizations of 100+ stakeholders.
Experience driving technical programs in ambiguity with high-level direction across distributed teams and diverse business cultures.
Experience establishing and evolving program operations and decision-making structures adapting to team culture and operating constraints.

NICE TO HAVES

Experience in Autonomous Vehicle projects, Automotive, or OEM/Tier-1 environments
Experience in the development of autonomy features for L2/L4 systems
Proficiency in Business level Japanese
PMP/PMI or other Project Management certifications are welcome

What We Offer

We are committed to creating a modern work environment that supports our employees and their loved ones. We offer many options of the best programs to allow you to do your most meaningful work and to help you shape the future of mobility.

・Excellent health, wellness, dental and vision coverage

・A rewarding 401k program

・Flexible vacation policy

・Family planning and care benefits

Our Commitment

Excellentes capacités de communication, y compris avec des COMEX / CODIR

Senior Program Manager 
Who We Are
We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.
We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager
to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).
What You'll Do
As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. The Sr. Program Manager reports to the Program Director (or Group Program Director) and will manage Associates and/or Managers. The Sr. PM partners with the Business Supervisor or Business Director to run most Tier 1 or 2 projects. 
Responsibilities
Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.
Drive the end-to-end process for integrated campaigns (film, experiential, digital/social, OOH), ensuring seamless delivery on time and on budget by developing and tracking tactical plans to develop each with a keen understanding of client parameters and objectives. Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules
Partner with Business Leadership counterpart to develop all scope proposals for assigned projects, developing a compelling proposal as well as profitable approach for the agency
Provide strong financial management of assigned accounts including managing all budget allocations, reviewing burn, proactively creating scope change orders (internal and external), proactively suggesting areas for optimization and macro view of out-of-pocket budget tracking
Lead all reporting and reconciliation processes in partnership with finance team 
Help digest all client feedback and lead the team on how we address and action the feedback. Understand and mentor teams on where/when to escalate creative feedback or work reviews to senior leadership 
Build and nurture strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor who understands how to get things done effectively and efficiently leveraging our teams and resources to create innovative and breakthrough creative solutions that solve clients business objectives 
Manage and mentor junior program managers, strategically deploying them across projects and fostering their professional growth.
Collaborate with department leads (account, production, creative, strategy) to assemble the right teams for each initiative, confirm the right allocations and manage overall workforce planning with Resource Management lead
Work closely with production to ensure timelines accommodate production requirements and projects continue to move seamlessly in execution 
Support the Business Lead and Production teams during executional and production phases of creative work to ensure absolute clarity client & media requirements, provide tactical support during production and oversee the successful delivery/traffic assets when required 
Partner with Creative, Production, and Business teams to turn campaign ideas into actionable plans, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track without compromising creative ambition.
Manage and monitor production and creative workflows, proactively identifying risks and driving solutions to keep projects moving smoothly.
Foster clear, integrated ways of working by aligning teams on roles, processes, and communication throughout the creative and production lifecycle.
Proactively identify potential issues or opportunities, keeping teams and clients informed and driving swift, effective solutions.
Oversee the creation of presentation materials that uphold agency standards and resonate with clients’ business objectives.
Participate in new business efforts, contributing to proposals, pitches, and strategic planning to showcase our operational strengths and capabilities
Champion a positive, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, accountability, and a shared passion for producing culturally powerful work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex ideas clearly, accurately, and persuasively.
Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.
Highly organized with exceptional time management and prioritization abilities, balancing multiple workstreams with quality and care.
Passionate about people and culture, with a results-driven approach balanced by genuine curiosity and sensitivity to team dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications
5–7 years of experience managing large-scale brands or programs within a creative agency or related communications environment.
Proven ability to build strong client partnerships that drive long-term growth and mutual success.
Demonstrated expertise managing multi-disciplinary teams across creative, production, and strategy disciplines.
Solid understanding of financial principles as they relate to agency scopes, budgets, and P&L impact.
Experience leading strategic and day-to-day client communications, as well as mentoring junior team members.
Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns, including digital, social, print, and broadcast production.
Comfortable with Google Suite (Sheets and Slides); experience with Monday.com or SmartSheets is a plus.

Background in managing cross-functional agency partners and leading collaborative workstreams.

Job Description:

The Deployment Project Manager supports healthcare technology management (HTM) work associated with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Federal Electronic Health Record Modernization (FEHRM) program. This role coordinates simultaneous deployment projects and workstreams across multiple VA medical centers. The Project Manager works directly with national, regional, and site-level Biomedical Engineering and clinical teams, technical teams, third-party vendors, and program management offices across the VA enterprise.

Successful candidates bring recent, practical experience with medical devices, facility HTM operations, or healthcare technology implementation, along with strong project coordination skills. They can follow a technical discussion, identify an unresolved issue, ask questions to understand its impact, and turn that information into a clear status update or escalation for leadership.

Travel associated with this role will consist of being away for about a week every 2 months*

Responsibilities:

Ability to coordinate HTM deployment schedules, site dependencies, equipment and interface readiness, testing activities, and go-live preparation across multiple VA facilities.
Track project milestones, risks, decisions, and action items; identify how unresolved issues may affect in-flight work or deployment readiness.
Work with facility HTM, clinical teams, Oracle Health, vendors, and program stakeholders to clarify ownership, deliverables, and milestone status.
Participate actively in technical and operational discussions. Ask focused follow-up questions when information is incomplete or conflicting, and track issues through resolution.
Escalate concerns with a clear explanation of the issue, its potential impact, the decision needed, and the next steps.
Prepare status reports, executive summaries, briefings, and meeting documentation that accurately capture decisions, owners, and follow-up actions.
Support planning and coordination through readiness, testing, deployment, and post-deployment follow-up.
Work within applicable VHA processes, federal requirements, and healthcare technology practices

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and at least 5 years relevant professional experience.
Recent, practical experience in a hospital HTM department, medical device or imaging company, healthcare technology deployment, or a comparable field-based environment.
Experience coordinating projects or complex work across technical, clinical, vendor, and leadership stakeholders.
Working familiarity with medical devices and facility HTM activities sufficient to understand the work being tracked and recognize readiness concerns.
Ability to identify the project implications of technical issues and communicate them clearly to technical teams and leadership.
Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting VHA operations or a multi-facility EHR deployment.
Familiarity with Oracle Health Cerner Millennium or VA FEHRM.
Experience coordinating medical device integration, equipment readiness, testing, or go-live activities.
Familiarity with HTM equipment inventory or computerized maintenance management systems.
Familiarity with applicable healthcare regulatory requirements and standards.
Experience using tools, including AI-assisted tools, to improve documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal public trust clearance.

Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies and experience, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Program Manager / Delivery Lead to lead the end-to-end execution and coordination of a large-scale Android platform modernization and application migration program for a next-generation In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) platform. The program involves Android operating system migration, hardware platform bring-up, middleware modernization, passenger, crew and maintenance application porting, integration, verification, Android compatibility qualification, release readiness, and customer acceptance support.

The Program Manager will serve as the primary delivery coordination lead responsible for planning, execution governance, schedule management, dependency tracking, risk mitigation, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and alignment across multiple engineering workstreams. The role will work closely with customer stakeholders, architects, engineering leads, verification teams, DevOps teams, and release management teams to ensure successful delivery of program objectives while maintaining schedule, quality, and reporting commitments.

This role is primarily focused on program execution, delivery governance, and cross-functional coordination, rather than hands-on software development.

Key Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution
Own overall program execution for Android platform and application migration activities.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering platform bring-up, middleware migration, application migration, integration, verification, compliance testing, and release readiness activities.
Define milestones, delivery phases, checkpoints, dependencies, entry criteria, and exit criteria.
Establish governance processes for tracking scope, schedule, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
Coordinate work across distributed onsite and offshore engineering teams.
Ensure alignment between technical execution plans and customer program objectives.
Support program onboarding, resource ramp-up, and capacity planning activities.
Monitor project health and drive corrective actions where schedule or technical risks emerge.
Delivery Coordination
Coordinate delivery activities across multiple engineering domains including:
Android Platform & BSP
Middleware & Platform Services
Passenger Applications
Crew Applications
Maintenance Applications
Build & Release Engineering
Test Automation
System Integration
Android Compatibility & Compliance
Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions and execution reviews.
Ensure technical teams are synchronized regarding deliverables, interfaces, integration points, and release schedules.
Manage dependency tracking across platform, middleware, application, and test teams.
Ensure timely closure of action items affecting project milestones.
Schedule Management
Create and maintain detailed project schedules and integrated master plans.
Track progress against committed milestones and delivery objectives.
Manage sprint, release, and milestone-level schedules.
Conduct schedule variance analysis and develop recovery plans when required.
Identify critical path items and escalation triggers.
Monitor resource allocation and project throughput against planned timelines.
Drive milestone readiness assessments before major releases or integration events.
Risk, Issue & Impediment Management
Maintain program-level risk and issue registers.
Proactively identify technical, schedule, resource, infrastructure, and dependency risks.
Facilitate risk mitigation planning and execution.
Coordinate root-cause analysis for major delivery challenges.
Escalate issues requiring leadership intervention.
Track mitigation actions through closure.
Remove execution impediments impacting engineering productivity and delivery commitments.
Coordinate resolution of environment, infrastructure, access, integration, and test setup issues.
Stakeholder Communication & Status Reporting
Act as primary delivery interface for customer and leadership stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
12+ years of software engineering, embedded systems, or technology program management experience.
Minimum 5+ years managing large-scale software development programs.
Experience leading complex platform migration or modernization programs.
Strong project and program management experience involving globally distributed teams.
Proven experience managing multi-stream deliveries involving development, integration, testing, and release teams.
Demonstrated success driving execution in schedule-sensitive environments.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Experience with risk management, dependency management, and escalation management.
Excellent organizational, leadership, negotiation, and facilitation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Android platform development programs.
Experience with AOSP, BSP, embedded Linux, or Android-based product development.
Experience in:
In-Flight Entertainment (IFE)
Aerospace systems
Automotive Infotainment
Consumer Electronics
Connected Products
Experience managing Android migration programs.
Familiarity with CTS, VTS, release qualification, and platform certification activities.
Experience managing offshore-onsite delivery models.
Knowledge of CI/CD and software release management processes.
Android based infotainment development program experience

Senior Engineering Program Manager

Careers That Change Lives

Help shape the future of a transformative therapy. The Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) Operating Unit is seeking an accomplished, high-impact Quality Core Team Member (QCTM) to lead Quality for the next-generation Renal Denervation (RDN) platform—one of ICT’s highest-priority innovation programs. Positioned at the intersection of strategy, product development, and execution, you will influence critical business and technical decisions, mobilize cross-functional partners, and help bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.

This position is on-site 4 days per week at the Mounds View, MN campus as the Quality lead on a cross-functional new product development team within the Coronary & Renal Denervation (CRDN) operating unit. This role will require less than 10% travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

We believe that when people from different cultures, genders, and points of view come together, innovation is the result—and everyone wins. Medtronic walks the walk, creating an inclusive culture where you can thrive.

A Day in the Life

A Senior Engineering Program Manager
leading the Quality team will:

Lead the Quality strategy for a high-priority new product development program, translating PDP milestones into an actionable plan that proactively manages timelines, dependencies, technical risks, and resource needs.
Serve as the Quality voice on the Core Team, partnering across Research & Development, Clinical, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Project Management Office, and Operations to shape strategies that advance quality, compliance, patient safety, and customer impact.
Drive key Quality-owned technical deliverables that support product development, including Risk Management, Design Verification, and Design Transfer, while ensuring strong alignment across engineering, regulatory, and manufacturing partners.
Use program metrics and risk indicators to monitor Quality performance, communicate progress, and drive timely mitigation plans with Quality and program leadership.
Influence cross-functional execution by clearly communicating priorities, progress, risks, and key decisions to technical teams, Quality leaders, and senior stakeholders.

Key Skills & Experience

Product development and program delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead Quality planning and execution within large, complex PDP programs, translating technical milestones into clear priorities, integrated workstreams, risk-based decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Capital equipment and systems expertise: Strong understanding of complex system-level product development, including the integration of software, hardware, mechanical design, and clinical or user needs in a regulated medical device environment.
Cross-functional leadership: Ability to lead through influence across engineering, quality, regulatory, clinical, manufacturing, and supply chain partners, building alignment and driving decisions in a matrixed, global environment.

TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE, PLEASE ENSURE THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS ARE EVIDENT ON YOUR RESUME.

Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or math and a minimum of 7 years of technical work experience; or an advanced degree in science, technology, engineering, or math with 5 years of technical experience.

Experience influencing and collaborating across geographically distributed teams, with the ability to build strong partnerships across functions, sites, and leadership levels.

Job Title: Program Manager with Quote to Cash & Finance M&A Integration

Location:
San Jose, CA/onsite

Position Type: Full time/Permanent role

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced contract Program Manager to lead program governance, execution, and delivery for the Quote to Cash (QTC) and Finance workstream of a strategic Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) integration initiative. This role contributes to the end-to-end program plan, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline required to integrate an acquired company's business processes and systems into the existing CRM and SAP ERP platform landscape.
You will partner closely with the QTC & Finance Product Manager, Sales Operations, Finance, IT, Engineering, and the acquired company's stakeholders to build the program roadmap, manage governance and reporting, drive risk and dependency management, and ensure a seamless, compliant, and minimally disruptive transition onto the platform. This is an execution and delivery leadership role that complements the Product Manager's ownership of requirements, scope, and functional design.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain the end-to-end program timeline for the QTC and Finance M&A integration workstream, from discovery through go-live, hypercare, and decommissioning of transition state.
Partner with BPO/PMO leadership, the Product Manager, Engineering, and business stakeholders to translate the vision, scope, and gap analysis for QTC and Finance integration into a structured program plan with clear milestones and deliverables.
Engage with SAP FI/CO, SD, and CRM (Microsoft Dynamics) functional and technical teams to estimate level of effort, sequencing, and feasibility of delivery for quoting, pricing, order booking, invoicing, revenue recognition, collections, and financial close workstreams.
Establish and run program governance, including meeting cadence and artifacts such as Scrum of Scrums, Steering Committee/Operating Committee, RAID logs, Wiki/SharePoint repositories, and integrated project schedules tailored to the M&A integration timeline.
Coordinate data migration, integration, and cutover planning across customer, contract, pricing, product, and financial master data workstreams, ensuring alignment with dual-run/parallel processing and business continuity requirements.
Manage the cross-workstream dependency map across Order Management, Billing, Tax, and other M&A integration workstreams, proactively identifying and resolving conflicts, blockers, and resourcing gaps.
Drive execution and monitoring by tracking progress against the plan, managing scope, schedule, and budget trade-offs, escalating risks and issues, and ensuring timely decision-making by sponsors and cross-functional leads.
Own program-level stakeholder communication and status reporting to the M&A Integration PMO.
Coordinate UAT scheduling and readiness, cutover/go-live planning, release communications, hypercare support, and post-go-live stabilization before disbanding the program team.
Support change management and training logistics to prepare acquired company employees and internal teams for the new platform and processes.
Ensure statutory, tax, revenue recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15), and audit requirements are reflected in the program plan and tracked to closure in partnership with Finance and Controllership.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience delivering complex, multi-functional technology programs, ideally with exposure to Finance/ERP platforms and M&A integration, carve-out, or platform consolidation projec ts.
Proven experience managing programs involving CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar) and SAP ERP, particularly SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) and SAP FI/CO (Finance & Controlling). SAP S/4HANA experience preferred.
Solid working knowledge of end-to-end Quote to Cash processes, including pricing/CPQ, contract management, order booking, billing/invoicing, revenue recognition, collections, cash application, and core finance and accounting principles such as ASC 606/IFRS 15, tax, and statutory reporting.
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams of business and technical resources and coordinating data migration and system cutover planning for customer, product, pricing, and financial master data.
Strong command of program governance tools and practices, including RAID logs, integrated schedules, steering committee reporting, backlog and dependency tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, Aha!, or similar), and process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart).
Experience with Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models typical of large enterprise integration programs, and the ability to apply the appropriate methodology based on program needs.
Exceptional stakeholder management, executive presence, and verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence across Sales, Finance, IT, Engineering, and executive leadership.
Resourceful, self-motivated, and able to operate effectively and autonomously in ambiguous, time-sensitive environments while recognizing and escalating critical issues quickly.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field required; MBA is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience integrating an acquired company's CRM/ERP environment into a parent company's platform ecosystem.
Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, SAP CPQ, SAP Hybris Billing, and SAP Finance/Treasury.
Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-currency, and multi-country finance operations.
PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent Program Management certification.
Prior consulting experience with M&A integrations, divestitures, or enterprise CRM/ERP transformation programs.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
The QTC and Finance program plan is executed on schedule, with clear governance, risk visibility, and cross-workstream alignment throughout the M&A integration lifecycle.
Minimal business disruption during cutover, supported by clean data migration, validated financial reporting, and a well-managed hypercare period.
Strong cross-functional alignment and communication between Sales, Finance, IT, the Product Manager, and the acquired company's teams.
Transparent and well-maintained program artifacts, including RAID logs, project schedules, and status reporting, enabling timely decisions by sponsors and leadership.

new_jobs.description:
Job Number: R0251307

Information Systems Security Manager

The Opportunity:

Department of War (DoW) information systems require continuous, disciplined oversight to stay authorized to operate and defensible against evolving threats. As a Senior Information System Security Manager (ISSM), you will own that oversight, serving as the principal cybersecurity authority for one or more system authorization packages across their full lifecycle.

You'll manage the RMF process end-to-end including categorizing systems, selecting and tailoring controls, overseeing assessment and authorization activities, and maintaining continuous monitoring posture after ATO. You'll supervise a team of ISSOs, assigning control families, reviewing their work, and consolidating it into authoritative packages in eMASS. You'll coordinate directly with Authorizing Officials (AO), Authorizing Official Designated Representatives (AODR), Security Control Assessors (SCA), and program leadership to resolve findings, manage POA&Ms, and drive packages to authorization on schedule.

This role combines technical depth in NIST SP 800-53, 800-37, and 800-137 with the leadership to run a compliance program. You'll set standards for documentation and artifact management, train and mentor ISSOs, and represent the security posture of your systems to senior stakeholders.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

6+ years of experience in cybersecurity compliance, information assurance, or IT security operations
Experience serving as an ISSM, ISSO, or RMF authorization role on DoD or DoW systems
Experience managing RMF Steps 1-6: Categorize through Authorize, and Step 7: Continuous Monitoring
Experience with eMASS, including authorization package development, control implementation statements, POA&M management, and artifact and evidence management
Experience supervising or mentoring ISSOs or junior compliance staff
Experience preparing systems for and supporting compliance audits, inspections, or assessments
Ability to communicate security risk and compliance status clearly to senior leaders, AOs, and SCAs
TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor's degree
DoD 8570 or 8140 IAM Level III certification

Nice If You Have:

Experience with defense or national security issues in a specific theater or combatant command environment
Experience working at a DoD or DoW Command-level Headquarters
Experience with CNSSI 1253, NIST SP 800-53B, and DoD-specific overlays
Experience developing internal SOPs, naming conventions, or governance frameworks for artifact and control management
Experience with system boundary changes, categorization changes, or reauthorization packages
Experience hiring, interviewing, or building out a compliance team
Knowledge of cloud-hosted DoD systems, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Master's degree

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Be a part of helping people live healthy lives as our new Cybersecurity Manager.

SUMMARY

The Cybersecurity Manager leads the day-to-day execution and continual improvement of the enterprise Cyber Security program. This role manages security operations, vulnerability management, incident response, risk reduction, compliance and audit readiness, security awareness, third-party security services, and the operational use of Microsoft security capabilities. The manager works across IT, business teams, and service providers to implement security controls, coordinate remediation, improve detection and response workflows, and strengthen the organization’s security posture while supporting the broader security strategy established by the Director of Cyber Security and IT Operations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Lead execution and continual improvement of the enterprise Cyber Security program, translating security strategy, policies, standards, and priorities into operational plans.
Manage vulnerability management activities, including identification, prioritization, coordination of remediation, and reporting of technology risks.
Lead day-to-day security operations and monitoring, including investigation, escalation, response, documentation, and follow-up for security events and incidents.
Coordinate incident response activities across IT domains and business functions and support post-incident reviews and corrective actions.
Maintain audit and assessment readiness by coordinating documentation, evidence collection, control validation, findings response, and remediation tracking.
Support security risk assessments and third-party/vendor security reviews and coordinate mitigation of identified risks.
Partner with IT, Legal, Operations, Compliance, and other business teams on cross-functional security initiatives and remediation activities.
Promote security awareness and compliance through communication, education, and support of organization-wide security programs.
Support the implementation of Operation’s security capabilities such as identity and access management, privileged access, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and email/web security.
Own the implementation and operation of security capabilities such as logging and monitoring, SIEM/SOAR, and data protection.
Manage third-party security operations center (SOC) and other security service providers, including service levels, analyst performance, alert quality, portal access, escalation paths, incident coordination, actionable reporting, backup coverage, and continuous improvement.
Lead the design, development, testing, governance, and continual improvement of security incident response and remediation tools, workflows, automation rules, playbooks, integrations, and reporting to improve detection, triage, containment, recovery, and corrective action while minimizing unintended operational impact.
Oversee the operational configuration, integration, data quality, alerting, and policy alignment of Microsoft security capabilities, including Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview, and supporting data connectors.
Establish and govern least-privilege administrative access, privileged identity management, separate administrative accounts, role elevation, and access review practices for security and technology platforms.
Maintain and improve security policies, processes, procedures, standards, knowledge articles, incident records, and lessons learned to support consistent execution, audit readiness, and organizational knowledge.
Help establish and maintain secure configuration, patching, hardening, and technical control standards across infrastructure, applications, endpoints, and cloud environments.
Provide clear security metrics, risk information, recommendations, and status updates to IT leadership and relevant stakeholders.
Evaluate emerging threats, technologies, and security practices and recommend practical improvements.
Mentor and develop Cyber Security staff, provide technical and operational guidance, establish priorities, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.
Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with executives, managers, auditors, partners, and subject matter experts.
Must be highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, or closely related IT roles, including experience leading security initiatives and providing guidance to other security professionals.
Working knowledge of security frameworks and best practices such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, and CIS Controls.
Experience with vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, identity and access management, endpoint security, logging/SIEM, data protection, secure configuration, and patch management.
Experience supporting internal or external security audits, assessments, evidence collection, remediation, and compliance activities.
Knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and cloud technologies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security environments, is highly desirable.
Hands-on experience designing, maturing, implementing, administering, tuning, and integrating the Microsoft security suite, including Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID and Privileged Identity Management, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Intune security controls, and related Microsoft 365 and Azure security capabilities.
Experience designing and governing security automation, including Microsoft Sentinel automation rules and playbooks, Logic Apps, alert enrichment, notifications, data connectors, workflow integrations, and automated response actions.
Experience managing third-party SOC or managed security service providers, including service-level oversight, escalation, quality review, access dependencies, performance reporting, and vendor coordination.
Ability to assess technical risk, translate findings into practical remediation plans, and communicate risk to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or Microsoft security certifications are preferred.
Commitment to continuous professional development and staying current with emerging technologies, threats, and security practices.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has supervisory responsibilities and is responsible for leading, mentoring, and developing Cyber Security staff.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and relevant experience. Demonstrated experience in enterprise cybersecurity operations, risk management, incident response, and audit/compliance activities is required; prior leadership or supervisory experience is preferred.

Life and AD&D insurance

Incident Response and Resilience

Lead technical investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident improvement.
Coordinate response activities with IT, Legal, Communications, firm leadership, and external providers.
Maintain and test incident-response plans, playbooks, escalation paths, and tabletop exercises.

Security Engineering and Architecture

Lead security reviews for network, endpoint, identity, cloud, data, AI, and business technologies.
Translate business requirements and security risks into practical technical designs and standards.
Validate access, integrations, logging, monitoring, segmentation, data protection, and recovery controls.

Security Platform Oversight

Ensure security platforms are properly configured, integrated, monitored, documented, and supported.
Monitor platform health, security coverage, service performance, and remediation of control gaps.

Security Transformation and Project Delivery

Lead cybersecurity initiatives from design through implementation, testing, transition, and measurement.
Manage scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, rollback plans, and stakeholder communications.
Build sustainable processes that reduce reliance on individuals, other IT teams, and external providers.

Detection and Vulnerability Management

Oversee vulnerability identification, validation, prioritization, remediation, exceptions, and reporting.
Direct development and tuning of security detections, alerts, use cases, and response playbooks.
Use incidents, testing, intelligence, and operational data to identify security improvements.

AI and Emerging Technology Security

Lead technical security assessments for AI platforms, agents, integrations, automation, and emerging technologies.
Evaluate permissions, data access, third-party connections, production impact, logging, and monitoring.
Translate governance requirements into practical technical safeguards and operating standards.

Vendor and Managed-Service Oversight

Manage operational relationships with security monitoring, incident-response, testing, and engineering providers.
Define responsibilities, service expectations, escalation procedures, deliverables, and performance measures.
Validate vendor work while retaining internal ownership of security decisions and operational knowledge.

Metrics and Reporting

Establish operational metrics for incidents, alerts, vulnerabilities, platforms, projects, and service performance.
Maintain dashboards and provide concise operational updates to the IT Security Director.
Identify recurring issues, control gaps, performance concerns, and improvement opportunities.

GRC, Audit, and Client Support

Provide technical evidence, control documentation, and subject-matter support to designated GRC personnel.
Support audits and client assessments through technical validation, evidence collection, and remediation.
Implement approved policies and escalate compliance concerns or control exceptions appropriately.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, or a related field preferred. In lieu of a degree, at least five years of directly relevant cybersecurity experience — gained at an organization with a minimum of 2,000 users and/or $500M in annual revenue — managing enterprise security operations, security engineering, architecture, or incident response.
Eight years of progressive IT and/or cybersecurity experience, including at least three years managing enterprise cybersecurity operations across network, endpoint, identity, cloud, and email security environments, with responsibility for security engineering, architecture, vulnerability management, and threat detection. Advanced technical knowledge of incident investigation, threat detection, containment, eradication, and recovery procedures. new_jobs.title: Sr. Business Operations Manager (Starlink Growth)
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK GROWTH)

Starlink is a revolutionary satellite constellation, delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world – bringing an unprecedented opportunity to significantly impact communities, businesses, and governments worldwide. The North America Business Development team is seeking a Sr. Business Operations Manager to serve as a pivotal partner in defining and executing go-to-market (GTM) strategy across both third-party and direct starlink.com selling channels. This role owns the operational backbone of North American Business Development initiatives while driving foundational GTM strategy work that shapes the team’s long-term direction. In addition, the role owns day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America and works cross-functionally to maximize Starlink fulfilments and subscribers. It is vital that Starlink deals, partnerships, and direct-to-consumer efforts be optimized for speed, scale, and balanced growth. This role requires deep program management and business operations expertise, comfort working with both people and data, and fluency in financial analysis, reporting, pricing, promotions, and the day-to-day mechanics that make Starlink business development and direct channel initiatives run.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business operations, and chief-of-staff capabilities with strategic rigor, GTM expertise, and long-term vision. This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of connectivity technologies with a world-class team focused on connecting every household and traveler.

Responsibilities

Own and drive GTM strategy for North America across both third-party channels and Starlink.com, ensuring alignment on prioritization, resource allocation, and growth objectives
Own day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America, including performance tracking, conversion optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize the business
Provide strategic insight across the North America Business Development team to minimize cannibalization and maximize balanced growth between third-party and starlink.com
Assist with pricing strategy and promotions development for both Starlink.com and third-party channels, partnering with finance, marketing, and commercial teams to design and evaluate programs that drive incremental growth
Own the operationalization of existing and upcoming business development and GTM initiatives, driving program management, deal pipeline tracking, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline so initiatives move with speed and scale
Create data visualization and present analysis on leading and lagging indicators, along with clear recommendations and optimization planning to leadership stakeholders
Conduct new vertical, competitor, and market research, develop big-bet hypotheses, and perform structured assessments of broad business intelligence, target partners, channels, and direct GTM opportunities to inform team prioritization and resource allocation
Report on progress of strategy, operations, and GTM initiatives, presenting insights, risks, and recommendations directly to Starlink leadership

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field
7+ years of experience in business operations, program management, strategy, GTM and ecommerce, consulting, investment banking, or related roles involving complex initiatives
4+ years of experience driving execution of revenue or growth-oriented programs, including tracking, reporting, and operationalizing commercial or direct-to-consumer initiatives

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven background in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, or chief-of-staff roles supporting high-growth or commercial teams in technology, telecommunications, utilities, or subscription-based services
Experience owning or supporting direct-to-consumer (e.g., e-commerce) channel growth alongside third-party or partner channels, with demonstrated ability to balance growth and minimize cannibalization
Experience in management consulting or investment banking, with demonstrated ability to structure problems, build rigorous analyses, and drive recommendations to action
Familiarity with business development, partnerships, pricing strategy, or promotions in consumer technology, telecommunications, or adjacent sectors
Strong analytical, financial modeling, and data fluency; comfort with accounting concepts, KPI design, pricing analysis, and building clear reporting for leadership
Demonstrated success operationalizing complex commercial, product, or direct-channel initiatives and driving them from concept through execution and scale
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; able to work effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders
MBA or master’s degree with a business or technical focus preferred

Additional Requirements

Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Willingness to travel approximately 25-50% of the time to customer locations and other SpaceX locations as required

Itar Requirements

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

In addition, the role owns day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America and works cross-functionally to maximize Starlink fulfilments and subscribers. It is vital that Starlink deals, partnerships, and direct-to-consumer efforts be optimized for speed, scale, and balanced growth. This role requires deep program management and business operations expertise, comfort working with both people and data, and fluency in financial analysis, reporting, pricing, promotions, and the day-to-day mechanics that make Starlink business development and direct channel initiatives run.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business operations, and chief-of-staff capabilities with strategic rigor, GTM expertise, and long-term vision. This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of connectivity technologies with a world-class team focused on connecting every household and traveler.

Responsibilities

Own and drive GTM strategy for North America across both third-party channels and Starlink.com, ensuring alignment on prioritization, resource allocation, and growth objectives
Own day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America, including performance tracking, conversion optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize the business
Provide strategic insight across the North America Business Development team to minimize cannibalization and maximize balanced growth between third-party and starlink.com
Assist with pricing strategy and promotions development for both Starlink.com and third-party channels, partnering with finance, marketing, and commercial teams to design and evaluate programs that drive incremental growth
Own the operationalization of existing and upcoming business development and GTM initiatives, driving program management, deal pipeline tracking, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline so initiatives move with speed and scale
Create data visualization and present analysis on leading and lagging indicators, along with clear recommendations and optimization planning to leadership stakeholders
Conduct new vertical, competitor, and market research, develop big-bet hypotheses, and perform structured assessments of broad business intelligence, target partners, channels, and direct GTM opportunities to inform team prioritization and resource allocation
Report on progress of strategy, operations, and GTM initiatives, presenting insights, risks, and recommendations directly to Starlink leadership

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field
7+ years of experience in business operations, program management, strategy, GTM and ecommerce, consulting, investment banking, or related roles involving complex initiatives
4+ years of experience driving execution of revenue or growth-oriented programs, including tracking, reporting, and operationalizing commercial or direct-to-consumer initiatives

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven background in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, or chief-of-staff roles supporting high-growth or commercial teams in technology, telecommunications, utilities, or subscription-based services
Experience owning or supporting direct-to-consumer (e.g., e-commerce) channel growth alongside third-party or partner channels, with demonstrated ability to balance growth and minimize cannibalization
Experience in management consulting or investment banking, with demonstrated ability to structure problems, build rigorous analyses, and drive recommendations to action

Strong analytical, financial modeling, and data fluency; comfort with accounting concepts, KPI design, pricing analysis, and building clear reporting for leadership
Demonstrated success operationalizing complex commercial, product, or direct-channel initiatives and driving them from concept through execution and scale
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; able to work effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders
MBA or master’s degree with a business or technical focus preferred

Additional Requirements
