new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Optivolt

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

Our Team & Traction

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team.

To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture.

Why we are looking for you

As Operations Manager, you will own the business processes and day-to-day operations that support our growth. You’ll manage working capital, financial projections, accounting workflows, and business systems while keeping logistics and facilities running reliably.

This hands-on role combines business operations with responsibility for our physical workplace and supply flow. You will partner with leadership, engineering, accounting providers, and legal counsel on budgets, forecasts, contracts, and practical processes. You’ll also directly manage shipping, inventory, vendors, and facility needs.

What you’ll do

What we’re looking for

Preferred skills

Additional requirements

Pay and benefits

Business Operations and Financial Planning
Manage working capital across receivables, payables, inventory, and supplier commitments; improve collections, payment terms, and cash conversion.
Build and maintain cash-flow forecasts, operating budgets, and revenue, expense, and inventory projections with leadership.
Track actual results against plans, explain variances, and model purchasing, hiring, and growth scenarios to support decisions.
Manage purchasing approvals and spending controls; identify cost reductions and flag cash needs and operational risks early.
Accounting and ERP Systems
Own AR/AP workflows, including quotes, customer invoicing, collections, vendor bills, and payment scheduling within approval processes.
Handle routine bookkeeping and account reconciliations; support month-end close and financial reporting with accounting providers.
Administer and improve ERP and accounting workflows across purchasing, inventory, billing, and reporting; maintain accurate records and access controls.
Maintain financial and operational dashboards, SOPs, approvals, and supporting records for reliable reporting and audit readiness.
Contracts and Business Administration
Coordinate customer and vendor agreements, NDAs, and purchase terms from preparation through approval and signature.
Negotiate commercial terms with leadership and coordinate legal review with counsel; track open issues through completion.
Maintain contract, insurance, and corporate records; track renewals, obligations, and administrative deadlines.
Shipping Logistics and Inventory
Own domestic and international shipping and receiving for prototypes, equipment, production materials, and field deployments.
Manage carriers, freight forwarders, rates, shipping and customs documentation, delivery tracking, and claims or exceptions.
Maintain inventory accuracy through labeling, cycle counts, and ERP reconciliation; coordinate returns and RMAs with engineering and quality.
Facilities and Lab Operations
Keep office, lab, and testing spaces functional, organized, and safe, including maintenance, access, and basic safety supplies and records.
Manage facility vendors, service contracts, budgets, upgrades, and equipment installations to support engineering and production needs.
Provide hands-on support for deliveries, visitors, workspace changes, and indoor and outdoor test setups.
3+ years in business operations, finance operations, or operations management, including 1+ years owning financial and operational processes.
Hands-on experience managing working capital and preparing cash-flow forecasts, budgets, financial projections, and variance analyses.
Working knowledge of bookkeeping, AR/AP, account reconciliations, and financial statements; experience supporting an accounting close.
Experience administering or improving ERP and accounting systems across purchasing, inventory, and finance.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial models, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and scenario analysis.
Experience coordinating contracts, negotiating commercial terms, and working with legal counsel or external advisors.
Experience managing facilities, logistics, vendors, and physical inventory in a hardware, manufacturing, lab, or similar environment.
Ability to prioritize independently, communicate financial and operational tradeoffs, and handle confidential information responsibly.
Track record improving processes and controls while remaining willing to handle routine accounting, administrative, and physical operations work.
Experience supporting GAAP-based financial reporting or SOC audit readiness, controls documentation, and evidence collection is a strong plus.
Experience in a hardware startup, including inventory planning, contract manufacturing, and the cash demands of physical products.
Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems such as NetSuite, Odoo, SAP Business One, or QuickBooks.
Familiarity with international shipping and customs, lab safety practices, or material-handling equipment.
Willingness to work extended hours as needed to support critical milestones
Everyone at Optivolt is required to participate in on call support for customers
Must be based in San Francisco, CA

Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, unlimited PTO, plus extra fun perks!

They are responsible for risk and issue management, project/engagement communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way.

Success is defined by delivering the project within committed timelines and financial parameters while achieving stated client outcomes and meeting all quality requirements. The ideal candidate combines large-scale SAP Project management, executive client relationship management, commercial acumen, and business development capabilities with a proven ability to lead complex transformation programs across global organizations.

Position Summary

The NetSuite Systems, Project & Integration Manager
is responsible for managing, optimizing, and continuously improving the company's NetSuite ERP environment and its integration with operational, financial, manufacturing, warehouse, EDI, payroll, and other business systems.
This position serves as the primary internal business owner and project manager for NetSuite-related initiatives. The role works closely with Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Sales, Quality, Warehouse, Production, Maintenance, HR, and external technology partners to ensure systems support the company's operational and financial requirements.
The position will oversee system projects from planning through implementation, including requirements gathering, process development, system configuration coordination, testing, training, implementation, troubleshooting, and ongoing performance management.
The successful candidate will be highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working between business operations and technology providers. The position does not require the individual to be a software developer but requires a strong understanding of ERP systems, integrations, data flow, business processes, and project management.

Key Responsibilities

NetSuite ERP Management

Serve as the primary internal point of contact for NetSuite-related business requirements, issues, projects, and improvements.
Develop a strong working knowledge of NetSuite's financial, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, sales, reporting, and operational capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve business processes through better utilization and configuration of NetSuite.
Coordinate with NetSuite consultants, Oracle partners, third-party vendors, and internal users.
Manage system enhancements, configuration changes, testing, and implementation.
Monitor system performance, data accuracy, user adoption, and process compliance.
Maintain documentation of system processes, configurations, integrations, and key workflows.
Establish appropriate controls around system changes, user access, and data integrity.

Systems Integration

Manage integrations between NetSuite and other company systems and applications.
Coordinate EDI implementations and ongoing EDI requirements with customers, suppliers, and third-party providers.
Manage integrations involving systems such as SPS Commerce, RF-SMART, I-Trade, payroll/HR systems, banking systems, shipping platforms, warehouse systems, and other operational applications
, as applicable.
Understand and document data flows between systems.
Coordinate testing of inbound and outbound transactions.
Investigate integration failures, data discrepancies, and transaction errors and coordinate resolution with the appropriate vendor or technical resource.
Establish procedures for monitoring critical integrations and escalating issues.

Project Management

Lead NetSuite and business systems projects from initial concept through implementation.
Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and deliverables.
Gather requirements from department managers and translate business needs into system requirements.
Coordinate internal resources and external vendors.
Manage project priorities, budgets, deadlines, and risks.
Provide regular project status updates to senior management.
Coordinate user acceptance testing and obtain appropriate approval before implementation.
Ensure completed projects achieve the intended operational and financial objectives.

Business Process Improvement

Evaluate existing business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, controls, and reporting.
Work with department leaders to document current-state and future-state processes.
Identify unnecessary manual processes and opportunities for automation.
Develop recommendations for system and process improvements.
Assist management in evaluating the financial and operational impact of proposed system changes.
Ensure system changes support the company's growth and operational requirements.

Reporting & Data Management

Develop and coordinate NetSuite reporting requirements across departments.
Improve access to purchasing, inventory, labor, production, sales, financial, and operational information.
Work with users to define reporting requirements and develop appropriate dashboards, saved searches, reports, and KPIs.
Monitor data integrity and investigate discrepancies between systems.
Assist management with developing reliable reporting for decision-making.
Establish consistent definitions and processes for critical business data.

User Support & Training

Serve as an internal resource for NetSuite users.
Coordinate user training for new functionality and system changes.
Develop user procedures, training materials, and system documentation.
Promote consistent system usage and adherence to established processes.
Identify recurring user issues and develop permanent solutions rather than relying on manual workarounds.

Vendor & Partner Management

Manage relationships with NetSuite consultants, software vendors, integration providers, and technology partners.
Review vendor proposals, statements of work, contracts, and project estimates.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed-upon scope, timelines, service levels, and deliverables.
Challenge unnecessary costs, duplicate services, and scope increases.
Coordinate vendor meetings and ensure action items are completed.
Assist management with evaluating new technology providers and solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, or a related field preferred.
5+ years of experience with ERP systems, business systems, technology projects, or systems implementation.

Demonstrated experience working with NetSuite or a comparable ERP platform
.
Experience managing system integrations and third-party technology vendors.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to understand business processes and translate them into system requirements.
Experience with data analysis, reporting, and process improvement.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

NetSuite implementation, administration, or optimization experience.
Experience with RF-SMART, SPS Commerce, EDI, I-Trade
, or similar systems.
Experience in manufacturing, food production, distribution, warehousing, or supply chain environments.
Experience with inventory, purchasing, production, labor, and warehouse management systems.
Experience managing ERP implementations or major system transitions.
Familiarity with APIs, data interfaces, integration platforms, or middleware.
Experience developing NetSuite Saved Searches, dashboards, reports, and workflows.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance in this position will be evaluated based on:
Successful completion of system projects within agreed-upon scope and timelines.
Reliability and accuracy of system integrations.
Reduction of manual processes and duplicate data entry.
Improved accuracy and availability of management reporting.
User adoption and effective utilization of NetSuite functionality.
Reduction in recurring system issues and integration failures.
Vendor performance and cost management.
Successful implementation of new systems and system enhancements.
Improved cross-functional business processes.
Data integrity and system controls.

Core Competencies

Project Management
— Ability to organize complex projects, establish priorities, manage deadlines, and drive accountability.
Systems Thinking
— Ability to understand how multiple systems interact and how changes in one system affect other areas of the business.
Business Acumen
— Understands the operational and financial impact of technology decisions.
Analytical Thinking
— Uses data and structured problem-solving to identify root causes and develop solutions.
Communication
— Able to communicate effectively with senior management, department managers, system users, consultants, and technical vendors.
Accountability
— Takes ownership of projects and follows issues through to resolution.
Continuous Improvement
— Consistently looks for opportunities to improve processes, systems, efficiency, and reporting.
Role Expectations

The NetSuite Systems, Project & Integration Manager is expected to operate as a business systems owner and project leader
, rather than simply an IT support resource. The position should understand the company's operational requirements, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure technology investments produce measurable business value.
The individual will be expected to take ownership of assigned projects, establish clear timelines and deliverables, communicate progress to management, and ensure that projects are fully implemented and adopted by the organization.

Für unser Business Solutions Team suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die digitale Projekte mit Augenmaß steuert, gerne mit Menschen arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, interne Kolleg:innen bei der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Systemen zu unterstützen.

Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassisches Beratungsumfeld mit externen Kund:innen, ständigen Pitches oder Dauerdruck. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit Kolleg:innen aus der Agenturgruppe zusammen, begleitest digitale Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass Tools, Prozesse und Systeme im Alltag gut funktionieren.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Du betreust digitale Projekte rund um Prozesse, Systeme, ERP-Lösungen und neue Tools von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
Gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team behältst du den Überblick über laufende Themen, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst für eine pragmatische Umsetzung.
Als Ansprechpartner:in für interne Stakeholder berätst du Kolleg:innen bei Anforderungen rund um digitale Lösungen und unterstützt bei der Einführung neuer Prozesse und Systeme.
Externe Dienstleister werden von dir gesteuert und koordiniert, damit Projekte zuverlässig und effizient umgesetzt werden.
Neue Technologien, KI-Anwendungen und digitale Trends beobachtest du mit Interesse und prüfst, wie diese sinnvoll im Agenturalltag eingesetzt werden können.
Workshops, Tests, Rollouts und Anwenderschulungen begleitest du gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen und sorgst für eine hohe Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen.

Was wir von dir erwarten:

Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Digitalisierungsumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
Erste Erfahrung in der Führung oder fachlichen Steuerung kleiner Teams ist von Vorteil.
Digitale Tools, Prozesse und Systeme interessieren dich und du hast idealerweise bereits mit ERP-Systemen oder vergleichbaren Plattformen gearbeitet.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
Im Austausch mit unterschiedlichsten Stakeholdern überzeugst du durch eine offene, verbindliche und unkomplizierte Art.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Was wir dir bieten:

Onboarding: Willkommensrunde, Onboarding-Tag, Neueinsteiger-Kaffee und Einsteigerrunde - wir sorgen für deinen perfekten Einstieg
Weiterbildung: Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Ob durch unser internes Campus-Weiterbildungsprogramm, freiwillige Sprachkurse oder regelmäßige Coachings - wir halten dich up to date!
Flexibilität: Durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Mobileoffice und Jobsharing-Modelle kannst du deinen Beruf an dein Leben anpassen – und nicht andersrum
Fun: Wer arbeitet, muss auch mal eine Pause machen. Ob Party oder auspowern – bei uns hast du durch regelmäßige After Work Events und agenturgeförderte Fitnessprogramme genug Möglichkeiten
Erreichbarkeit: Unsere modernen Offices sind immer zentral und Dank unserer Bezuschussung des Bahntickets gut für dich erreichbar
Internationalität: Als international agierende Agenturgruppe bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, dich mit Kolleg:innen aus den unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen aus der ganzen Welt zu vernetzen und auszutauschen

new_jobs.description:
Integrated Solutions Project Manager

Do you enjoy being part of a team that provides high-quality services for our customers?

Are you passionate about leading complex projects, building strong client relationships, and delivering operational excellence?

Join a Team That Delivers Essential Services

We provide industry-leading integrated solutions that support our customers' operational success. Our team is responsible for delivering safe, efficient, and high-performing projects through collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence. We are committed to helping our customers achieve their objectives while driving continuous improvement and delivering value across the project lifecycle.

Partner with the best

As an Integrated Solutions Project Manager
, you will be responsible for leading the execution and delivery of integrated well construction projects across drilling, completions, intervention, and associated services. You will manage project performance against safety, operational, financial, and contractual objectives while serving as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle. This position works closely with operations, engineering, service delivery teams, subcontractors, and client stakeholders to ensure successful project outcomes.

As an Integrated Solutions Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

Acting as the primary point of contact for the client, building and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
Leading the execution and delivery of Integrated Solutions projects across drilling, completions, intervention, and associated well construction services.
Managing project performance against safety, operational, financial, and contractual objectives.
Overseeing mobilisation planning, resource allocation, and operational readiness across multiple wellsites, rigs, and service lines.
Driving project execution to ensure on-time delivery while maintaining Baker Hughes quality and HSE standards.
Monitoring and forecasting project revenue, costs, profitability, and cash flow, ensuring delivery against financial targets and P&L expectations.
Identifying and mitigating operational, commercial, and contractual risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinating cross-functional teams including operations, engineering, service delivery, and subcontractors to achieve project objectives.
Reviewing project performance metrics and preparing regular reports for senior leadership and client stakeholders.
Leading contract management activities, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and managing scope changes when required.
Supporting business growth by identifying opportunities for additional products and services within existing projects.
Driving continuous improvement initiatives and promoting best practices across project execution and service delivery.
Providing regular updates and performance reporting to regional leadership and wider stakeholder groups.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

Have a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Management, or a related discipline.
Have significant experience within the oil and gas industry, including managing large-scale integrated projects.
Demonstrate experience delivering drilling, completions, intervention, or well construction projects.
Possess strong commercial and financial management skills, including revenue forecasting, budgeting, profitability management, and P&L accountability.
Have experience managing complex client-facing projects involving multiple service lines and subcontractors.
Demonstrate strong contract management and commercial management capabilities.
Be able to identify project risks and implement effective mitigation and recovery plans.
Have experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across multiple locations and operational environments.
Possess excellent stakeholder management and client relationship-building skills.
Demonstrate strong reporting, planning, and project governance capabilities.
Have strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
Demonstrate a leadership mindset with a commitment to safety, operational excellence, and customer success.

Key Competencies

Project Management & Execution
Commercial & Financial Acumen
Contract & Risk Management
Client Relationship Management
Operational Excellence
Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication
Leadership & Team Coordination
Strategic Planning & Decision Making
Continuous Improvement
Customer Focus

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working pattern:

Working flexible hours, allowing you to adjust your workday to maximize productivity and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. To keep moving forward, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and reward those who embrace change and drive results. Join us, and you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing initiatives
Comprehensive private medical care options
Life insurance and disability coverage programs
Tailored financial and retirement programs
Additional elected and voluntary benefits
Professional development and career growth opportunities within a global organization

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Project Management Senior Advisor - Integrated Solutions/Project Management

About Us:

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

new_jobs.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we've earned the distinction of being Salesforce's #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you'll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you're ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

We are hiring for an AWS Project Manager to work with our Mid-Market & Enterprise customers! As the Project Manager, you will manage projects by providing day-to-day leadership to analyze their requirements, developing designs, and implementing cloud-based contact center solutions based on Amazon Connect and the broader AWS ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has experience working with small and large customers and is comfortable with playing multiple roles on an engagement to be successful. The Project Manager is professional and confident in front of VP and Director-level stakeholders, has a strong analytical and consultative mindset, and thrives when working against tight deadlines. If you appreciate working with cutting edge technology and delivering exciting new digital solutions - then this is the role for you!

You'll have the opportunity to:

Plan, initiate, and lead the full lifecycle delivery of contact center (CCaaS), conversational AI, and agentic solutions and migrations
Monitor and manage project financials, scope and change control, schedule, dependencies, milestones, and risks
Facilitate regular status meetings with the project team, sponsors, and all stakeholders, and publish weekly status reports that proactively communicate progress, early risk indicators, and forward-looking milestones
Act as the client's primary day-to-day point of contact, with a focus on building strong customer relationships
Lead client-facing Outcomes and Business Objectives sessions at project kickoff, defining success metrics and desired business outcomes, then track and report progress against them throughout the engagement
Establish client and project team roles, decision rights, and dependencies at kickoff, and drive timely client decisions and stakeholder access throughout the engagement
Partner with the Solution & Technical Architects to capture, groom, and trace business requirements and user stories through design specifications and delivery, owning the quality of user stories and acceptance criteria
Assist consultant team members in the delivery of client presentations during requirements, design, pilot and user acceptance testing sessions
Facilitate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including coordinating test plans, tracking defects, and driving resolution with the project team
Support end-user training by coordinating logistics, contributing to materials, and ensuring client readiness
Plan and coordinate production cutover and post-go-live hypercare activities
Coordinate across distributed customer and delivery teams, including AWS teams, third-party vendors, architects, developers, QA, and DevOps, to manage dependencies
Serve as Agile Scrum Master and guide the software development lifecycle (SDLC) process
Apply AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery, within approved tools and client data-handling requirements

Required Qualifications:

5+ years of project management experience in contact center environments, including Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) implementations
2+ years of hands-on experience as project manager or scrum leader on Amazon Connect implementations
AI delivery/solution experience in a contact center context, specifically overseeing blueprint and implementation projects
Experience working in a professional services/consulting environment
Experience with estimation/sizing and SOW/Change Order contracting
Demonstrated experience facilitating requirements sessions, writing or grooming user stories, and presenting functional content directly to client stakeholders
Experience applying Agile and hybrid approaches to project management
Current AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) certification

Preferred Skills:

Working knowledge of contact center technology, including IVR and voice, chat, and SMS channels, call routing, integrations, and reporting
Hands-on experience delivering agentic AI solutions in a contact center context
Hands-on experience with Jira and Smartsheet, or similar project-management and agile tooling
A hybrid skillset; prior experience in roles such as Solution Architect, Product Owner, Functional/Technical Consultant, or Business Analyst
Strong presentation and communication skills
Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve project delivery
Ability to influence without formal authority, resolve conflict, and drive decisions across client and delivery teams
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology or Management

What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

new_jobs.title: Claims Fraud and Investigations Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in insurance fraud investigations, claims operations, and people management and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Claims Fraud and Investigations Manager for our Waterloo officee to lead and develop a team responsible for the prevention, detection, and investigation of suspected insurance fraud while supporting the effective management of claims fraud risk.

Reporting to the AVP, Investigative and Recovery Services you will oversee the daily operations of the Claims Fraud Investigations team, provide technical expertise and leadership on complex fraud matters, and help develop strategies that enhance fraud detection, investigation outcomes, and organizational savings. You will work closely with Claims leadership, investigators, Human Resources, and other key business partners to ensure investigations are conducted effectively, professionally, and in compliance with regulatory and governance requirements.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

The position is currently based in Waterloo, with plans to relocate to our new Kitchener office when it opens in early 2027.

What you will do

Lead the daily operations of the Claims Fraud Investigations team and ensure the delivery of high-quality investigative services to the Claims organization.
Promptly review and triage investigative referrals from all sources
Promptly assign investigations to the appropriate internal investigator after triaging them
Provide counter fraud education on key fraud indicators, fraud trends, fraud metrics, etc. to Zurich adjusters and management
Provide operational leadership and technical guidance to investigators while supporting the development and execution of fraud investigation strategies.
Deliver professional investigation reports with clear conclusions and technically sound recommendations.
Monitor and manage highly complex fraud investigations, including matters involving arbitration and litigation.
Handle technical referrals, complaints, and collaborate with Internal Audit regarding claims fraud investigation performance.
Conduct quarterly quality audits of completed investigations and periodic reviews of open investigations as needed.
Develop team capabilities through coaching, mentoring, and training related to fraud identification, investigation, documentation, and reporting.
Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for Claims leaders and managers regarding fraud investigation activities.
Ensure compliance with all local regulations, privacy requirements, and Zurich Claims governance standards.
Collect, analyze, and report fraud-related data to support management reporting, business insights, and fraud strategy initiatives.
Promote awareness and adherence to claims fraud prevention and investigation strategies across the organization.
Act as the liaison between the Claims Fraud Investigation team and Human Resources on employee-related matters.
Foster strong working relationships across Claims and other business units to support successful investigative outcomes.

Job Qualifications - What You Bring To The Table

Bachelor's Degree and 6 or more years of experience in Insurance Fraud or Insurance Investigations.

OR

Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree, and 6 or more years of experience in Insurance Fraud or Insurance Investigations.

OR

High School Diploma or equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in Insurance Fraud or Insurance Investigations.

AND

Leadership experience.
Project management experience.
Must obtain and maintain anti-fraud certification.
Knowledge of claims handling processes and procedures.
Experience interpreting and applying fraud statutes and regulations.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
People leadership and team development experience.
Experience working collaboratively across business units and stakeholder groups.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation based on objective criteria such as skills, experience, and internal equity. The salary range for this position is $100,000 to $150,000. This range reflects the expected pay for the role across Canada and may vary depending on factors like office location, specific responsibilities, and individual qualifications. As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable compensation range, but starting salaries may exceed this range based on a candidate’s skills and experience.

Our Culture

At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.
We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.
We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.
We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.
We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. new_jobs.title: Senior Cyber Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
If you are motivated and believe in the credit union philosophy of "People Helping People," join our team!

About The Role

The Senior Cyber Intelligence Analyst is the technical lead for intelligence-driven detection and exposure management. You own the analytic tradecraft, the detection engineering standards, and the intelligence products that shape how the organization prioritizes vulnerabilities, builds detections, and briefs leadership. You set the bar for the team's Splunk work, mentor analysts, and represent threat intelligence to peer teams and executives.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real ownership. You are expected to define how the work gets done, not just do it, and to make defensible analytic calls that leadership will act on.

What you will do

Lead threat intelligence and analysis

Own the intelligence requirements process: define priority intelligence requirements with stakeholders, maintain the collection plan, and evaluate feed and vendor value.
Lead analysis of threat actors, campaigns, malware families, and TTPs relevant to financial services, our technology stack, and our third-party ecosystem, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
Produce and quality-review decision-ready intelligence products at the tactical, operational, and strategic levels, including briefings for the CISO and contributions to governance and Board-level reporting.
Own the threat-informed assessment of newly disclosed vulnerabilities (CISA KEV, EPSS, exploit availability, vendor advisories) and drive that assessment into vulnerability prioritization and emergency remediation decisions.
Lead intelligence support to incident response: attribution, campaign context, indicator enrichment, and post-incident lessons that become detections and requirements.
Represent the organization in industry sharing communities (FS-ISAC and peer groups) and build relationships with vendor and government intelligence contacts.

Lead detection engineering

Own the detection engineering program in Splunk Enterprise Security: standards, lifecycle, coverage measurement, and the tuning process.
Design and build high-value detections, correlation searches, and risk-based alerting (RBA) logic; review and mentor others' detection work.
Maintain the MITRE ATT&CK coverage map, prioritize gaps against current threat intelligence and crown-jewel assets, and drive a roadmap to close them.
Establish detection-as-code practices: version control, peer review, testing against replayed or emulated attack data, and controlled deployment.
Lead purple-team and adversary emulation exercises to validate detections and measure real coverage rather than assumed coverage.
Set standards for SPL quality, data model use, CIM compliance, and search performance; partner with the Splunk platform team on data onboarding and platform direction.

Lead threat hunting and exposure management

Design and run the threat hunting program: hunt hypotheses tied to priority intelligence requirements, documented methodology, and outcomes that feed detections and remediation.
Lead cross-source analysis correlating vulnerability data (Tenable) with endpoint (SentinelOne), source control (GitHub), network and edge (F5, Check Point, Zscaler), and email (Proofpoint) telemetry to identify exposed, exploitable, and actively targeted assets.
Serve as the threat intelligence lead for the continuous threat exposure management (CTEM) program, ensuring exposure prioritization reflects real adversary behavior and business impact.
Provide threat research and detection strategy for emerging programs in AI security, software supply chain and third-party risk, and application security.

Mentor, influence, and report

Mentor and technically guide analysts on the team; review analytic products and detections for rigor and clarity.
Own the team's Splunk dashboards and scheduled reporting for intelligence metrics, detection coverage, hunt outcomes, and threat-informed vulnerability metrics that roll up to leadership reporting.
Influence remediation and control decisions across IT operations, application owners, and engineering by presenting evidence-based risk assessments.
Brief executives and governance audiences clearly and credibly, including confidence levels and dissenting assessments.

What you bring

Required

7+ years in cybersecurity with at least 4 years in threat intelligence, detection engineering, or threat hunting, including experience leading work streams or projects.
Expert hands-on Splunk skills: advanced SPL, Splunk Enterprise Security, correlation searches, risk-based alerting, data models, CIM, and search optimization.
A track record of building detection programs or coverage strategies, not just individual detections, and measuring their effectiveness.
Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, structured analytic techniques, and intelligence product standards (confidence language, sourcing, analytic rigor).
Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and email, with the ability to translate it into telemetry and search logic.
Experience integrating threat intelligence into vulnerability prioritization using CVSS, VPR, EPSS, CISA KEV, and exploit intelligence.
Excellent analytic writing and briefing skills; comfortable presenting to executives and defending assessments under scrutiny.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and raise the technical bar for a team.

Preferred

Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, with familiarity in FFIEC, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and PCI DSS expectations for threat intelligence and monitoring.
Experience with Tenable, SentinelOne, GitHub Advanced Security, Zscaler, Proofpoint, or comparable platforms.
Python for enrichment, automation, and data analysis; experience with security APIs and STIX/TAXII; experience operating a threat intelligence platform (TIP).
Experience with detection-as-code tooling and CI/CD for detections.
Hands-on experience with CTEM or exposure management platforms.
Experience running purple-team or adversary emulation programs.
Certifications such as GCTI, GCDA, GCFA, GREM, Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, or CISSP.
Research or practical experience in AI/ML security, software supply chain security, or application security.

new_jobs.title: Research Analyst - Cyberspace Operations
new_jobs.description:
Apply your analytical skills to support the Department of War’s assessments of full-spectrum cyberspace operations. Provide rigorous independent analysis and insights to key decision-makers in the Department and Congress to ensure that the warfighting enterprise is secure, resilient, and mission-capable. Make a tangible impact with great pay and benefits.

About IDA

This position is part of IDA’s Operational Evaluation Division (OED), located in Alexandria, VA, just outside Washington, D.C. IDA is a non-profit, federally funded research and development center (FFRDC) that delivers objective, rigorous analysis on the nation’s toughest national security, technology, and science policy challenges. Our work is team-based, multi-disciplinary, and deeply impactful to national defense.

What does research look like in this position?

Plan, design, observe, and analyze assessments of full-spectrum cyberspace operations within the Department of War. Define data needs and analysis and reporting methods.
Work independently, in small teams, and collaboratively with government sponsors, to advocate for operationally realistic cyber assessments, ensuring that military systems are resilient and that forces can achieve and sustain dominance in the cyberspace domain.
Develop firsthand knowledge of cyberspace operations by participating in Department-wide planning and attending assessment events.
Conduct independent, in-depth analyses of assessment results to assess the ability of equipped combat forces to conduct realistic operations in contested, threat-representative conditions.
Present findings to mid- and senior-level officials (e.g., presidential appointees, generals, admirals, etc.) through oral presentations and written reports.

What qualifications and skill-sets do you need?

Required:

Candidate must meet one of the following education/experience combinations:
PhD in a STEM field (such as Physics, Chemistry, Applied Mathematics, Engineering (such Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Chemical Engineering), Computer Science, or Operations Research), or any other data-intensive research field; OR
Masters degree (same fields as above) along with 6+ years of work experience in research, system design/engineering, or system operations; OR
Master's degree (same fields as above) combined with military experience in cyberspace operations or cybersecurity-related fields

Have an interest in learning fundamentals of cybersecurity, cyberspace operations, and the implications of operating in contested cyberspace.
Proficiency with compilation and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data
Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.
Availability to travel approximately 25% time.
Successful completion of a background check is required.
Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred:

Prior military, DoW acquisition, test and evaluation, and/or assessment experience.
Knowledgeable in cyberspace domain awareness or cybersecurity.
Experience with software or programming languages used in research, engineering, testing, and analysis automation (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB).

Why work at IDA?

Comprehensive benefits including diverse health insurance options, generous 10% contribution to retirement, maternity/paternity leave, 20 days paid time off, and relocation assistance;
Mission-oriented work at a non-profit that supports and protects our warfighters; as a non-profit, IDA employees are eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSFL);
Professional development including tuition reimbursement, internal and external trainings, and funding for researcher-pitched projects and publications;
A strong employee and corporate culture of work-life balance.
Organization-wide commitment to diversity in the workplace and providing a working environment free from discrimination, by fostering a culture of active citizenship and implementing data-driven processes of continuous feedback and learning.
Flat corporate structure that encourages collaboration and ability to choose your own projects.
A brand-new facility located in Alexandria’s high-tech corridor in Potomac Yard; amenities include gym, and close proximity to local dining and shopping; and
Easy access to Potomac Yard Metro stop and Potomac Yard DASH bus stop. Employer contributes $340/month (IRS max) to commuter benefits.

What are the next steps?

Complete the application and submit your resume.
The application process consists of three interviews.

A short screening call with HR;
A 30 min – 60 min screening call with researchers; and
Full day interview with various researchers and staff; includes giving an hour presentation on a research project.
Prior to the full day interview, you will be asked to provide:

Transcripts (unofficial accepted);
3 letters of recommendation; and
A writing sample.

Identity Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing our government is no longer how to get more data – it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our nation’s leaders.

As an Identity Intelligence Analyst for the U.S. Army Europe Africa team, you'll bring strategic, operational intel analyst experience leveraging all sources of information to collaborate and coordinate planning and activities at an Army Service Component Command in support of real-world operations in Europe and Africa. You’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client address challenging digital forensic challenges. You’ll validate the information and develop tradecraft, as you build assessments for senior policymakers. This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skillset into areas like digital forensics, and media exploitation. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have the resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our nation’s leaders and policymakers.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

At Alteryx, Security and Trust are foundational to how we help organizations use data, analytics, and artificial intelligence with confidence. The Security Trust team helps build confidence in Alteryx by supporting security assurance activities across customers, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders. We operate as a global team supporting the organization around the clock, using scalable processes, reusable knowledge, automation, and artificial intelligence to meet the needs of a fast-moving business.

Position Overview

The Information Security Analyst, Security Trust supports security assurance workflows across the Information Security organization. This includes customer security reviews, Trust Center operations, third-party risk assessments, vendor security reviews, security documentation, evidence management, and operational reporting.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys analyzing security information, communicating clearly, improving processes, and using artificial intelligence tools to reduce manual work. The analyst will have the opportunity to develop across multiple areas of Security Trust, with room to grow more deeply into customer trust, third-party risk management, or broader security assurance operations over time.

What You'll Do

Support global Security Trust operations across customer trust, third-party risk, and security assurance workflows.
Respond to customer security questionnaires, vendor assessments, due diligence requests, and requests for security documentation.
Ensure customer-facing responses are accurate, evidence-based, consistent with approved messaging, and aligned with Alteryx Security, Legal, Privacy, Product, and Compliance positions.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve self-service, reduce turnaround time, and scale Security Trust operations globally.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the broader Information Security organization.

Artificial Intelligence & Automation

Artificial intelligence is a core part of how the Security Trust team operates and scales. Success in this role requires a passion for leveraging AI to improve productivity, quality, and consistency while maintaining strong security and governance practices.

You Will

Use approved AI tools to accelerate questionnaire completion, vendor assessments, evidence collection, document generation, content maintenance, and security analysis.
Develop reusable prompts, workflows, and knowledge assets that improve consistency and reduce manual effort across the team.
Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve operational efficiency.
Validate AI-generated outputs for technical accuracy, completeness, consistency, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.
Measure and improve the effectiveness of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining human oversight and accountability.
Help drive adoption of AI-enabled processes that improve the experience of customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Strong written, verbal, analytical, and organizational skills.
Demonstrated curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI and automation to improve security operations.

SaaS security experience.
Experience with Conveyor, SafeBase, Vanta, or similar Trust Center platforms.
Experience with third-party risk management platforms.
Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience using artificial intelligence and workflow automation in security operations.
Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSK, CTPRP).

Improve response times for customer and vendor security reviews.
Expand reusable Trust Center content.
Mature scalable Security Trust workflows.
Leverage artificial intelligence to reduce manual effort.
Build trusted cross-functional partnerships.
Support a security program that enables business growth while maintaining strong security standards.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title – Trade Operations Analyst

Location: Dublin

Duration: Permanent

Working Hours: Standard GMT (08:30am-5:00pm)

The Expertise
We’re Looking For

3 years of financial services experience, preferably with exposure to Custody Operations and/or Trade/Fixed Income Life Cycle management.
2 years of experience, in Trade Life Cycle, Settlements or Fails Management.
Experience with OMGEO Alert, CTM, CLS, Finastra preferred.

The Purpose
of Your Role

This position will be responsible for the day-to-day activities ensuring all trade confirmation and settlement processes, reporting, and inquiry responses are completed timely and accurately for the Fidelity Trading Desks (Equity, Fixed Income and FX) activities. This person will possess a full understanding of Fidelity’s organizational structure, information flow and internal systems, as well as good industry knowledge pertaining to trading and settlement of equity, and foreign currency (non USD) exchanges. They should be able to identify, analyse, and resolve complex issues or potential operational risk that may arise and effectively communicate with any party that may be involved.

The Skills
You Bring

Experience with industry practices and tools.
Detailed knowledge of market settlement practices.
Operational knowledge in FX settlement
Proficient skills in various software applications to include, Excel, Word, Power point, Outlook
Excellent interpersonal and communications skills.
Working knowledge of agile methodologies
Strong time management skills.
Strong attention to detail
Strong data analytical skills.
Must be able to recognize high-risk items and escalate those items or seek assistance to minimize loss to either the shareholder and/or Fidelity.
Must have the ability to develop solid action plans to resolve daily operational issues/problems.

The Value
You Deliver

Monitoring transactional confirmation, fails resolution, escrow activity and settlement.
Communicate issues and take initiative to proactively resolve and prevent problems
Perform market-specific processes to ensure confirmation and settlement in challenging foreign markets
Communicate with internal Equity / FX Trading Desks, Broker, Custodian Banks, and other business partners to ensure operational challenges are managed
Participate as a Subject Matter Expert on projects
Ability to work effectively within a team environment to successfully manage daily work volumes and quality standards
Works with Manager and Team Leads to identify process improvements
Ensure that all responsibilities/assignments are performed in a timely fashion
Deliver effective written and verbal communication to appropriate business partners

How Your Work Impacts
the Organization

The Global Middle Office (GMO) acts as a servicing centre for FMR Co. and FIAM trading desks globally, facilitating the confirmation and settlement of security and currency transactions with brokers and custodian banks, and providing daily cash estimates to Trading. It is also responsible for coordinating corporate action executions, ensuring the collection of income to the Funds, resolving position differences and facilitating securities lending activities.

Trade Operations provides trade support to Fidelity's domestic and international equity, fixed income, high yield and foreign exchange trading desks located in Hong Kong, London and Boston.. Trade analysts work closely with the traders, broker-dealer community and the custodian bank network to facilitate trade matching and settlement in over 70 countries worldwide. In addition to the various external counterparts that the trade analysts deals with, there are also several internal groups that assist in the group's daily responsibilities, including Compliance, Treasurer's Office, Counterparty Risk, Legal, Fund Accounting and other Custody groups.

Company Overview

At Fidelity, we are focused on making our financial expertise broadly accessible and effective in helping people live the lives they want. We are a privately held company that places a high degree of value in creating and nurturing a work environment that attracts the best talent and reflects our commitment to our associates. Fidelity established an Ireland presence in 1996 and we currently employ 1000 staff across IT and shared services, with offices in Dublin (City West) and Galway (Parkmore East).

For information about working at Fidelity, visit www.fidelityinvestments.ie.

Job Description

Accelerate your career with us

The Funding & Securities Operations Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the operational execution, settlement oversight, and risk management of fixed income securities, debt issuance activities, and funding transactions. This position is responsible for end-to-end settlement support, fail management, TMPG compliance, new issue funding operations, underwriting support, and operational risk oversight across brokered CDs, bank notes, Treasury securities, and other fixed income products.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Treasury, Funding, Capital Markets, Trading, Middle Office, Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations teams, and external counterparties to ensure transactions settle accurately, funding obligations are met, regulatory requirements are satisfied, and operational risks are proactively mitigated.

Key Responsibilities

Securities Settlement, Fail Management & TMPG Oversight

Monitor daily settlement activity and identify failed or at-risk securities transactions across fixed income and government securities products.
Lead investigation, escalation, and resolution of settlement fails and operational exceptions.
Monitor aged fails and implement escalation protocols based on financial, operational, counterparty, and regulatory impact.
Engage with counterparties, custodians, clearing organizations, and internal partners to resolve settlement issues.
Support compliance with Treasury Market Practices Group (TMPG) requirements, including fail charge monitoring, validation, reconciliation, and dispute resolution.
Review fail trends, settlement performance, and exception activity to identify opportunities for risk reduction and process enhancement.
Maintain documentation supporting fail investigations, settlements, TMPG activity, and control evidence.

Funding & New Issue Operations

Manage the operational lifecycle of brokered certificates of deposit (CDs), bank notes, and other debt issuance transactions.
Coordinate underwriting and funding activities across Treasury, Finance, Capital Markets, Legal, Operations, and external issuing agents.
Review transaction documentation and settlement requirements to ensure operational readiness and timely execution.
Monitor issuance pipelines and funding calendars to support successful transaction settlement.
Support onboarding of new funding programs, structures, products, and issuance capabilities.
Ensure funding transactions are executed within established deadlines and operational requirements.

Settlement & Wire Controls

Review and validate wire instructions, settlement details, payment routing information, and beneficiary data.
Establish and maintain settlement instructions, approved templates, and payment controls.
Coordinate with Treasury, correspondent banks, trustees, custodians, and external agents to ensure accurate and timely delivery of funding proceeds.
Investigate and resolve wire exceptions, rejected payments, settlement discrepancies, and funding delays.
Maintain documentation supporting approvals, validations, settlements, and payment processing activities.

Risk Management & Controls

Maintain a strong control framework supporting settlement activity, funding operations, and debt issuance processes.
Escalate material settlement, funding, liquidity, operational, or reputational risks to leadership and key stakeholders.
Support audits, compliance reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk management inquiries.
Ensure adherence to internal policies, procedures, and control standards.
Develop and maintain process documentation, desktop procedures, escalation protocols, and control evidence.

Analytics, Reporting & Process Improvement

Develop and maintain reporting related to settlement performance, fail activity, funding transactions, underwriting operations, and operational exceptions.
Analyze trends across fails, funding delays, wire rejections, operational breaks, and settlement exceptions.
Perform root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and opportunities for remediation.
Track operational performance metrics and remediation efforts to measure improvements and reduce risk.
Partner with Technology and Operations teams to implement automation, process simplification, and enhanced controls.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Support

Serve as a key operational contact for Funding, Treasury, Trading, Capital Markets, Finance, Risk, Technology, and external counterparties.
Provide transparency on significant settlement and funding issues, including financial and operational impacts.
Participate in governance discussions related to settlement effectiveness, funding operations, operational risk, and control enhancement.
Support new product initiatives, business changes, and operational readiness assessments.
Collaborate across teams to improve client, counterparty, and business partner experience while strengthening operational performance.

Figure (NASDAQ: FIGR) is transforming capital markets through blockchain. We’re proving that blockchain isn’t just theory - it’s powering real products used by hundreds of thousands of consumers and institutions.

Together with our 170+ partners, we’ve originated over $22 billion in home equity loans (HELOCs) on our blockchain-native platform, making Figure the largest non-bank provider of home equity financing in the U.S. Figure’s ecosystem also includes YLDS, an SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin that operates as a tokenized money market fund, and several other products and platforms that are reshaping consumer finance and capital markets.

About The Role

At Figure, we’re redefining what’s possible at the intersection of finance and technology. Fresh off our IPO, we are building the next generation of financial infrastructure, transforming how capital moves, how credit is assessed, and how customers experience financial products. Our data team sits at the heart of that transformation, serving as the analytical engine that powers the entire business. From architecting the data models that drive risk and capital allocation to delivering the reporting and insights that guide growth strategy and operational excellence, we ensure every department has the intelligence needed to win.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a vital driver of our growth and product evolution, partnering closely with Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering to optimize the borrower journey. Data Modeling & Architecture: Design and implement robust data models that transform fragmented marketing spend and application event logs into structured, "gold-standard" datasets. You will ensure our product and acquisition data is clean, organized, and optimized for cross-functional use.
Funnel Optimization: Build and maintain scalable frameworks to monitor the loan application funnel—identifying friction points, drop-off behaviors, and opportunities to improve conversion from lead to funded loan.
Technical Impact: Elevate our analytics toolkit by writing high-performance BigQuery SQL and designing intuitive Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to track KPIs like CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), Approval Rates, and Origination Volume in real-time.
Experimental Design: Partner with Product and Marketing to design, execute, and analyze A/B tests, ensuring we make evidence-based decisions on everything from landing page optimization to credit offer presentation.
Cross-Functional Insight: Act as the analytical backbone for the business, translating complex user behaviors into repeatable, automated insights that drive measurable growth and product-market fit.

Expertise with Tableau: You don’t just report data; you build intuitive dashboards that help managers visualize cohort performance, attribution models, and funnel velocity.
Statistical Depth: Strong grasp of statistical concepts like survival analysis (to model time-to-repayment or time-to-next-loan), causal inference, and significance testing.
Fintech/Lending Context: Understanding of the lending lifecycle—from initial acquisition through underwriting to funding—and how product changes impact portfolio quality.
Communication: Clear, confident ability to translate complex data trends into actionable stories for both technical teams and executive leadership.
Adaptability: A generalist mindset—you are comfortable navigating the ambiguity of a fast-moving environment and can apply your analytical toolkit to solve problems across different business domains.

About Turtlebox Audio

The first Turtlebox was born out of necessity. After breaking every “loud” product on the market through routine outdoor use, the idea of the Turtlebox was born in our garage, not as a business but just for personal use. Nothing else could get the job done.

Most portable speakers aren’t actually meant for the outdoors and can’t withstand the elements, the ones that can aren’t loud enough to be heard. When you’re at the beach or on an ATV, you need sound to carry in order to hear it over the wind, waves, and boat engines, you need a Turtlebox.

We soon realized that there was a huge need for the Turtlebox among likeminded adventurers and our journey began to set out to make the world’s loudest most rugged outdoor portable speaker.

Click here for a peek inside our workplace!

Role Overview

The Quality Data Analyst turns quality data into decisions. This role analyzes the company’s quality data, including warranty return rates, customer feedback, product reviews, and factory operational KPIs, to identify trends, uncover root causes, and drive improvements in products, operational processes, and business strategy.

Working closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations, Customer Service, and Supply Chain teams, the analyst builds dashboards that give clear visibility into how current systems and products are performing, designs experiments to determine the best configurations or operational changes, and applies predictive modeling to improve customer experience, operational excellence, and other business outcomes. The analyst tracks quality performance over time and delivers clear, data-backed recommendations to stakeholders at every level of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Data analysis and preparation

Collect, combine, and analyze quality data from multiple sources, such as warranty claims, returns and RMA records, customer service tickets, product reviews, factory inspection results, and supplier data.
Review data structures and identify errors, inconsistencies, and gaps before analysis begins.
Clean and prepare data by correcting errors, removing duplicates, and handling missing values, documenting each step so results are repeatable.
Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in failure modes, defect rates, and return reasons, and dig into the root causes behind them.

Validation and testing

Run validation checks to confirm data meets business rules and quality standards.
Build and maintain automated data quality checks so issues are caught early rather than discovered in reports.
Design and run experiments (A/B tests, process trials, design-of-experiments studies) to evaluate proposed product or operational changes and measure their impact.

Dashboard development and reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards that give leadership and cross-functional teams real-time visibility into quality performance, from the factory floor to the customer’s hands.
Automate recurring reports (weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews) to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.
Translate complex findings into clear, concise summaries and visuals for both technical and non-technical audiences.

KPI monitoring and predictive analytics

Track key quality metrics such as warranty return rates, customer returns, defect rates, first-pass yield, and other operational KPIs, and flag negative trends early.
Build predictive models to forecast warranty exposure, anticipate emerging product issues, and support proactive decisions that improve customer experience and operational excellence.
Set baselines and targets for quality KPIs in partnership with Quality and Operations leadership.

Cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement

Partner with Engineering, Operations, and suppliers to investigate quality issues and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Share insights from customer feedback and field returns with Product Development to inform future designs.
Provide data-driven recommendations and follow up to measure whether implemented changes delivered the expected results.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, preferably in consumer goods, consumer electronics, or a related industry.
Strong proficiency in SQL, plus experience with a scripting or programming language (such as Python or R) for data analysis.
Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (such as Power BI or Tableau) and building dashboards for business users.
Solid knowledge of statistical techniques and concepts (regression, probability distributions, hypothesis testing and their proper use) and experience applying them to real business problems.
Experience working in a fulfillment, production, or other operational environment.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail.

Preferred

Familiarity with quality tools and methodologies such as Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), 8D, or root cause analysis.
Experience analyzing warranty, returns, or customer feedback data, including text analysis of reviews or service tickets.
Experience with predictive modeling or machine learning techniques.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and to work independently.
