new_jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Dave vs. Goliath. We’re Dave.

Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave’s digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave’s offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option.

Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most.

Dave is hiring a Marketing Project Manager to own the vendor, contract, and systems operations that keep our Marketing team moving. You'll be the connective tissue between our agencies, vendors, Legal, and Marketing teams.

The Opportunity

As Marketing's Project Manager, you'll be the day-to-day point of contact for vendor contract management, agency management, and systems and workflow management. You'll partner with Marketing managers, Project Management, and Legal to keep contracts on schedule and ensure we have the right workflow structures in place. We'll count on you to spot friction in our workflows and fix it, including piloting AI-assisted tools that take repetitive work off the team's plate.

What You Build & Own

Vendor relationships, end-to-end. Serve as the primary contact for vendor information requests, diligence forms, and contract logistics so partners onboard quickly and stay compliant.
Contractor, talent, and creator logistics. Source, onboard, and schedule contractors and freelancers; coordinate agency, talent, and creator/influencer partnerships, including fulfillment and work with our User Acquisition team.
Asset and repository management. Keep marketing assets organized in our digital asset management (DAM) system and pull materials by date range on demand.
Audit requests. Own the fulfillment of audit requests, working with Legal and Marketing managers to pull and organize relevant documentation.
Systems and workflow. Maintain and improve our project management systems, and pilot AI-assisted workflows for vendor, invoice, and asset tasks with the Manager of Marketing Operations.

The impact

When vendors and tools are onboarded quickly, and assets are organized and on schedule, our marketers can spend less time on admin and more time reaching the members who count on Dave. You'll make the whole Marketing organization faster.

What We’re Looking For

3-5 years of project management experience
3-5 years in-house or at an agency, working directly in or closely with creative production
Hands-on experience with project management systems such as Jira or Confluence
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the flexibility to adapt to rapid and ongoing change
Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and stay effective under pressure
Resourceful and proactive; you learn quickly and think ahead
Works well with people across many roles, bringing a positive, empathetic approach to managing project teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice-to-have

Experience managing agency or vendor invoicing and contracts
Experience with creator or influencer partnership logistics
Experience using AI tools to automate repetitive operational work

What To Expect

Marketing at Dave moves fast, and priorities shift as we learn what works. You'll have real autonomy over how vendor and production operations run, and we'll expect you to use data like spend, turnaround times, and delivery dates to decide what to fix first. If you like bringing order to ambiguity, you'll thrive here.

Why join Dave

Mission: Help build products that level the financial playing field for everyday Americans.
Scope and growth: Own a function end to end and shape how Marketing works with its partners.
Resources and support: Work alongside experienced Marketing Operations, Legal, and Creative partners.
Meaningful challenges: Modernize core workflows, including with AI, and see the results quickly.

Ready to build for the underdog?

Reports to: Manager, Marketing Operations & Production

Don’t let imposter syndrome get in the way of an incredible opportunity. We’re looking for people who can help us achieve our mission and vision, not just check off the boxes. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Dave, our people are just as important as our product. Our culture reflects the values that guide who we are, how we work, and what we aspire to be. Daves are member-centric, helpful, transparent, persistent, and better together. We strive to create an environment where all Daves feel valued, heard, and empowered to do their best work. As a virtual-first company, team members can live and work anywhere in the United States, except Hawaii.

A Few Of Our Benefits & Perks

💚 Opportunity to tackle tough challenges, learn and grow from fellow top talent, and help millions of people reach their personal financial goals

💻 Flexible hours and virtual-first work culture with a home office stipend

🏥 Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance plans

👶 Generous paid parental and caregiver leave

💰 401(k) savings plan with matching contributions

📈 Financial advisor and financial wellness support

🏖️ Flexible PTO and generous company holidays, including Juneteenth and Winter Break

🎉 All-company in-person events once or twice a year and virtual events throughout to connect with your team members and leadership team

Dave Operating LLC is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is dedicated to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We will consider for employment all qualified applicants and do not discriminate on any basis protected by federal, state, or local law, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance relating to an applicant's criminal history.

As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.
We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager
to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).
What You'll Do
As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. Responsibilities
Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.

Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules

Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.

Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.

Position Summary

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection & Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings & Program Management
; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers
, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team.

NV5’s Project Delivery Services, a part of Buildings & Program Management, is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Project Manager to serve in an Owner’s Representative role within our multidisciplinary project delivery team. This position will manage complex projects from inception through completion and coordinate architects, engineers, technical specialists, and other professionals across the NV5 platform, as well as outside consultants. The Senior Project Manager will serve as a trusted client advisor, provide strategic and day-to-day direction to integrated project teams, and maintain accountability for delivery consistent with client goals, contractual requirements, budget, schedule, quality, and risk expectations.

This is a hybrid position based in New York City, New York.

Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Owner’s Representation

Serve as the Owner’s Representative and trusted client contact, protecting client interests and guiding decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
Build trusted relationships with client leadership and stakeholders; translate strategic and operational objectives into clear project priorities and delivery requirements.
Lead complex multidisciplinary project teams on behalf of the Owner and NV5, exercising sound judgment and maintaining accountability for scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder alignment.
Develop durable client relationships and lead or materially support business development efforts, including pursuit strategy, proposals, interviews, scoping, and expansion of follow-on work.

Project Management & Delivery

Lead complex projects and programs from early planning and programming through design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
Develop delivery strategies and manage scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk with a high degree of independence in alignment with client goals and contractual requirements.
Establish project communication protocols, escalation paths, and decision-making processes appropriate to project complexity and stakeholder needs.
Coordinate and integrate multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, planners, technical specialists, contractors, and consultants from across the NV5 platform and external partners, clarifying roles, deliverables, interfaces, and accountability.

Design & Construction Oversight

Manage design-phase activities across disciplines to confirm alignment with program requirements, technical interfaces, constructability, budget, schedule, quality, and regulatory standards.
Lead integrated reviews of design deliverables at key milestones, resolve cross-discipline coordination issues, and guide cost-estimating, value-management, and design-to-budget efforts.
Serve as the Owner’s primary project liaison during construction, monitoring progress, quality, safety, and team performance through site observations, project reporting, and meetings.
Evaluate and provide well-supported recommendations regarding RFIs, submittals, change orders, claims, disputes, and other matters with material cost, schedule, technical, or contractual implications.

Project Controls & Financial Management

Establish and maintain project controls, including integrated schedules, budgets, cash-flow forecasts, performance metrics, and client reporting.
Anticipate, quantify, communicate, and mitigate schedule, cost, technical, contractual, and performance risks before they affect project outcomes.
Manage the development and reconciliation of cost estimates, contingency strategies, and forecasts at key design and construction milestones.
Review and recommend approval of pay applications, invoices, change orders, and financial commitments, providing clear analysis of impacts and available options.

Regulatory, Permitting & Documentation Oversight

Develop regulatory and permitting strategies and coordinate entitlements, permits, and approvals from Authorities Having Jurisdiction.
Lead coordination with public agencies, user groups, community representatives, and other stakeholders on complex or sensitive project matters.
Maintain comprehensive project documentation, records management, decision logs, and reporting, and promote consistent team compliance.

Closeout, Occupancy & Transition

Plan and lead project closeout, including punch lists, commissioning, inspections, final acceptance, and resolution of outstanding contractual and technical matters.
Coordinate multidisciplinary move-in, occupancy, training, systems activation, and operational transition activities to support a successful handoff.
Ensure timely financial reconciliation, contract closeout, lessons learned, and turnover of warranties, record documents, and operational information.

Internal Management & Mentorship

Manage internal project performance, including staffing coordination, workload planning, fee and contract management, invoicing, accounts receivable, profitability, and forecast accuracy.
Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and quality oversight to project managers, coordinators, and technical team members; delegate effectively and support accountability for results.
Contribute to multidisciplinary delivery practices across NV5 by sharing lessons learned and supporting improvements to tools, standards, resource coordination, and training.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

Establish credibility as a trusted Owner’s Representative and project advisor for assigned clients.
Lead complex multidisciplinary assignments through key milestones with clear accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.
Demonstrate strong project financial stewardship, reliable forecasting, and timely escalation and resolution of material issues.
Build effective working relationships across NV5 disciplines and regions, creating integrated teams that deliver coordinated solutions.
Strengthen project team capability through mentoring, delegation, quality oversight, and consistent use of project delivery standards.
Support NV5 growth in local and strategic markets through client relationships, cross-selling, and participation in pursuits and market activities.

Qualifications
Specific Knowledge & Skills

Advanced proficiency in project budgeting, scheduling, forecasting, project controls, financial management, and delivery planning for complex assignments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to advise clients, facilitate difficult decisions, and present clear recommendations.
Demonstrated project leadership, independent judgment, negotiation, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and risk-management abilities.
Strong knowledge of design and construction processes, consultant coordination, contracts, procurement, and multiple project delivery methods.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams, integrate technical workstreams, manage interfaces between disciplines, and promote accountability among internal and external contributors.
Proficiency with MS Office, Bluebeam, and common project management, scheduling, financial, and collaboration tools.
Ability to travel as required by project assignments; travel percentage will vary based on project location.

Requirements

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture, engineering, project management, facilities management, or a related field preferred.
Project experience in Mission Critical/Data Center sectors preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible experience managing design and construction projects, including substantial responsibility for complex, multidisciplinary assignments.
Demonstrated experience leading project teams, working independently, managing client relationships, and taking responsibility for project financial performance and delivery outcomes.
Demonstrated experience coordinating architects, engineers, contractors, technical specialists, and other disciplines across organizational or geographic boundaries.
Established professional network within the Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Development industry in the Northeast and across the United States.
Professional registration (Professional Engineer, Registered Architect, etc.) or project management certification (PMP, CCM) strongly preferred.

The pay range for this position in New York is up to $180,000; however, base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, dependent on the position offered. We Do Consulting Differently

Job Summary

The Workplace Portfolio, Sr. Project Manager leads complex projects across BRG’s global workplace portfolio and owns defined programs that improve capital planning and project delivery. The role combines hands-on responsibility for office expansions, relocations, and renovations with portfolio analysis and executive recommendations. Program ownership includes workplace standards and governance, delivery tools and playbooks, and strategic process improvement.

Working with the Head of Workplace Portfolio, this person translates business needs into practical options, maintains reliable project controls, and develops consistent delivery practices across locations. The role exercises independent judgment within approved scope and budgets. Portfolio strategy, capital allocation, and lease or contractual commitments remain subject to established leadership and legal approvals.

Reports to: Head of Workplace Portfolio

Role: Senior individual contributor; no direct reports

Travel required: 25–50% domestic and international.

Duties And Responsibilities

Project Delivery

Act as BRG’s owner’s representative for assigned workplace projects, directing external project teams and managing delivery from market surveys and site selection through design, construction, commissioning, and occupancy, including furniture, workplace technology, and relocations. Exercise this responsibility within approved scope, budgets, and authority.
Direct architects, engineers, contractors, and other project providers. Lead procurement, bid evaluations, scope development, and vendor negotiations in coordination with Legal and other required approvers.
Adapt project delivery to local market conditions, regulatory requirements, and procurement practices, coordinating with regional partners and required internal approvers.
Review test fits and construction documents, conduct site inspections, and coordinate technology, security, and building-system requirements.
Manage operational handoff and closeout, including readiness checks, as-built documents, warranties, final accounts, and landlord obligations such as tenant-improvement reimbursements.

Analysis & Planning

Lead assigned portfolio-planning initiatives, using headcount forecasts and utilization data to evaluate renewals, relocations, expansions, and consolidations.
Develop decision-ready business cases comparing capacity, total occupancy cost, capital requirements, and delivery risks. Recommend a preferred option and identify the approvals needed.

Capital Planning & Program Controls

Own annual and multi-year capital plans for assigned projects, including budgets, cash-flow forecasts, commitments, and variance reporting. Partner with Finance to distinguish capital expenditure from ongoing occupancy costs.
Develop and maintain capital-project budgeting tools and processes with Finance and IT, including estimating templates, cost benchmarks, forecasting, and variance reporting. Standardize their use across projects and improve reporting to reduce manual work.
Maintain an integrated view of concurrent projects, including schedule dependencies, resource conflicts, and emerging risks.
Apply approval checkpoints and change-control procedures. Escalate scope, cost, or schedule changes with a clear recommendation before commitments exceed delegated authority.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

Partner with office leaders, Finance, and the Head of Workplace Portfolio to prioritize needs and translate approved decisions into sequenced project plans. Present recommendations and progress to executive audiences.

Workplace Program Leadership

Own and maintain workplace project standards and governance approved by the Head of Workplace Portfolio. Define consistent delivery stages, review checkpoints, documentation requirements, and escalation procedures within established approval boundaries.
Develop and maintain workplace playbooks, templates, and procedures covering project initiation through operational handoff. Support consistent use across the global portfolio while allowing for local requirements.
Develop and maintain RFP templates and procurement playbooks for project management, design, and construction services. Standardize scopes, evaluation criteria, and selection documentation in coordination with Legal and required internal approvers.
Capture global project best practices and lessons learned through structured post-project reviews. Incorporate findings into delivery standards, playbooks, and team guidance.
Lead value-engineering and sourcing reviews that evaluate cost, operational requirements, and delivery risk. Document approved savings against an agreed baseline and use project results to improve cost benchmarks and procurement practices. Maintain vendor-performance measures and use post-project reviews to improve delivery and identify repeatable savings.
Mentor team members in financial analysis and executive communication. Review work quality and help resolve complex project issues without assuming direct people-management responsibility.
Coordinate reliable lease, critical-date, occupancy, and cost reporting with the relevant record owners to support proactive planning.
Lead assigned workplace environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives and incorporate approved sustainability requirements into project delivery. Coordinate greenhouse gas (GHG) savings analysis and reporting, documenting baselines and validating calculations and reported results with the appropriate internal owners.
Lead assigned strategic process-improvement initiatives across the workplace portfolio. Identify delivery and reporting gaps, develop implementation plans, and measure results against agreed cost, cycle-time, quality, or risk measures.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of progressive experience in workplace, corporate real estate, architecture, construction, interior design, facilities, or related project management fields.
Demonstrated delivery of complex commercial office projects and concurrent initiatives across multiple locations.
Strong command of capital planning, forecasting, procurement, construction documentation, and project controls.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience developing scenario models and presenting concise recommendations to senior leadership.
Evidence of improving delivery standards or business processes, leading external teams, and mentoring colleagues.
Strong written communication and independent judgment; ability to manage ambiguity and travel domestically and internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with global workplace portfolios, occupancy planning, and lease administration or portfolio-reporting systems such as Visual Lease.
Experience with workplace sustainability or greenhouse gas reporting, including documented baselines and savings analysis.
Experience with Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Project, and workplace technology or building systems.
PMP, LEED AP, NCIDQ, architectural, construction, or other relevant professional certifications.

Salary Range: $145,000- $195,000

Position Summary

The Principal Project Manager, Corporate Compliance, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing compliance-related projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. This position serves as a liaison between Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, Information Technology, Operations, and other business stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with regulatory, accreditation, and organizational requirements.

The Project Manager is responsible for maintaining project governance, tracking milestones, managing risks and dependencies, facilitating stakeholder communication, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's compliance program. This role requires strong organizational, analytical, and relationship management skills, along with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

Position Responsibilities

Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of compliance department projects and initiatives.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
Coordinate cross functional project teams to ensure successful implementation of compliance initiatives.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, barriers, and resource constraints.
Facilitate project meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
Prepare project reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for leadership and governance committees.
Ensure project documentation is complete, organized, and maintained in accordance with departmental standards.

Compliance Program Support

Support implementation and enhancement of compliance program elements, including policies and procedures, training, risk management, hotline management, investigations, auditing and monitoring, and corrective action plans.
Coordinate enterprise compliance initiatives related to Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Marketplace, and other lines of business.
Support implementation and optimization of compliance technology platforms, including NAVEX and other governance, risk, and compliance systems.
Assist with enterprise risk assessments and compliance program effectiveness initiatives.
Monitor project activities to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory and contractual requirements.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management

Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
Coordinate activities between Compliance and business owners to ensure accountability for project deliverables.
Manage vendor implementation activities and track contractual deliverables, milestones, and action items.
Facilitate issue resolution and escalation when project risks or delays are identified.

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, workflows, and operational efficiencies.
Develop standard operating procedures, project methodologies, templates, and reporting tools.
Support automation, workflow optimization, and technology enhancements designed to improve compliance operations.
Track project outcomes and key performance indicators to measure effectiveness and support continuous improvement.

Governance and Reporting

Maintain project governance structures and documentation.
Develop meeting agendas, meeting minutes, action item logs, and project status reports.
Present updates to Compliance Leadership, executive leadership, and applicable committees.
Ensure action items are assigned, monitored, and completed timely.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Project Management, Compliance, Public Health, or related field required.
Master's degree preferred.

Experience

Minimum of five (5) years of project management experience required.
Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting compliance, regulatory, healthcare, health plan, PBM, TPA, or highly regulated business environments preferred.
Experience leading enterprise or cross departmental projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, dependencies, and organizational objectives required.
Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms preferred.
Experience managing the annual review of business continuity plans and disaster recovery plans preferred.

Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) considered.
Healthcare Compliance certification such as CHC or CCEP preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong project planning, organization, and execution skills.
Knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience facilitating meetings and driving accountability across departments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and Project.
Experience with JIRA, Smartsheet, Asana, or similar project management tools preferred.
Experience with NAVEX, policy management systems, incident management systems, or other compliance platforms preferred.
Knowledge of healthcare regulatory requirements, including CMS, HIPAA, URAC, and NCQA standards preferred.

Holliswood Development is hiring a Senior Project Manager – Residential Development.

New York, NY | Full-Time | On-Site
Compensation: $150,000–$200,000, commensurate with experience

ABOUT HOLLISWOOD
Founded in 2011, Holliswood Development is a vertically integrated NYC real estate investment and development firm focused on residential value-add opportunities, multifamily renovations, luxury conversions, and the repositioning of existing buildings across Manhattan and Brooklyn. Our projects are small to mid-sized, and we run them with lean, collaborative teams and an entrepreneurial mindset.

THE ROLE
This is an owner-side role. You'll work directly with ownership and oversee third-party GCs, architects, engineers, and consultants on projects in existing NYC buildings, often requiring Alt-1 and Alt-2 filings. You'll have significant influence over design, layouts, finishes, budgets, and schedules, and you'll drive projects from initial planning through completion.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead pre-construction: design development, budgeting, constructability reviews, scheduling, and procurement
• Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings to catch conflicts and cost or schedule impacts early
• Identify value-engineering opportunities without compromising design intent or quality
• Develop and maintain budgets, schedules, scopes of work, and cost controls
• Solicit and level GC bids, negotiate scopes, manage buyouts, and evaluate change orders
• Manage 3–5 projects at once through regular site visits and project coordination
• Coordinate DOB filings, permitting, inspections, and approvals with expediters and consultants
• Report to ownership on budgets, schedules, risks, and key decisions

QUALIFICATIONS
• 7+ years in construction management, real estate development, or project management
• Experience with NYC multifamily renovations, luxury residential, conversions, or value-add projects
• Strong knowledge of existing NYC buildings, DOB requirements, and Alt-1 / Alt-2 filings
• Strong architectural and design sensibility, with an eye for layouts, detailing, and high-end finishes
• Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit; Bluebeam and Procore preferred
• Ability to manage multiple projects independently and take full ownership of execution
• Preferred: degree in architecture, construction management, or engineering, plus owner/developer-side experience

If you or someone you know would be a strong fit, please email a resume and a brief note on your background and why you'd be a good fit to mgreely@holliswoodnyc.com.
